item.nusmp.cloak_of_comfort.desc: Cool in the heat and warm in the cold: thermal-fluctuation, cold and heat resistance, and freezing and magma do you almost no harm. It also makes camp anywhere: rest, heal and set your spawn point.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_comfort.card:
While worn: Tensura's Thermal Fluctuation, Cold and Heat Resistance are lent to you; freezing damage is cut by 90%, powder snow and Tensura's Chill never get hold of you; magma damage is cut by 90% and fire damage by 15%. Make Camp (use, 5 min): on dry level ground with no hostile creature within 14 blocks, rest by the cloak: heal 6, Regeneration for 10 seconds, four points of food, and your spawn point is set where you stand.
Became: the cloak's comfort in desert and tundra is the three resistance skills plus freezing, magma and fire resistance (there is no weather temperature in the game); sleeping anywhere without bedding is a camp that sets your spawn point.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_dichotomy.desc: Fades from white to black. A blow struck by hand makes your next spell 20% harder to resist; a spell makes your next blow strike with up to 4.8 extra radiant damage. Each is spent once.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_dichotomy.card:
Needs attunement. The cloak fades from white to black. A blow struck by hand (the paladin's smite) makes the next spell you deal within 10 seconds 20% harder to resist (+20% damage). A spell (magic, or anything from a spell mod) makes the next blow you strike within 10 seconds deal up to 4.8 extra radiant damage (up to 7.2 against evil creatures, which also feel Tensura's Holy Damage). Each benefit is used once. Read the Balance (use) tells you which side is lit.
Became: Divine Smite is a blow struck by hand, "+2 to the save DC" is +20% spell damage, and the extra 1d8 is the radiant bonus.
item.nusmp.cloak_mimic_tame.desc: A living cloak: +2 armor, corrosion and acid resistance, night eyes and a Danger Sense that warns of ambushes, and it clings to you. It feeds on you at every dawn, on a caster's magicules first.
item.nusmp.cloak_mimic_tame.card:
A living cloak (no attunement). Shapechanger (use): the cloak shifts through six cuts and colours. Protective: +2 armor and half acid damage; Tensura's Corrosion Resistance is lent to you and Corrosion cannot take hold. Alert: night vision, Tensura's Danger Sense is lent to you, and every 2 seconds up to three hostile creatures that have chosen you and are creeping up from behind glow for 2 seconds. Clingy: +0.2 knockback resistance, it holds you in place. Hungry: at the turn of each day the cloak feeds on you: a tenth of your magicules if you have them (it prefers a caster), otherwise 4 food points; with almost nothing it takes what there is and exhausts you for a minute (weakness, slowness); starving, it takes two hearts of blood (never your last) and exhausts you.
Became: the DC 18 Strength check to remove it is not modelled (you may take it off whenever you like); sacrificing hit dice and levels of exhaustion are magicules, food and the exhaustion effects; advantage on Perception is the night vision, Danger Sense and the warning glow.
item.nusmp.arcanists_circlet.desc: Three arcane motes circle your head. Fire one at a creature you can see (36 blocks): 3 force damage that never misses. When all three are spent they gather again after a minute.
item.nusmp.arcanists_circlet.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 1).
Magic Missile: while you wear the circlet you always have this spell. Use the worn-relic key (G) to cast it.
Mote Magic: three small glowing arcane motes circle your head. Cast Magic Missile at the creature you are looking at, up to 36 blocks away: a mote flies to it and never misses, dealing 3 force damage (through the balance law, capped at 30% of a player's health). Each cast spends one mote; there is a half-second pause between motes. When all three are spent they gather again after one minute. The motes you have left are the ones you see circling you.
Tabletop became: "force damage equal to half your level" is a flat 3 per mote (nine in all); "bonus action" is the short pause; "120 ft" is 36 blocks.
item.nusmp.prides_crown.desc: A crown of golden flame. Hostile creatures within six blocks whose existence is below yours slow down in your presence. Once a day a charm or fright aimed at you is refused and turned back on its sender.
item.nusmp.prides_crown.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 2).
Golden lines form a crown of flame; the mark of Pride is confidence and the dangerous power of hubris.
Aura of Superiority: you carry the weight of the one who towers over others: +1 Luck, and every two seconds the hostile creatures within six blocks (not players, not bosses) whose maximum existence (EP) does not exceed yours slow down in your presence. Those stronger than you are not touched.
Hubris's Fall: once a day, when a Tensura effect that would charm, frighten or befuddle you (fear, hypnosis, insanity, confusion, mind control, lust) is aimed at you, the crown refuses it and turns it back on whoever sent it (or, if that cannot be told, the nearest foe within twelve blocks): five seconds of fear, half of that against a boss.
Tabletop became: "Charisma (Intimidation/Persuasion) checks" are the aura and the Luck; "Wisdom save DC 15" is the existence check of the aura and the boss halving; "once per long rest" is once per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.dreamwalker_cowl.desc: A hooded scarf of stitched dreams. You see in the dark and sense magic, and magical sleep cannot take you. Three dream charges buy Sleep, Calm Emotions and Hallucinatory Terrain; a night's sleep refills them.
item.nusmp.dreamwalker_cowl.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 1).
Eyes of the Dreamer: you see in the dark (night vision) and the Tensura skill Magic Sense is lent to you while you wear it: you see 30 feet into the ethereal.
Master Dreamer: magical sleep and drowsiness cannot take you. Act "Master Dreamer": you slip into a short dream on your feet: eight seconds of Regeneration III and Slowness II, a magical sleep on you is lifted, and the phantoms forget you have not slept.
Shared Imagery: friends within sixteen blocks see in the dark for half a minute and are lent Magic Sense (the dreamer's sight); every foe in that circle glows for ten seconds so all can see it.
Dream charges: three; they come back when you wake from a night's sleep with the cowl on.
Sleep (1 charge): up to five hostile creatures within eight blocks, the weakest first, fall asleep for eight seconds (Tensura sleep, or a deep slowness). Creatures whose existence is more than three times yours shrug it off; bosses are not affected.
Calm Emotions (1 charge): within nine blocks every creature that was hunting drops its target and stays calm for twenty seconds; friends shake off fear, charm and madness.
Hallucinatory Terrain (2 charges): an illusion wraps you and the friends within five blocks: invisible for forty seconds, Presence Concealment lent, and hunters lose you.
Tabletop became: "30-foot sphere" is nine blocks; "8 hours" is forty seconds; "falling asleep at will" is the short dream; the save DC 15 is the existence check.
item.nusmp.captains_tricorn.desc: Eight charges, two back at every dawn (1d6+2 if you sleep aboard a boat). Command halts a creature for a moment; the Captain's Order, two charges a target, rallies your crew and talks foes out of the fight.
item.nusmp.captains_tricorn.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 2). +10% swimming speed.
The hat holds eight charges and regains two each dawn; if you are riding a boat when the day turns it regains 1d6+2 instead.
Command (1 charge): "Halt!" at the creature you are looking at, within twenty blocks (not a player, not a boss, not one whose existence is more than three times yours): it stands frozen and calm for four seconds.
Captain's Order (2 charges per target, up to four targets): your pets, summons and shipmates within 24 blocks take up the order (Strength, Speed and Resistance for three minutes); then hostile creatures within twelve blocks that can be bent are talked out of the fight for half a minute (they will not hunt you; strike one and the spell breaks).
Tabletop became: "mass suggestion for 3 hours" is half a minute against foes and three minutes of buffs for crew; "spell DC 14" is the existence check.
item.nusmp.godking_crown.desc: Put on its power: ten minutes of flight, +5 on everything and three Tensura skills merged into you. Then the crown takes its price: a radiant blast on you and everything within six blocks. Take the crown off, or dismiss it, to end it in peace.
item.nusmp.godking_crown.card:
Requires attunement. A Metal Vessel for a Djinn. Worn on the head (armour 3, toughness 2), +6 maximum health, +1 Luck.
Ascend (costs 5% of your existence points; thirty minutes of cooldown): you put on the crown's power for ten minutes: flight, and "+5 to all rolls" as +4 attack damage, +5 armour, +2 toughness, +5 Luck, +0.5 knockback resistance and +15% speed, with three Tensura skills merged into it (Danger Sense, Physical Attack Resistance, Sage).
The price: when the ten minutes are over (with the crown still on) a radiant blast bursts from you: 12 damage to every foe within six blocks, who also glow, and 8 to you (never enough to kill you; you are left weakened). It is telegraphed: warnings at one minute, thirty seconds, ten and five seconds, and a ring on the ground in the last five seconds that shows who will be hit.
Escape: take the crown off, or use "Dismiss the Ascension": the power ends at once with no blast. You also fall slowly for fifteen seconds when it ends.
Tabletop became: "+5 to all rolls" is the attributes and skills above; "DC 25 Constitution save" is not rolling at all: the way out is to take the crown off in time; "9d12 radiant" is 12 to others and a non-lethal 8 to you.
item.nusmp.claws_of_greed.desc: Black claws curl round your hands. You sneak faster and your presence is hard to feel. Once a day a blow that lands snatches whatever the creature holds into your own hand.
item.nusmp.claws_of_greed.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the hands (tattoo).
Grasp of Avarice: you sneak faster (+0.3 sneaking speed) and the Tensura skill Presence Concealment is lent to you while worn (if Tensura has it): your presence is hard to feel.
Seize: once a day, when a blow of yours lands on a creature holding something in its hands (not a player, not a boss) and you have a free hand, the claws snatch the item out of its hand into yours.
Tabletop became: "+2 to Stealth and theft checks" is the sneaking speed and the concealment; "once per long rest" is once per Minecraft day; "5 pounds" is any held item.
item.nusmp.gloves_of_instant_cleanliness: Snap your fingers and everything within three blocks is spotless: you and your friends shed nausea, hunger, blindness and poison, and cobwebs and flames are swept away. Ten snaps a day. Curses stay.

No attunement. Worn on the hands.
Snap Clean: snap your fingers and everything within three blocks is spotless: you and your friends lose nausea, hunger, blindness, poison and Tensura infection, burning clothes stop burning, and cobwebs and flames within three blocks are swept away. Curses and magical afflictions stay.
Ten snaps a day (the d20 of the card, played as ten, its middle); they come back at dawn. While you wear the gloves rotten food and sickness leave you quickly: hunger and nausea are wiped from you every few seconds.
Tabletop became: "10-foot radius" is three blocks; "recharge at midnight" is at dawn.
item.nusmp.elemental_hand_wraps.desc: Ribbons that bind your fists. Turn them to fire, cold, lightning, thunder or acid: every bare-fisted blow then deals 3 extra damage of that element with its own sting. Turn them once more to quiet them.
item.nusmp.elemental_hand_wraps.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the hands.
Your bare fists are empowered by elemental magic. Act "Elemental Infusion" turns the wraps to the next element: fire, cold, lightning, thunder, acid and then none (the card's "end this effect"). While an element is set, every blow from a bare fist (nothing in your main hand) deals 3 extra damage of that element, with its own sting:
Fire: sets the creature alight for four seconds. Cold: slows it and chills it. Lightning: arcs to the nearest other foe within four blocks for 60%. Thunder: a sonic blow that throws it back. Acid: corrodes it (Tensura corrosion, or poison).
Tabletop became: "+3d6 for very rare" is a flat 3 (the card's rarity is Unique grade); "bonus action" is the short pause.
item.nusmp.thermo_gloves.desc: One red glove, one blue. Bare fists carry +2 fire or +2 cold as you choose; the red touch lights flammable things, the blue freezes water; twice a day clap them for a cloud of scalding steam. You shrug off a sixth of fire and frost.
item.nusmp.thermo_gloves.card:
No attunement. Worn on the hands. You shrug off 15% of fire and freezing damage.
Red or Blue: choose which glove strikes: your bare fists carry +2 fire damage (and set the creature alight) or +2 cold damage (and chill it).
Ignite (red glove): the flammable thing you look at within five blocks is lit as a flint and steel would (campfires, candles, flammable blocks); a creature right in front of you is set alight for four seconds.
Freeze Water (blue glove): the water you look at within six blocks, a three-by-three-by-three block of it, turns to frosted ice that thaws by itself in a while; cells with a creature in them are left alone.
Steam Cloud (twice a day): clap the gloves: a cloud of steam bursts round you. Foes within three blocks are scalded for 2, thrown back and made to fall (slowness); for fifteen seconds the cloud (six-block radius) darkens and slows your foes inside it.
Tabletop became: "10-foot cube" is three blocks; "20-foot sphere" is six; "prone" is a very strong slowness; "1 hour" is the frosted ice's own thaw; "10 minutes" is fifteen seconds.
item.nusmp.gauntlets_of_eldritch_ferocit: Stone-plated gauntlets carved with runes. Eldritch Blast: a force beam (2 to 4, never under 2). Eldritch Ferocity: two beams (up to 3 each); on a 1 or 2 of a d20 the second turns on you and lowers your maximum health until you sleep.

Requires attunement. Worn on the hands (+2 armour). Costs mana.
Eldritch Blast (2% of your mana): a beam of force at the creature you look at, up to 32 blocks: 2 to 4 damage. A roll of 1 counts as a 2, so it is never under 2.
Eldritch Ferocity (4% of your mana): two beams (up to 3 damage each, 6 in all): the first at your target and the second at another foe within eight blocks of it, or the same one. The extra beam is not free: on a 1 or 2 of a d20 it turns on you: 1.5 to 6 necrotic damage that cannot kill you, and your maximum health drops by that much (at most 6) for ten minutes or until you sleep.
Tabletop became: "treat a 1 as a 2" is the floor of 2; "3d12 necrotic, HP maximum reduced until a rest" is the non-lethal bite and the ten minutes; "ignores resistance and kills at 0" is deliberately not kept: nothing here can kill its wearer.
item.nusmp.alchemists_belt.desc: Six vials hang from this belt, each good once a day: red heals, blue shields, green regenerates (best in the sun), yellow arms your friends, purple charms a creature, black lets you shrug off one killing blow.
item.nusmp.alchemists_belt.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the belt. +2 maximum health, +1 Luck.
Six vials hang from the belt, each good once a day (they return at dawn; the card's refilling with an ingredient and water is the dawn). The attunement limit "artificer or wizard" is not kept.
Healing Potion (red): heals 10 health (the balance law may cut it if you were healed a moment ago).
Shield Potion (blue): about 8 points of absorption for three minutes.
Regeneration Potion (green): in direct sunlight Regeneration II for a minute, elsewhere a lesser Regeneration I; the Tensura skill Self Regeneration is lent for three minutes (lost limbs grow back).
Enlightening Potion (yellow): the Crusader's Mantle: you and your friends within ten blocks take Strength for three minutes and glow for ten seconds.
Love Potion (purple): the creature in front of you (within six blocks, not a player, not a boss, not far above you in existence) falls for you for ninety seconds: it will not fight you (animals fall in love); strike it and the spell breaks.
Undeath Potion (black): for three minutes you need neither air nor food, poison means nothing to you (Poison Resistance lent), and the first blow that would kill you leaves you on one health point (Undead Fortitude).
Tabletop became: "level/CR multiplied" dice are flat numbers; "18 DC Charisma save" is the existence check; "12 h" is three minutes.
item.nusmp.genie_gin.desc: Open it and a minor djinni grants one wish for a day: Power, Fortune or Fame. Sneak while you drink to turn the bottle to the next wish without using it up.
item.nusmp.genie_gin.card:
No attunement. Used up when drunk (hold use). Sneak while drinking to turn the bottle to the next wish (Power, Fortune, Fame) without using it up.
Upon opening, a minor djinni appears and grants one limited wish. Its effects last one Minecraft day (twenty minutes).
Power (an ability score to 30): Strength II, Health Boost III and Resistance for the day, and three Tensura skills lent to you (Danger Sense, Physical Attack Resistance, Sage).
Fortune (a bag that produces 10,000 gp): a stash of 24 Magic Stones (diamonds if Tensura is absent), 32 emeralds and 32 gold ingots, and Luck II for the day.
Fame (every humanoid charmed): you are the Hero of the Village for the day, and humanoid creatures within 24 blocks (illagers, witches, zombies, skeletons, piglins, goblins, orcs, lizardmen, war gnomes...) that do not shrug it off (existence more than three times yours) count you a close friend: they stop hunting you until you strike one.
Tabletop became: "24 hours" is one Minecraft day; "DC 18 Charisma save" is the existence check; "10,000 gp" is the stash.
item.nusmp.mad_marbles.desc: A sack of glass marbles with lightning in them. Pour them on the ground in front of you: the first creature to step there falls and the marbles go off in sparks that blind it; the others only slip.
item.nusmp.mad_marbles.card:
No attunement. Used up when poured.
Pour the marbles on the ground just in front of you: a three-by-three patch of glass marbles with coloured lightning in them (half a minute; three patches at most per player). The first creature to step on it (on the ground, not you or your friends) falls (a strong slowness for a moment) and the marbles go off in coloured sparks that blind it for one to four rounds (2 to 8 seconds). The patch stays slippery: other creatures that step on it fall again, at most every three seconds each, but are not blinded.
Tabletop became: "DC 17 Acrobatics/Reflex and DC 19 Fortitude saves" are not rolled: the marbles always work on whoever steps there; "a bag of 200" is one pour.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_coven.card:
Legend Grade necklace. Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn's Metal Vessel. The closed eye of Cegilune, patron goddess of the hags, hangs from a cord said to be woven of her white hair.
Darkvision. While worn you see in the dark (Night Vision).
Distant Watcher (2% mana, 30 s cooldown). The eye opens and sees for you: every hostile creature within 40 blocks in the half of the world in front of you glows for 12 seconds. Tensura's Magic Sense and Danger Sense are lent to you for 15 seconds, so the eye also feels what the dark hides.
Bloody Presage (3% mana, once per game day). Pour three hearts of your own blood on the amulet (it never takes your last ones) and the eye opens on the creature under your crosshair within 96 blocks, walls or not; if you look at none, on whatever last drew your blood in the past minute, wherever it stands in this world. It glows for 20 seconds and you learn its name, health, how much of its magicules it has left and its exact place; Tensura's Sage is lent to you for 30 seconds to read it. If the blood is its own, it cannot hide: the glow lasts 40 seconds.
Weakening Gaze (6% mana, twice per game day, 30 s cooldown). A burst of anti-magic fills 10 blocks around you for 8 seconds (a Nihility zone: barriers and area spells shatter, foes are silenced and their Tensura skills jammed): every foe in it loses Resistance, Fire Resistance and Absorption, is weakened for 8 seconds, and takes 30% more damage from every source while it lasts. Your allies, pets and summons are untouched.
Tabletop rules replaced: the spell slot and material components of Scrying became the blood and a daily use; the Wisdom saving throw became the blood binding the target; the 30 ft sphere and DC 17 Constitution save became a 10 block Nihility zone with no save (silence and skill jamming are the 'anti-magic'); 'resistances lost, immunities become resistances' became Resistance effects stripped and +30% damage (a true immunity is not lifted); 'up to five creatures unaffected' became allies, pets and summons always spared; 'until next dusk' became once or twice per game day; darkvision 60 ft became Night Vision; 'see through the amulet' became outlines plus lent Magic Sense / Danger Sense.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_coven.desc: The closed eye of a hag goddess: it shows what hides ahead, scries a creature for a price in blood, and strips your foes' defences.
item.nusmp.pendant_of_echoed_souls.card:
Unique Grade necklace. Requires attunement. A blackened silver pendant set with fragments of bone; faint whispers echo when it is held to the ear.
Echoed Souls. Once per game day, when a blow would kill you, the pendant takes the death instead: you stay on 1 health, any fire on you goes out, and 1 to 4 spectral warriors (10 health, a blow of about 5, gone after a minute) rise at your side and fight your foe. Until the last of them falls, or the minute is up, nothing can target you or hurt you (only the void and commands still can), and every Tensura skill debuff (fear, paralysis, silence...) is shaken off you each second. If no warrior can answer, a shell of bone shields you for 5 seconds instead.
It answers only once a day however many pendants you wear.
Tabletop rules replaced: 'once per long rest' became once per game day (kept on you, not on the pendant); 1d4 warriors became 1 to 4; AC 14 and 1d6 + proficiency became 10 health and a blow of about 5; 'cannot be the target of an attack or spell effect' became mobs not taking you as a target and all damage being turned aside (Tensura skill debuffs are shaken off each second; other non-damage effects still land); the 1 minute stayed a minute.
item.nusmp.pendant_of_echoed_souls.desc: Once a day a killing blow leaves you at 1 health and calls spectral warriors; while they stand, nothing can touch you.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_forest.card:
Legend Grade necklace. Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn's Metal Vessel. Ancient forest spirits bestow it on a hero who defended the natural balance. Six animal figurines hang from a cord tied in a bow.
Touch a figurine (one ability per animal) and that spirit blesses you for one game day (20 minutes). Only one spirit at a time: send it away (Send the Spirit Away) before another will answer. Each touch costs 2% mana.
Bear: 20% larger, +3 attack damage, 30% knockback resistance, +4 maximum health.
Cat: +25% movement speed, you take no harm from 4 blocks more of falling, you jump higher; Tensura's Danger Sense is lent to you.
Beetle: +4 armour, +2 armour toughness, +4 maximum health, and everything that heals you heals 50% more; Tensura's Physical Attack Resistance and Poison Resistance are lent to you.
Raccoon: +2 Luck; blindness, darkness and nausea (illusions) cannot take hold of you; Tensura's Sage is lent to you.
Owl: you see in the dark (Night Vision); charm and mind-control effects are stripped from you; Tensura's Magic Sense is lent to you.
Peacock: villagers favour you (Hero of the Village). Touch the peacock again while it blesses you to cast Charm Person: every humanoid within 5 blocks forgets you and takes no player as a target for 20 seconds; one with 40 or more health resists, and cannot be charmed again for a game day.
Tabletop rules replaced: 'advantage on ability checks' became the attribute bonuses and lent Tensura skills above; 'size increases by one category' became 20% larger; 'Hit Die heal the maximum' became +50% healing; 'automatic success against illusions' and 'cannot be charmed' became stripping those effects each second; 'Charm Person DC 15 at will' became a 5 block charm limited only by the 5 s ability cooldown, and the saving throw became 'too mighty (40 or more health) resists'; 24 hours became a game day.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_forest.desc: Six forest spirits hang from it. Touch a figurine and that spirit's blessing is yours for a day: one at a time.
item.nusmp.arcane_glass_of_seeing.card:
Rare Grade necklace. Requires attunement. A gold amulet with a reflective gem in the middle.
Look into the Glass (5 s cooldown, spends 1 of 6 charges). A six-sided die decides your next blow, which must land within 10 seconds: on 3 to 6 you strike true for 50% more damage; on 1 or 2 the glass clouds and the blow lands for 30% less. The glass regains 3 to 6 charges (1d4+2) at every dawn. If you spend the last charge there is a 1 in 20 chance the gem cracks: a cracked glass does not wake at the next dawn, then works again as before (it is never destroyed).
Tabletop rules replaced: advantage and disadvantage on the next attack became +50% and -30% damage on the next blow; 'the gem shatters and the amulet becomes non-magical' became a one-dawn crack, so the relic is never lost.
item.nusmp.arcane_glass_of_seeing.desc: Six charges. Look into the glass and a d6 decides your next blow: a 3 to 6 strikes true, a 1 or 2 falls short.
item.nusmp.voice_of_the_mountain.card:
Special Grade necklace. Requires attunement. A white horn pendant capped in silver and bound with emerald shards.
Rousing Call (2% mana, 60 s cooldown). Sound the horn: you, your tamed creatures and the friendly players (same team) within 24 blocks gain Speed I and Haste I for 20 seconds, and each player there draws 3% of their maximum magicules back (the bard's inspiration, in Tensura's currency).
Tabletop rules replaced: there is no bard class here, so the 'attunement by a bard' became plain attunement, and 'the range of the wearer's bardic abilities is increased by 25 ft' became a bard's call that the horn carries itself, at the widened reach (24 blocks), with a Tensura magicule refill for players.
item.nusmp.voice_of_the_mountain.desc: A horn that carries far. Sound it to rouse yourself and your allies within 24 blocks with Speed and Haste.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_sea_of_stars: Amulet of the Sea of Stars
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_sea_of_stars.ca:
Unique Grade necklace. Requires attunement. A silver chain holding a shield-cut amethyst.
Star-Eyed. While worn you see in the dark (Night Vision). Once per game day (3% mana) your eyes channel the stars: Truesight for 5 minutes. Invisible creatures within 24 blocks are outlined, blindness and darkness cannot hold you, and Tensura's Magic Sense and Sage are lent to you for the whole time.
Ancient Amethyst. You take 40% less damage from force (magic), radiant (holy, light) and necrotic (wither, curse, darkness) harm.
Overseer's Might. While you wear this amulet and are attuned to Astralis, the Eye of the Universe, its Dimension Walker holds 2 more charges.
Tabletop rules replaced: darkvision 120 ft became Night Vision; Truesight for 1 hour became 5 minutes of outlined invisible creatures, immunity to blinding and lent Magic Sense / Sage; damage resistance (half) became 40% less damage; 'once per day' stayed once per game day.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_sea_of_stars.de: Darkvision always; once a day Truesight for five minutes. Resists force, radiant and necrotic harm. Raises Astralis's charges by 2.
item.nusmp.pendant_of_the_dreamer.card:
Rare Grade necklace. Requires attunement. A dark bronze pendant with a glowing blue gem, hung on braided cords.
Might of the Old One. The pendant holds 6 charges and regains 1 to 6 (1d6) of them at every midnight.
Blessing of the Deep (2 charges). You breathe water for 10 minutes.
Features of the Ancient (3 charges). Sprout gills and webbing between your fingers: you breathe water and swim as fast as you walk, for up to 10 minutes. Use it again to close them (free).
Force of Mhigh'Raine (3 charges). Reach into the mind of a creature you can see within 90 blocks (walls block the sight): it takes 3 to 12 mental damage (Tensura's mind damage when present, else magic; at most 6 against a player), halved if it resists (a coin toss); if it does not resist it reels with nausea, is struck with Tensura fear and leaks 5% of its magicules (which regenerate).
Tabletop rules replaced: the Water Breathing spell became the Water Breathing effect; swimming speed equal to walking speed became full water movement efficiency; the DC 18 Wisdom save became a coin toss; 3d6+2 psychic damage became 3 to 12 mental damage scaled to hit points, with Tensura fear and a magicule bleed on a failed resist; 8 hours became 10 minutes; 'attunement by a warlock' became plain attunement.
item.nusmp.pendant_of_the_dreamer.desc: Six charges that return at midnight: breathe water, grow gills and webbing, or reach into a creature's mind.
item.nusmp.beast_masters_amulet.card:
Rare Grade necklace. Requires attunement. A grey disc with a square hole, animals pressed round it.
The amulet stores creatures safely for any length of time: while inside they need no food or water and do not age. It holds 10 points. A creature takes 1 point if its maximum health is 8 or less, 2 up to 16, 5 up to 40 and 10 up to 80; mightier creatures do not fit.
Store Creature (2 s cooldown). Draws the creature under your crosshair, within 6 blocks, into the amulet. Your own tamed creatures go in freely; any other must first be wounded to half its health or less; other people's pets never go in. Stored creatures keep everything about them: name, owner, armour, health.
Release Creature (2 s cooldown). The last creature stored steps out in front of you with the health it had.
Tabletop rules replaced: the challenge rating ladder (ten, five, two, one creatures) became the 10 point ladder by maximum health; 'a willing creature' became your own tamed creatures; the DC 14 Wisdom check of an unwilling one became 'wounded to half health first'.
item.nusmp.beast_masters_amulet.desc: Holds up to ten points of creatures safely: your tamed beasts freely, wild ones once wounded to half health.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_warmage.card:
Rare Grade necklace. Requires attunement.
Arcane Awareness. Raw magic is turned aside: half of all magic, indirect-magic and sonic-blast damage (the nearest thing to Force damage) never reaches you. In Tensura's terms your magicule well is 8% deeper, your magicule stream 10% faster, your spells cost 5% less, you gain +0.1 magic resistance, and Magic Sense is lent to you for as long as you wear it.
Extra Tricks. The amulet holds four charges, shared by four cantrips from the Wizard's list; each cast spends one (a cantrip that finds no foe spends none): Fire Bolt (a bolt at the foe in your sights, 24 blocks: 4 fire damage and it burns for 3 seconds), Ray of Frost (3 cold damage and a slow, 24 blocks), Shocking Grasp (touch range: 4 lightning damage and a moment of slowness, so it cannot act in reply), Acid Splash (3 acid damage to a foe and to one more creature next to it, 16 blocks). Cantrips grow with you: +1 damage for every 10 experience levels, up to +2, and never more than 6 to one target. 1d4 charges come back when a new day begins (never above four).
Replaced from the tabletop: the +3 bonus in Arcana (a skill check) became the Tensura magic stats and Magic Sense; resistance to Force damage became 50% off the three magic damage types; the Wizard's cantrip list became these four; the long rest became the new day.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_warmage.desc: A war-mage's amulet: it turns raw magic aside and deepens your magicule well. It holds four cantrip charges (Fire Bolt, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp, Acid Splash); 1d4 come back each dawn.
item.nusmp.hemlocks_amulet.card:
Legend Grade necklace. Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn's Metal Vessel.
Found within the ancient mass grave by Urien Hemlock after he dug his way out, this amulet hides the true form of its wearer. Half of all wither damage is turned aside while it is worn.
Wear the Mask of the Living (3% mana, 10 s cooldown). For 5 minutes you look like a living man to the dead: undead creatures cannot take you as their target and let go of you if they have; Glowing and other detecting effects cannot be put on you; your presence is concealed in Tensura's terms (+0.5 presence concealment, and the Presence Concealment skill is lent to you while the mask lasts). Let the Mask Fall takes it off early.
Awakened. The amulet drinks energy: 2 for every undead you slay (12 for a boss), and 1 from a spell that strikes you (one sip every 5 seconds). At 60 it is Awakened: +4 maximum health, +2 armour toughness, +25% spiritual health, and the mask lasts 8 minutes.
Exalted. At 240 it is Exalted and grows into the form it was made for, the Reliquary of your soul: +8 maximum health, +4 toughness, +50% spiritual health, a 10-minute mask, and once per game day a blow that would kill you is turned aside and leaves you at 40% health with Resistance IV for 6 seconds; then your soul-torn body is weak for 90 seconds and slow for 30. (Not against /kill or the void.) The energy is kept in the amulet.
Replaced from the tabletop: 'appears as a normal human male' and 'advantage on saving throws against divination magic' became the mask, its undead-proofing, Glowing immunity and Tensura's presence concealment; 'Awakened: holds new enchantments' became the Awakened bonuses; 'absorbs the soul of the wearer, becoming its Reliquary' became the Exalted rescue and the spiritual health.
item.nusmp.hemlocks_amulet.desc: It hides your true form behind a living man's face: the dead cannot find you. It drinks the dead's energy and grows Awakened, then Exalted: the Reliquary of your soul.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_safeguarding.card:
Unique Grade necklace. Requires attunement.
Meditate on the Record (10 s cooldown). Once each month (once per eight-day lunar cycle), on the night of the full moon, sit still for 30 seconds: you may not wander more than 1.6 blocks, be hurt, or let the night end. The amulet then holds a complete record of you as you are: body, hunger, experience, your magicules and aura (existence) and the list of what you carry.
If a blow would kill you (it does not save you from /kill), the amulet breaks in a brilliant flash and you are restored to the record: you go back to the place where you sat; your health is whatever the record held or half your maximum, whichever is more; your hunger, experience, magicules and aura are no lower than the record's; every effect on you ends. Whatever you carry that the record did not hold stays where you fell (relics always stay with you); the record never makes an item, so it can never copy one. The amulet cracks, and mends after two more full moons.
Replaced from the tabletop: the hour became 30 seconds; the month became the lunar cycle; 'items the amulet had no record of disappear' became 'stay where you fell' (nothing in this mod is ever destroyed, and relics must stay unique); the amulet does not vanish when it breaks, it mends; the memories became the Tensura existence points.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_safeguarding.desc: Under the full moon, sit still for thirty seconds and the amulet records you. If a killing blow lands, it breaks and puts you back as you were.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_huntress.card:
Rare Grade necklace. Requires attunement.
Predator's Stealth. You creep 50% faster while sneaking; creatures more than 8 blocks away cannot take a sneaking you as their target, and those that already have lose you; your presence is dimmed to Tensura's senses (+0.3 presence concealment, and the Presence Concealment skill is lent to you while you stalk).
Weapons of Choice. +1 damage with swords, axes, tridents and arrows. The bonus doubles to +2 if you fight with claws and teeth: a beastfolk, vampire or lizard-and-dragon-kin race or blood (and bare-handed blows count too). A sneaking blow on a creature that has not noticed you adds +2 more (the pounce).
Replaced from the tabletop: '+3 on Stealth checks' became the creeping speed, the 8-block rule and Tensura's concealment; 'shape-changed into an animal, or claws and teeth' became the race-and-blood test (this mod has no shape-change to test).
item.nusmp.amulet_of_the_huntress.desc: A predator's stealth and a hunter's edge: you creep faster and are not noticed beyond eight blocks while sneaking. +1 damage with blades, axes, tridents and arrows, doubled for claws and teeth.
item.nusmp.the_amulet_of_lost_souls.card:
Legend Grade necklace. Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn's Metal Vessel.
The amulet has 8 souls within. You call on one at a time; the souls' three spells cost 1, 2 and 3 charges (Soul Spell I, II, III). It has 10 charges and regains 1d10 when a new day begins. Commune with the Souls turns to the next soul still in the amulet (the first turn of a day is free; each later one costs a charge). If you spend the amulet's last charge, roll a d20: on a 1 the soul in use is freed, you thank it, and its spells are gone for good; when the last soul is freed the ruby shatters and the amulet is no longer magical. A spell that finds no target spends nothing. No spell does more than 6 damage to a single creature.
Comos Parolath, male triton: Witch Bolt (5 lightning, slows), Misty Step (a short blink; Danger Sense is lent for 10 s), Lightning Bolt (a line of up to 6 foes, 6 lightning each, slowed).
Helbi Finemane, female gnome: Healing Word (heal 6, and your pets), Lesser Restoration (cures harmful effects; Poison Resistance lent for a minute), Spirit Guardians (12 s: foes within 5 blocks take 1 and are slowed every 2 s; Physical Attack Resistance lent).
Hurod, male half-orc: Thunderwave (5 blocks round you, 3 damage and thrown back), Shatter (a sonic burst where you look: 5 damage, weakness), Thunder Step (a blink of 12 blocks; thunder where you left: 6 damage and a shove).
Ilia, female yuan-ti: Ray of Sickness (2 damage and poison), Dragon's Breath (poison breath: a 6-block cone, 2.5 damage and poison), Aura of Vitality (heal 4 and Regeneration II for 15 s; Self Regeneration lent if Tensura has it).
Klaroven of the Torch, male elf: Inflict Wounds (touch: 6 necrotic), Ray of Enfeeblement (Weakness II and slow), Vampiric Touch (touch: 6 necrotic, and you heal 6).
Mantra Tarlem, female tiefling: Burning Hands (a 4.5-block cone, 4 fire, burning), Scorching Ray (three bolts of 2 shared among the foes you face), Fireball (4 blocks across, 6 fire, burning; only a show, no block is ever touched).
Prammac Caerkul, female dragonborn: Tasha's Caustic Brew (a narrow 10-block line, 2 acid and poison), Melf's Acid Arrow (2.5 and lingering poison), Vitriolic Sphere (3.5 blocks across, 5 acid, Weakness II).
Vagan Nightfist, male goliath, cold only: Ice Knife (4 cold, slows), Snilloc's Snowball Swarm (3 blocks across, 5 cold, slows), Spirit Shroud (30 s: each of your melee hits adds 2 cold damage and a slow). The card's last line is unclear ('[?]'); the three spells are read as 1, 2 and 3 charges.
Replaced from the tabletop: the long rest became the new day; spell slots became charges; 'choose a soul at the end of a long rest' became Commune with the Souls; spell effects became the nearest Minecraft or Tensura effect (above), each capped to the PvP limit.
item.nusmp.the_amulet_of_lost_souls.desc: Eight souls are bound in it, each with three spells. Call on one at a time; ten charges, 1d10 back each dawn. Spend the last charge and the soul in use may break free for good.
item.nusmp.lovelorn_locket.card:
Special Grade necklace. Requires attunement.
This locket received a blessing from the Grand Inquisition; the King commissioned them for the whole kingdom when he lost his brother in the war.
Villagers deal fairly with its wearer: the Hero of the Village effect is kept up while it is worn (better trade prices).
Billet for the Night (once a game day). Beside an old soldier within 24 blocks (a weaponsmith, an armourer, a toolsmith, or an iron golem) you are given a bed for the night: your respawn point is set here (no bed needed), you recover half your health, you are fed, and you feel Regeneration II for 20 seconds. If there is no old soldier near, nothing is used up.
Replaced from the tabletop: 'advantage on Persuasion rolls with those of your own gender' became the Hero of the Village effect (a roll that does not exist became a price that does); 'any former soldier is willing to house you for the night' became the billet; the locket turning gold on a reunion is only flavour here.
item.nusmp.lovelorn_locket.desc: Villagers deal fairly with its wearer. Once a day, beside an old soldier (a weaponsmith, armourer, toolsmith or iron golem), you are billeted for the night: fed, healed, and your return spot is set.
item.nusmp.amulet_of_dragon_rage.card:
Legend Grade necklace. Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn's Metal Vessel.
A sinister cult tried to make copies of this amulet. Ultimately, they gave up as each attempt decreased their membership by one soul. Thirty percent of any cold that reaches you is turned aside, even in your own shape.
Speak the Command Word (3% of your magicules and aura, once per game day). You become an Adult Silver Dragon for 2 minutes: +8 armour, +4 toughness, +5 attack damage, +25% speed, near-immunity to being knocked back, step height and falls that do not hurt, wings (you fly like a creative player), a dragon's pool of 40 hit points (golden hearts) that is spent first, a body 30% larger (Tensura's size stats), +0.3 magic resistance, and the Physical Attack Resistance, Danger Sense and Magic Sense skills lent as one merged form. Cold and falls do nothing to you.
Silver Frost Breath (8 s cooldown). A 9-block cone of cold: 6 damage to up to 8 foes, a deep slow and a freeze.
Speak the Word Again returns you to your own shape, and so does the end of the two minutes. When a blow breaks the pool, the form ends. What is left of the blow after the pool is the remaining damage: if it is more than the dragon's whole pool (40) you die; if it would take you to 0 HP you are left unconscious instead (1 HP, stunned); otherwise you simply take it and fall back out of the form reeling.
Replaced from the tabletop: the Monster Manual statistics became the modifiers above (your mind is yours: nothing mental changes); 'one hour' became 2 minutes; 'cannot use again for 24 hours' became once per game day; 'hit points are the lesser of current and new maximum' became the pool (you are not healed by transforming); 'unconscious and unstable' became 1 HP and stunned; the Minecraft model is not swapped (the body grows through Tensura's size stats and glitters with particles).
item.nusmp.amulet_of_dragon_rage.desc: Speak the command word and become an Adult Silver Dragon for two minutes, once a day: wings, scales, a bite, a pool of dragon hit points and a breath of frost. Break the pool and the form breaks.
item.nusmp.skycrystal_armor.desc: Giant-forged crystal plate with ten charges that regrow at dawn. It drinks spells aimed at you, casts Absorb Elements, Shield, Globe of Invulnerability and Invulnerability, and holds time at bay.
item.nusmp.skycrystal_armor.card:
Forged by legendary giant blacksmiths in ages past and infused with the unending magic of creation, this armour gives mortals a glimpse of true immortality. Requires attunement. Heavy: movement -4%, knockback resistance +10%, +2 hearts. Tensura skills kept while worn: Magic Resistance, Abnormal Condition Resistance (the old 'advantage on saves against spells and magical effects') and Self-Regeneration (Timelessness). Also: magic damage is cut by a quarter, and 30% of harmful magical effects are turned away.
Charges: 10, and 1d8+2 come back at every dawn. Spending the last one rolls a d10: on a 10 the armour regains 1d4+1 at once.
Spell Absorption (automatic): a spell that would hit you (magic damage) is cancelled and fills the armour with 1 to 4 charges by its strength, once every 5 seconds, while the armour is not full.
Absorb Elements (1 charge): 15 s fire ward, 12 s Resistance I and Strength I, and four Tensura resistances (flame, cold, electricity, water) merged into one cast.
Shield (1 charge): three hearts of force for 8 s, and Tensura's Multilayer Barrier lent for 10 s.
Globe of Invulnerability (6 charges, 1% existence): for 10 s no spell can hurt you or your allies within 5 blocks of where you stood; Magic Nullification and Magic Jamming are lent to you for the duration.
Invulnerability (9 charges, 3% existence): 5 s of Resistance V and Tensura's physical and magic nullification and pain nullification.
Timelessness: poison, wither, hunger and Tensura's infections lose half their remaining time every 5 seconds (the old 'you stop aging').
Replaced: Requires STR 15 and Stealth disadvantage are gone (the weight is the movement penalty). Spell save DC and spellcasting ability do not exist: the spells use the charges and your existence.
item.nusmp.slime_armour.desc: A cuirass that constantly seeps slime: blades slide off it, hammers do not, and no grip or web holds you. Three times a day it melts you into a small, soft slime for a minute.
item.nusmp.slime_armour.card:
+2 armour (it is a cuirass of 7 armour points). Your armour constantly secretes a thin layer of slime.
Slashing resistance: melee blows with swords and axes do 35% less. Vulnerable to bludgeoning: maces, picks, shovels, hoes and hard landings do 30% more.
Slips every grip: webs, earth locks, movement interference, and crushing slowness (Slowness IV and up) never take hold; Tensura's Paralysis Resistance is kept while worn (the old 'advantage on saves against being grappled').
Slime Form (3 a day, 100 ticks apart): for 60 s you and your gear become small soft slime: 45% size (a one-block gap is wide enough), no fall damage, knockback resistance, and Tensura's physical attack, pierce and pain resistances. You cannot use items or cast (eating and drinking are allowed) and you cannot attack. Use the armour again to end it early. If you would be stuck in a wall when it ends, it holds up to 25 s more. It ends on death, relog, dimension change or taking the armour off.
Replaced: 'advantage when grappling' has no grapple in Minecraft; the knockback resistance and the three Tensura skills stand in. 'Move through a space 1 inch wide' became the 45% size.
item.nusmp.armor_of_the_defiant_dawn.des: Armour infused with the Eternal Light. Dawnlight shows what hides and lights the dark; when a hard blow lands, one of its three charges flashes a blinding, burning light around you.
item.nusmp.armor_of_the_defiant_dawn.car:
First worn by an adventurer who dared defy the god of night, this armour is infused with motes of the Eternal Light. Requires attunement.
Dawnlight (switch on or off): night vision, burns off Darkness, shows invisible creatures within 16 blocks (they glow), and lends Tensura's Magic Sense and All-Seeing Eye while it shines.
Luminous Retribution: 3 charges, 1d3 come back at dawn. When a blow of 4 or more lands on you from within 8 blocks (every 2 s at most), the armour flashes in a 6-block radius: foes within 3 blocks take 6 light damage and are blinded for 4 s; farther foes take half and are not blinded. The undead always fail the save, take half again on top (9) and holy damage. Tensura's flashed blindness is added. You can also set it off by hand (5% magicules).
Replaced: the DC 15 Constitution saving throw is distance from you; 4d8 became 6 (the PvP cap) and the 15-foot radius became 6 blocks.
item.nusmp.suit_of_the_astral_overseer.d: A light suit woven from the space between worlds: you fly, you never fall, the first two spells of the day pass through you, and crossing between worlds leaves no mark.
item.nusmp.suit_of_the_astral_overseer.c:
Requires attunement. Light armour (6 points). You never take fall damage; Tensura's gravity and spatial attack resistances are kept while worn.
Zero Gravity Movement (switch on or off): you fly at twice the walking-flight speed. Flight costs hunger (about as much as sprinting) and ends when you are starving or take the suit off; it never touches flight someone else gave you, and a soft landing is thrown in.
Into the Void: twice a day a spell that would hit you (magic damage) finds nothing to strike and is cancelled; you are charged with the void: Strength and Speed for 8 s and Tensura's Thought Acceleration (the old 'advantage on your next spell attack').
Traveler of the Universe: when you cross to another dimension, Nausea, Blindness, Darkness and Tensura's confusion and insanity are lifted from you and allies within 8 blocks, you get Regeneration and Resistance for a few seconds and Tensura's spatial and abnormal-condition resistances for 30 s.
Replaced: 'by a spellcaster' is not enforced; the opposing spell attack roll is the two daily wards; AC 12+modifier is the armour value.
item.nusmp.shadow_robes.desc: Robes that carry a supernatural chill: cold barely hurts you, sneaking in the dark hides you, and twice a day you step through the shadows, leaving a cloud of necrotic energy behind.
item.nusmp.shadow_robes.card:
Once worn by a ferocious bone claw. Requires attunement.
Frigid Darkness: freezing damage is halved, and Tensura's Cold Resistance and Darkness Attack Resistance are kept while worn.
Black Veil: while sneaking in dim light or darkness (light level 7 or less) you turn invisible and Tensura's Presence Concealment hides your trail.
Shadow Step (2 a day, short cooldown, only spent when it works): from dim light or darkness you step up to 12 blocks along your sight to another dim place with room to stand; Tensura's Shadow Motion is lent for 10 s. One hostile mob within 3 blocks that is hunting you is dragged along and slowed. A cloud of necrotic energy is left where you stood: for 3 s it pulses once a second (2 darkness damage and a short Wither each) on foes inside 2.5 blocks.
Replaced: 60 ft is 12 blocks; 'grappling' became 'a mob hunting you'; the Constitution save DC 14 and 5d12 became a telegraphed 3 x 2 damage cloud (6 total, the PvP cap).
item.nusmp.mistwalker_robe.desc: A hooded robe that exudes mist. Five charges (1d4+1 back at dawn) buy Misty Step, Levitate, Gaseous Form, Far Step and Wind Walk. Spending the last one may throw you off course.
item.nusmp.mistwalker_robe.card:
This garment slowly exudes a mysterious mist. Requires attunement. 5 charges, 1d4+1 back at dawn. Every cast wraps you in mist: two hearts of absorption for 8 s.
Misty Step (1): teleport up to 6 blocks along your sight to a safe place.
Levitate (1): drift upward for 2 s, then float down slowly for 30 s; Tensura's Gravity Flight for 30 s.
Gaseous Form (2): 8 s invisible, Resistance III, Speed, slow fall; Tensura's Wind Transform.
Far Step (4): teleport up to 14 blocks, Speed II 8 s, and Tensura's Spatial Motion for one minute (the old 'teleport again each turn for one minute').
Wind Walk (5): you and your allies within 8 blocks get Slow Falling, Speed II and Jump Boost II for 90 s; you also get Wind Manipulation and Gravity Flight.
Spending the last charge rolls a d20: on a 1 the mist slips: Blindness and Nausea and you are thrown a short way. (The tabletop robe teleports away and you lose attunement; here you never lose the robe.)
item.nusmp.nekets_practical_mage_robe.de: A tidy robe with two bottomless side pockets, straps that return what you drop in a fight, and up to five stored Mage Armors that it casts on you by itself when you are attacked.
item.nusmp.nekets_practical_mage_robe.ca:
A flowy yet practical robe. Requires attunement.
A Dress with Pockets: two side pockets, each a 27-slot bag, opened with Left Pocket and Right Pocket (they hold whatever you put in, kept on the robe).
Lost and Found: in a fight (you hit or were hit in the last 5 s), an item you throw away without sneaking is put straight back into your inventory. Tensura's Danger Sense is kept while worn (the old 'pickpockets have disadvantage'). The straps for carrying staves also steady your focus: +5% maximum magicules.
Unforgettable Armor: the robe stores up to 5 Mage Armors (one more at every dawn; Store Spell puts one in for 8% magicules; casting grimoire spells can fill it too once wired). Mage Armor (use by hand, or the robe does it by itself when a foe hits you and you have none): 8 minutes of +4 armour and Tensura's Multilayer Barrier for 3 minutes.
Replaced: 'mental command, no action' became the two pocket actions; 'sorcerer or wizard' is not enforced.
item.nusmp.armor_of_plot.desc: Overcome all odds. Blows have a way of missing you at the last second, more so the closer you are to the end, and three plot points a story keep you alive past a fatal blow. At zero, the story runs out.
item.nusmp.armor_of_plot.card:
The wearer can stave off death for as long as they wear the Armor of Plot. Requires attunement (or being likeable). Armour 9, toughness 4.
+4 to all saves: fire, explosion, projectile and lightning damage are cut by a fifth, and Tensura's Abnormal Condition Resistance is kept while worn.
Negates half damage on failed saves, and 'when hit, negates all damage... at the last second': any blow from a creature has a chance to miss entirely: 6% at full health rising to 33% at death's door (Tensura's Fate Change shows it). Never a guarantee.
Plot points: 3, one comes back at every dawn. A blow that would kill you is cancelled instead; you are left on a third of your health (at least 6), harmful effects are lifted and you get Resistance IV and Regeneration II for 5 s. (Void, /kill and the like still kill.)
The ending: at 0 plot points the armour is basic: no dodge, no save, and Luck -3 (the old '-3 to Wisdom') until a point returns at dawn. The armour's own armour value and resistances stay.
item.nusmp.zar_sancuis_plate_of_the_red_: Z'ar Sancuis - Plate of the Red Prophet
Heavy plate of a red prophet. Twice a day it shrugs off an effect that would have held you, or an ally's; each blow on a hostile foe heals you; allies fighting beside you hit harder.

Requires attunement. Heavy plate: armour 10, toughness 4, knockback resistance +20%, movement -3%; Tensura's Abnormal Condition Resistance is kept while worn.
Legendary Resistance (2 a day): a harmful effect that would take hold of you (lasting 2 s or more) is turned away instead; the rest of the same burst within 6 s is free. By hand, one use lifts every harmful effect from the nearest afflicted ally in sight within 18 blocks (and lends a player ally Tensura's Abnormal Condition Resistance for 30 s).
Healing through Vengeance: each blow that lands on a creature hostile to you heals 2 health (at most every half second).
Prophet's Guidance: a player or pet allied to you fighting within 6 blocks of you hits for +3 and gets Tensura's Ally Boost for 5 s, once every 3 s per wearer.
Replaced: 'twice per long rest' for Prophet's Guidance became a 3 s cooldown on a small bonus; the spell attack modifier is the flat +3; 'a creature hostile to you' is any monster, or a mob that is hunting you.
item.nusmp.skitchs_smuggling_coat.desc: A patchwork coat with fifty pockets in unlikely seams: a deep pocket of six rows and a seam pocket of three, both bigger on the inside, open at any time and wearable without attunement.
item.nusmp.skitchs_smuggling_coat.card:
This ratty looking coat is a boon to smugglers and thieves everywhere. Optional attunement: it works for anyone who wears it.
Deep Pockets: the two 64-cubic-foot extradimensional pockets became one 54-slot bag. Seam Pockets: the ten small and five medium pockets became one 27-slot bag. The other 33 pockets are plain cloth. Both are opened by hand at any time and keep their contents on the coat.
Replaced: the Investigation check to find an item and the action to withdraw it are gone: everything is one click away, for the wearer, attuned or not.
Rare Grade chest armour: 7 armour, 1 toughness. Requires attunement.
Stone Fast. Of all the hunger your actions cause, only half is kept, so you need half as much food. You also sleep half as much: half of the phantoms that would spawn near you do not.
Stone Stillness. Stand still and quiet (no moving, swinging, sprinting or being hurt) for 8 seconds and you enter a trance: mobs notice you from only a fifth of the usual distance, you see in the dark (Night Vision) and Tensura's Magic Sense is lent to you (the card's +5 to Insight, Investigation and Perception). Keep still for the card's full ten minutes and the trance deepens to a statue: mobs notice you from a tenth of the distance and you are Invisible with Presence Concealment. Any movement or noise breaks it.
Cursed. Your skin becomes tough and stony: Tensura's Physical Attack Resistance is lent to you and you have 15% knockback resistance, but you move 8% slower (the card's -2 Dexterity).
Tabletop rules became: eat and sleep half as much -> half hunger and half the phantoms; +5 Insight/Investigation/Perception -> Magic Sense and Night Vision; the stone skin -> Physical Attack Resistance.

Cracked grey stone plate: half the food, half the phantoms, and a stony skin (Physical Attack Resistance) that slows you. Stand still for 8 seconds and you fade into the stone (Magic Sense, mobs barely notice you); after ten minutes you are a statue.
item.nusmp.starstudded_leathers.card:
Unique Grade chest armour: 7 armour, 2 toughness. Requires attunement. Sneaking is much faster.
Emanate Starscape (3 uses per day, 10% mana, 10 s cooldown). A starscape of drifting stars surrounds you for 1 minute and moves with you: 5 blocks across, 7 blocks between dusk and dawn. Invisible creatures inside it are outlined (Glowing) and cannot hide, and the stars lend you Tensura's Magic Sense and Thought Communication while it lasts. Whoever hits you from inside the starscape takes radiant damage (5, or 3 if it is a player; it is also outlined).
Star Bolt (3% mana, 3 s cooldown). While your starscape lasts, hurl a bolt of starlight at the nearest foe in it: 5 magic damage and Glowing.
Stealth. Mobs see you from three quarters of the usual distance, and from about half while sneaking (the card's +5 Stealth).
Tabletop rules became: 3 charges that return at dusk -> 3 uses per Minecraft day; the Dexterity saving throw (2d12 radiant, half on a save) -> a fixed hit well under 30% of a player's health. The card image is cut off where it describes one more bonus-action effect of the starscape ('send ...'): it is played as the Star Bolt (starlight) and as Thought Communication (a message sent to those you know).
item.nusmp.starstudded_leathers.desc: Star-studded night leather: stealthier and quicker when sneaking. Three times a day it unfolds a starscape that scorches whoever hits you, outlines the invisible and lends Magic Sense and Thought Communication; inside it you can throw bolts of starlight.
item.nusmp.coat_of_the_duelist.card:
Legend Grade chest armour: 6 armour, 2 toughness. One of a kind (no attunement). Can be a Djinn's vessel. +8% movement speed, +10% attack speed. Tensura's Danger Sense is lent to you while you wear it.
Duelist's Footwork. While your off hand is empty (one weapon, or none) you take 22% less damage from melee blows. After landing a melee hit you gain Speed II for 2 seconds: the free step of the card.
En Garde (30 s cooldown, 5% mana, 0.5% EP). For 6 seconds the next melee blow against you is parried: it does no damage, the attacker is knocked back and takes 5 damage, and you gain Speed II for 4 seconds. Thought Acceleration and Danger Sense are lent for the stance.
Lunge (6 s cooldown, 3% mana). Dash 6 blocks forward through your foes; the first one ahead takes 5 damage and you gain Speed II for 3 seconds.
Tabletop rules became: doubling the Dexterity bonus to AC -> the 22% melee reduction and Danger Sense; the opportunity-attack move -> the Speed buff and the Lunge.
item.nusmp.coat_of_the_duelist.desc: A black tailcoat for a fencer: Danger Sense, far less melee damage with the off hand empty, and every hit you land sets you running. En Garde parries the next blow (with Thought Acceleration); Lunge carries you through a foe.
item.nusmp.suit_of_the_golden_shadow.car:
Legend Grade chest armour: 7 armour, 2 toughness. Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn's vessel. Sneaking is much faster and you move 5% faster. Tensura's Magic Sense is lent to you while you wear it.
A Rogue's training. The card is for Rogues: here the bar is a pool of 500 maximum aura (Tensura's physical energy). At 500 the suit works as written; with a tenth of that it works half as well (shorter Unseen, weaker stealth, smaller sneak attacks); with ten times that it works half as well again. It never locks you out.
Shadow Walker. Mobs see you from about 60% of the usual distance, and from about 42% while sneaking (at 500 aura). Magic Sense spots the hidden: invisible and hidden creatures within 12 blocks are outlined (Glowing).
Unseen (2 uses per day, 8% mana, 10 s cooldown). You turn invisible for 30 seconds at 500 aura (15 s to 45 s with training), with Presence Concealment and Shadow Motion lent. Attacking ends it.
Fade from View. Whenever you kill a creature you turn invisible, with Presence Concealment, for 5 seconds; attacking ends it.
Precise Assassination (sneak attack). A blow from Unseen or Fade from View, or against a mob that is not fighting you, deals extra damage: 40% of the blow, never less than 3 and never more than 8 (the 'reroll the 1' rule), scaled by your training. Players are only hit by the cloaked version.
Tabletop rules became: the Rogue requirement -> the aura gate; +5 Stealth and Perception advantage -> lower visibility, Magic Sense and outlining the hidden; twice per long rest -> twice per day; rerolling a 1 -> a minimum of 3.
item.nusmp.suit_of_the_golden_shadow.des: Black-gold assassin's suit for a trained Rogue (the bigger your aura pool, the deeper the shadow): Magic Sense spots the hidden, kills cloak you for 5 seconds and unaware targets take sneak-attack damage. Unseen makes you invisible, with Shadow Motion, twice a day.
item.nusmp.armor_of_the_lionheart.card:
Legend Grade chest armour: 10 armour, 3 toughness, +2 hearts, 20% knockback resistance. Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn's vessel. Heavy plate is noisy: mobs see you from 125% of the usual distance. Tensura's Abnormal Condition Resistance is lent to you while you wear it.
Leader of the Pride. You and your allies (pets, team mates, other players without a team) within 10 blocks cannot be frightened: Tensura's Fear is lifted from you every second and cannot be applied to you.
Bolstering Roar (1 use per day, 1% EP, 30 s cooldown). A Hero Haki battle cry: you and every ally within 10 blocks gain Strength I, Resistance I and Speed I for 30 seconds, allies who are players are lent Abnormal Condition Resistance for it (the card's advantage on the first saving throw), and you are lent Hero Haki.
Lion's Resolve (2 uses per day, 5% mana, 5 s cooldown). Your guard passes to the ally within 10 blocks who is hurt most: for 5 seconds they take 25% less damage and you take 25% more.
Tabletop rules became: advantage on saving throws, attack rolls and ability checks -> fear immunity, Abnormal Condition Resistance, the three buffs and Hero Haki; plus or minus 5 AC -> plus or minus 25% damage.
item.nusmp.armor_of_the_lionheart.desc: Silver plate under a lion's mane: Abnormal Condition Resistance, and you and allies within 10 blocks cannot be frightened. Once a day a Hero Haki battle cry strengthens every ally; twice a day Lion's Resolve moves your guard onto an ally.
item.nusmp.armor_of_the_beheaded.card:
Unique Grade chest armour: 9 armour, 2 toughness, 10% knockback resistance. Requires attunement.
Curse. The armour takes your head's worth of life: 1 heart less maximum health. In return there is no head for the flying axe: arrows and other shots do 15% less damage.
The Chosen One: Detach Head (20 s cooldown, 4% mana). Lift your head off for 45 seconds, or press again to put it back. Without a head you have magical senses: Night Vision, Tensura's Magic Sense and Water Breathing (you cannot drown), and you cannot be blinded, nauseated or darkened; shots do 40% less damage. You cannot eat or drink while it is off.
Dispel Magic (30 s cooldown, 6% mana). A Tensura-style dispel in 6 blocks: harmful effects wash off you; the beneficial effects of up to 8 foes are torn away and their skills and spells jammed for 6 seconds (2 on bosses); magic barriers and spells nearby are broken; Chant Annulment is lent for 10 seconds. As on the card, the dispel also darkens the magical senses of the headless: yours and any other Armor of the Beheaded nearby lose their Night Vision, Magic Sense and Water Breathing for 1 minute (the immunities stay).
Tabletop rules became: the Constitution save against beheading -> the curse falls on every wearer and every attuned wearer may detach the head; the senses of Arcane Eye and Magic Mouth -> Night Vision and Magic Sense; Dispel Magic disabling them for a minute -> the armour's own Dispel Magic art and its one-minute cost; +2 AC -> the armour value.
item.nusmp.armor_of_the_beheaded.desc: Headless plate with a chilling aura. Cursed: it takes a heart of your life, and in return no axe finds your head. Detach your head for 45 seconds for magical senses (night sight, Magic Sense, no drowning or blinding), but you cannot eat or drink; Dispel Magic strips magic from your foes and darkens those senses for a minute.
item.nusmp.false_dragon_armor.card:
Unique Grade chest armour (+2 plate): 9 armour, 3 toughness. Requires attunement.
Dragon's Heat. You take 60% less fire damage, and Tensura's Flame Attack Resistance and Heat Resistance are lent to you while you wear it.
Fiery Wings (1 use per day, 12% mana, 10 s cooldown). Wings of fire burst from your back: you can fly for 2 minutes and are immune to fire while they burn. When they burn out you glide down gently (Slow Falling) so the end is never a fall.
Tabletop rules became: fire resistance (half damage) -> 60% and two Tensura resistance skills; one hour of flight -> 2 minutes; once per day -> 1 use per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.false_dragon_armor.desc: Red steel plate with a dragon's eye in the chest: fire barely hurts you (Flame Attack and Heat Resistance). Once a day it burns out fiery wings that let you fly for 2 minutes.
item.nusmp.soul_armor.card:
Rare Grade chest armour: 7 armour, 1.5 toughness. Requires attunement. Heavy plate is noisy: mobs see you from 125% of the usual distance.
Soul Drinker. For every living creature (not undead) you kill while wearing it you gain 1 to 4 temporary hit points (absorption), stacking up to 8 (four hearts), and the escaping life energy returns 3% of your maximum magicules and aura. Blows use the temporary points first; they fade when you take the armour off, when you sleep, and a day after the last kill.
Special Attunement. The first creature you slay while wearing it wakes the armour: a bonus of 3 more temporary points and 10% of your maximum magicules and aura. (The normal attunement ritual still applies.)
Tabletop rules became: 1d4 temporary hit points stacking up to twice the proficiency bonus -> a random 1 to 4 with a cap of 8; a long rest -> sleeping or a day; the escaping life energy -> magicules and aura; special attunement -> the awakening kill.
item.nusmp.soul_armor.desc: Headless white plate that drinks the life of what you kill: each kill adds 1 to 4 temporary hit points (up to 4 hearts, fading after a day, a rest or when the armour comes off) and returns some of your magicules and aura. Heavy plate is noisy.
item.nusmp.arcane_conduction_armor.card:
Rare Grade chest armour: 5 armour, 1 toughness. Requires attunement.
A spellcaster's pool. The card is for spellcasters: here the bar is a pool of 1,000 maximum magicules. Below it only Base Mode works (the circuits stay dark). At and above it every mode works and the suit adds your Intelligence modifier as damage reduction: 4% at 1,000, 8% at 10,000, 12% (the most) at 100,000.
Reconfigure (2 s cooldown). Cycles the suit through four modes, shown in a message:
Base Mode: you take 35% less force and magic damage; Tensura's Magic Resistance is lent to you.
Fortified Mode: you take 12% less of all damage and Physical Attack Resistance is lent to you, but you are slowed (Slowness II).
Stealth Mode: mobs see you from 65% of the usual distance (less while sneaking) and sneaking hides you with Presence Concealment (the Hide action). You cannot cast: your grimoire is sealed and Tensura silence (magic jamming) jams your skills and spells while the mode lasts.
Burst Mode: your force and magic damage is raised by 15% and Magic Aura is lent to you, but you take 10% more of all damage.
Tabletop rules became: AC 11 + Intelligence -> armour 5 and the Intelligence bonus above; +2 AC -> 12% less damage; halved speed -> Slowness II; Stealth added Intelligence and the Hide action -> visibility and Presence Concealment; no spells in Stealth Mode -> the grimoire seal and silence; +2 to spell attack -> 15% spell damage; -2 AC -> 10% more damage taken.
item.nusmp.arcane_conduction_armor.desc: A circuit-lined suit for a spellcaster (the bigger your magicule pool, the better it protects) that reconfigures into four modes: Base (resists force and magic), Fortified (tougher, slower), Stealth (hard to see, but your spells are sealed) and Burst (stronger spells, more fragile). Only Base works without a caster's pool.
item.nusmp.delphynes_cursed_armor.card:
Legend Grade chest armour: 11 armour, 4 toughness, 25% knockback resistance. Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn's vessel. Heavy plate is noisy: mobs see you from 125% of the usual distance.
Strength 15. The plate wants a strong existence: 3,000 maximum EP. Below it the plate drags (Slowness I); at it the Tail Sweep is as written, and the stronger you are, the harder the tail shoves (up to half as hard again at ten times that).
Dragon-Scale Ward. Tensura's Dragon Skin is lent to you while you wear it. You take 70% less damage from dragon breath and 25% less from any dragon (ender dragon, Tensura dragons, drakes).
Unbowed. The frightful presence of dragons has no hold on you: Abnormal Condition Resistance is lent to you, and Tensura's Fear is lifted from you every second and cannot be applied to you.
Draconic Tongue. You speak Draconic and grasp the basic meaning of all languages: Thought Communication is lent to you and villagers understand you, so you carry the Hero of the Village effect while worn.
Tail Sweep (8 s cooldown, 5% mana). The dragon tail of the armour lashes all foes within 4 blocks: 4 damage, Slowness II for 3 seconds and a shove away from you. (An addition drawn from the card's art.)
Tabletop rules became: AC 18 and the +3 bonus -> the armour value; the Strength 15 requirement -> the EP gate; resistance to dragon breath and immunity to frightful presence -> the ward and Unbowed; speak Draconic and comprehend all languages -> Thought Communication and Hero of the Village; stealth disadvantage -> visibility x1.25.
item.nusmp.delphynes_cursed_armor.desc: Dark dragon-scale plate (Dragon Skin): dragons hit you far less, breath is mostly shrugged off, nothing can frighten you, and you understand every tongue. It is heavy and noisy and drags a wearer under 3,000 EP; the tail sweeps foes away.
item.nusmp.dark_rukh_shard.desc2: Stronger, black and gold. It eats you.
item.nusmp.charter_grimoire_devil_avatar: Charter Grimoire of the Devil Avatar
item.nusmp.charter_grimoire_charybdis_sp: Charter Grimoire of the Charybdis Spawn
item.nusmp.dante_gravity_crown.desc: The gold crown of the Spade King's heir, heavy with Lucifero's gravity: you fall slowly, jump high and shrug off gravity attacks. Weight of the Crown opens a well that drags, slows and finally crushes foes within 8 blocks; Lift lends you gravity flight for 7 seconds.
item.nusmp.dante_gravity_crown.card: Taken from the brow of Dante Zogratis, whose devil Lucifero bends weight itself. Worn, the crown thins gravity round its bearer (a lower gravity attribute, a higher jump, a longer safe fall, half the damage of a fall, and Tensura's Gravity Attack Resistance while it is worn and attuned). Weight of the Crown (3% magicules, 20 s): a gravity well at your feet for 4 seconds; foes within 8 blocks are dragged inwards, slowed (Slowness I to III, deeper towards the heart), forced down, and crushed once for a few hit points as the well closes; Tensura's Gravity Field is lent for the same time. Lift (4%, 30 s): Tensura's Gravity Flight lent for 7 seconds with a slow fall and a high jump. Dante drops it rarely when a player kills him, and only if the world has no copy.
item.nusmp.zenon_spatial_ring.desc: A silver band with a slit of Beelzebub's rift in it: Spatial Attack Resistance. Rift Step blinks you up to 10 blocks where you look; Twin Gates opens two linked portals for 15 seconds that you and your pets walk through.
item.nusmp.zenon_spatial_ring.card: Worn by Zenon Zogratis, whose devil Beelzebub folds space. While worn and attuned it lends Tensura's Spatial Attack Resistance. Rift Step (2% magicules, 5 s): a short blink to a safe spot where you look, 10 blocks if there is room, then 6, then 3 (Tensura's Spatial Motion is lent for the moment). Twin Gates (5%, 30 s): two linked gates open for 15 seconds, one 2.5 blocks ahead and one up to 12 blocks away on safe ground with a clear line; you and your tamed pets step into either and come out of the other (a half second of re-entry delay). Only one pair per player. Zenon drops it rarely when a player kills him, and only if the world has no copy.
item.nusmp.artifact_mimic.desc: A living belt that is a mimic chest: its latch hides teeth and a long tongue. Bite opens its jaws, then lunges at the foe in front of you (up to 4 blocks); Hoard opens the 27-slot pocket in its belly. Treasure finds the wearer: +1 luck.
item.nusmp.artifact_mimic.card: A belt that was a chest that was a monster. Bite (3% magicules, 8 s): the jaws open for 0.6 seconds (the telegraph), then snap shut and lunge at the nearest foe within 4 blocks in front of you for 6 damage (capped for players), slowing it and returning a little life. Hoard (2 s): opens the Mimic's 27-slot pocket, a chest menu saved on the belt itself; the pocket closes when the belt comes off. While worn and attuned: +1 luck.
tooltip.nusmp.relic.bow_acts: Draw to shoot. Sneak and use for its ability.
tooltip.nusmp.relic.crossbow_acts: Load and shoot as usual. Sneak and use for its ability.
item.nusmp.krakeblade.desc: A cleaver-slab of barnacle and coral with a tentacle round its guard. Near water it glows blue-green and bites 20% harder; you swim like a dolphin and breathe underwater. Once a day, a Wall of Water.
item.nusmp.krakeblade.card:
Unique Grade greatsword (11 damage, slow). Requires attunement.
A massive sword wielded fluidly despite its size, much like the kraken itself, and drawing its power from the kraken's domain.
Domain of the Kraken. In water or rain, or with a pool within four blocks (the card's 15 feet), the blade glows blue-green; the wielder's blows land 20% harder, and a blow struck while swimming wraps the target in tentacles (Slowness).
Swimmer. While held: Water Breathing, Dolphin's Grace and the full swimming speed (the card's 30 ft swim speed), more air, and the Tensura skill Water Breathing lent.
Wall of Water (once a day, 3% magicules, long cooldown). Raise a wall of water four blocks ahead, nine blocks wide and four high, for eight seconds: foes in it are shoved back and slowed, missiles that enter it are swallowed.
Tabletop became: 'swim speed 30 ft' = Dolphin's Grace and water movement efficiency; 'cast Wall of Water' = a timed wall that pushes foes and catches projectiles, uses per day = once per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.unicorn_dagger.desc: A dagger cut from a unicorn's horn. Poke an ally three times a day: 1 harmless damage and a random d8 buff. A plain dagger against enemies.
item.nusmp.unicorn_dagger.card:
Rare Grade dagger (fast). No attunement.
This unique dagger is crafted from a unicorn horn. Three times a day, poke an ally with it (use): it deals 1 damage to them (never enough to kill) and gives them a random d8 buff for 30 to 90 seconds: 1 Strength, 2 Speed, 3 Regeneration, 4 Resistance, 5 Jump Boost II, 6 Haste II, 7 Absorption II, 8 Magicule Regeneration (Tensura; Luck where Tensura is absent). With no ally in reach the horn pokes you instead, so the use is never wasted. Against enemies it is a normal dagger. Luck +1 while held.
Tabletop became: 'random d8' = a table of eight real effects rolled with the game's random; 'ally' = anyone you could not harm (pets, team mates, players where PvP is off, peaceful animals).
item.nusmp.rune_splitter.desc: A dwarven cleric's sun axe, strapped with light. Use it to shine (night sight for you, a glow on hostile creatures near you; the colour changes each time); sneak-use once a day to Dispel Magic.
item.nusmp.rune_splitter.card:
Unique Grade battleaxe (10 damage). Requires attunement.
Forged by a dwarven cleric of Pelor over a fire kindled by celestial light, engraved with golden carvings of the sun, with a strap that seems made of light.
Light (use, switch on and off). The axe sheds bright light: you gain night sight and every hostile creature within ten blocks glows (outlined) while it is on. Each time you light it the light changes colour (gold, amber, rose, violet, sky, mint). It goes out when you stop holding it.
Dispel Magic (sneak + use, once a day, 4% magicules). Choose a creature in your sights (or yourself if there is none): on a foe it strips the beneficial effects, on an ally or on you it lifts the afflictions. Level III or lower effects (amplifier 0 and 1) always end; stronger ones need a roll (60%), and infernal targets (devils, demons, daemons) are harder to strip (30%, the card's disadvantage). Light resistance (Tensura) while held.
Tabletop became: 'light cantrip' = night sight + a glow on hostiles; 'spell level / ability check DC' = effect amplifier and a percentage roll; 'disadvantage' = the lower chance.
item.nusmp.junglethorn_whip.desc: A thorny jungle vine. Climb trees at walking speed, swing from tree to tree, tear weapons from mobs' hands, lash a creature towards you; wild animals leave you be.
item.nusmp.junglethorn_whip.card:
Unique Grade whip (6 damage, long reach). Requires attunement.
Crafted by a wild druid who searched for enlightenment in primordial jungles.
Junglestride. Pressed against a tree, leaves, vines or bamboo you climb at walking speed (sneak to hold on). The whip also softens your falls and lengthens your reach.
Vine Swing (use). The whip catches a tree, vine or any solid anchor within 24 blocks and swings you towards it (a weaker swing on a bare block).
Thorny Disarm (sneak + use). The whip tears the weapon from the hand of the creature you point at and pulls it to your hand (or your feet if your bag is full). Players are only stung and weakened: nobody is disarmed in PvP.
Thorn Whip (worn-relic key, 1% magicules). A lash of thorns cuts a creature within ten blocks and pulls it up to five blocks towards you, poisoned for three seconds.
Lord of the Jungle. Wild animals do not choose you as a target unless you hurt them first (the card's Speak with Animals, primates only, widened to all animals).
