Tabletop became: 'advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics' = climbing and swinging simply work; 'disarm action' = an act that takes the weapon; 'Thorn Whip spell' = an act; 'Speak with Animals' = animals stay calm.
item.nusmp.needler.desc: A deep purple crossbow that ignores loading. Sneak-use for a Needle Volley: four needles in a fan, no strength added. Every bolt adds a little magic that finds the gap.
item.nusmp.needler.card:
Legend Grade crossbow, one of a kind. Can be a Djinn's Metal Vessel.
A deep purple crossbow with sleek engravings along the metalwork. It draws and shoots like a crossbow; sneak + use (or the worn-relic key) fires the volley instead.
Needle Volley (sneak + use, 1% existence points, cooldown six seconds). Four needles leave in a flat fan and each hits the first creature on its line within 40 blocks for a fixed 2.2 damage (no strength, no enchantment: 'no ability modifiers to damage'), without any ammunition, loading or draw.
Needles that find the gap. Every bolt you shoot from it adds 2 magic damage (the engravings pierce barriers).
Tensura: Farsight is lent while it is held. The loaded crossbow shows the needle on its rail.
Tabletop became: 'a number of attacks equal to the proficiency modifier' = four needles (a fan); 'ignores loading' = the volley needs no bolts and no draw; 'no ability modifiers' = a flat damage per needle.
item.nusmp.sidras_swearing_sword.desc: A sentient crystal shortsword that cannot stop swearing. After a hit the target saves or is insulted: 1d4 psychic damage and a moment of weakness. Barrage of Insults does it to everyone nearby.
item.nusmp.sidras_swearing_sword.card:
Rare Grade shortsword (+1). Requires attunement.
Loved by jerks and many bards, this sentient sword (clever as a rock, chatty as a bard, chaotic stupid) keeps swearing to demotivate his enemies.
Insults. After a hit, the target must pass a Wisdom save against DC 13 (a roll against its toughness, health and knockback resistance). If it fails it is insulted: the sword shouts a random, stupid insult naming the creature ('You rotting... ehrm... Ogre!') that everyone within 24 blocks reads, the target takes 1d4 psychic damage and is Weak for four seconds. At most once a second per target.
Barrage of Insults (use, 2% magicules, cooldown 20 seconds). The sword insults up to six foes within six blocks at once, each with its save.
Tabletop became: 'WIS saving throw DC 13' = the mod's save roll (a die plus the target's resilience against 13); 'chaotic alignment' = a flavour line only.
item.nusmp.stegosaurus_greatsword.desc: A +2 greatsword made of a stegosaurus's spine; speak the word and it clatters into a whip. It will not fight to the front: ahead it hits weakly, but it lashes back by itself at whatever stands behind you.
item.nusmp.stegosaurus_greatsword.card:
Rare Grade greatsword (+2, 9 damage, slow). No attunement.
Speaking the command word (use) makes the blade clatter apart into a +2 whip and back again. Whatever its form, you may only use it against creatures standing directly behind you, and then you flail it around in a cowardly, self-defensive fashion.
Cowardly Flail. Every 1.5 seconds the weapon lashes out on its own at the creature behind you (a rear arc of about 107 degrees): the greatsword reaches three blocks and one foe for 7 damage, the whip form five blocks and two foes for 5 damage each.
A blow struck at something in front of you does only 40% damage (the sword does not want to fight face to face).
Tabletop became: 'only attack creatures behind you' = the automatic rear lash at full strength and a heavy penalty on frontal blows; 'turns into a whip' = a toggle (longer reach, two foes).
item.nusmp.jade_xiphos.desc: A leaf-shaped blade of green glass, finely balanced. A heavy blast of force or thunder shatters it, and the shards fly into every foe beside you. Sing it to pieces on purpose by sneaking and holding use.
item.nusmp.jade_xiphos.card:
Special Grade shortsword (finesse, light, 5 damage, fast). No attunement.
Fine Balance. A +1 bonus to hit and damage (built into its damage and speed).
Ringing Note (use, cooldown ten seconds). Flick the blade: a high glassy note stings every foe within five blocks (sonic damage) and slows it for two seconds.
Shards of Glass. If one blow of explosion, lightning or sonic damage on you is 15 or more while you hold it, the blade violently vibrates itself into pieces: the sword is destroyed beyond repair and the shards fly into every foe within five blocks (6 to 20 piercing damage, most for those closest). You can do this on purpose with Shatter (sneak, hold use for three seconds): the card's bard singing a high note.
Tabletop became: '30 points of Force or Thunder' = 15 health points of explosion, lightning or sonic damage in one blow (scaled to 20 health); '6d10 piercing' = 6 to 20; 'Charisma (Performance) DC 25' = the deliberate three-second hold.
item.nusmp.returning_hand_axe.desc: A throwing axe that turns to water. Use it to hurl it at the first creature in sight; sneak-use within eight seconds to bring it back in a burst that cuts everything on the way home.
item.nusmp.returning_hand_axe.card:
Rare Grade hand axe (6 damage). No attunement.
Much like other mythical weapons that are thrown and return, this one turns into water and appears in a burst back in its owner's hand.
Hurl (use, cooldown two seconds). The axe flies at the first creature in sight within 18 blocks (6 thrown damage) and breaks into water on impact; it never leaves your hand for real, so you keep fighting with it.
Recall (sneak + use, within eight seconds of a throw). The water gathers where the axe landed and bursts back to your hand, cutting every foe on the line back (4 damage, slowed) up to eight of them.
Tensura: Water Attack Resistance while held.
Tabletop became: 'bonus action to return it' = a second act with its own cooldown; 'turns into water' = splash and bubbles; the axe is never actually removed from your hand, so it cannot be lost.
item.nusmp.dead_blade.desc: A glaive whose huge blade is a heap of glowing skulls. Long reach. Once a day, hold use and release for Finger of Death: a drain of 14 plus 12% of the target's health (a save halves it), and a humanoid it kills rises as your servant.
item.nusmp.dead_blade.card:
Rare Grade glaive (9 damage slashing, long reach). No attunement.
Finger of Death (once a day, hold use for 1.25 seconds then release; 2% existence points). The blade points at the creature in your sights within 24 blocks: a pink beam of skulls strikes it for 14 plus 12% of its maximum health (at most 60), halved if it passes a save against DC 16. Against another player the damage is capped (45% of their health). A person it kills (villager, illager, piglin, zombie, goblin, orc, lizardman, a skeleton, a witch) rises as a zombie that serves you for a minute.
Tensura: Darkness Attack Resistance while held. The long glaive reaches 1.5 blocks further.
Tabletop became: 'Finger of Death once per long rest' = once per Minecraft day; '7d8+30 necrotic' = a scaled drain with a save for half; 'kill and raise a zombie' = the zombie ally, with the telegraph of the held breath and the beam.
item.nusmp.wavebreaker.card: Forged of deep-sea iron, heated by volcanic vents and hardened in water from beyond the Material Plane. Requires attunement. A very rare longsword: +2 to hit and damage (a heavy, quick nodachi, 9 attack damage). While attuned you breathe under water (Water Breathing, plus Tensura's Water Breathing lent) and swim as fast as you walk (Dolphin's Grace while you are in water). Shape Water (sneak + use, at will, 2 s cooldown): point at still water and a 3 x 3 patch freezes into ice for 20 seconds, a path over the water; a burning bearer is doused. Mystic Reflection (use, once a Minecraft day, 6 percent of your magicules): a watery double stands beside you for one minute (a summoned water spirit where Tensura has one). It grants an extra reaction: once a second it turns a blow aside (-40 percent damage) and marks the attacker, so your next blow on them within 5 seconds lands 25 percent harder. While it stands your strikes carry 2 more damage of cold and a slow. Sheathe the blade (put it away) and the double is dismissed. Tabletop rules replaced: disadvantage on the attacker = -40 percent damage; advantage on your next attack = +25 percent damage; the clone's 1d6 cold = +2 damage and slowness; the clone's own action = the water spirit fights beside you; once per dawn = once per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.wavebreaker.desc: A long scaled blade forged in the deep sea. You breathe and swim as fast as you walk under water, and Shape Water freezes a patch of still water. Mystic Reflection raises a watery double for a minute that turns a blow aside each second and adds cold to your strikes (once a day).
item.nusmp.encircled_blade.card: A slim turquoise blade with a black sphere set in its guard. Twice a day (a Minecraft day, 5 percent of your magicules, 5 s cooldown) the Encircle spell shuts a sphere of shimmering force round the creature in your crosshair (20 blocks). A foe is held fast (Slowness X, Weakness III) for 10 seconds, 6 seconds for a player, only 2 seconds for a boss-sized creature (300 health or more); a visible sphere of light marks it. A friend or pet in the crosshair is sheltered instead (Resistance IV, held still) for 8 seconds. Tabletop rules replaced: Dexterity saving throw = foes cannot dodge it but size and boss health shorten it; one minute = 10 seconds (PvP-fair); large or smaller = any creature, shortened by boss health; an object = not enclosed (no world blocks are touched); twice daily = twice per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.encircled_blade.desc: A slim turquoise blade with a black sphere in its guard. Twice a day it shuts a sphere of shimmering force round the creature in sight: a foe is held fast, a friend is sheltered.
item.nusmp.windcutter.card: A gift of a primordial air elemental lord to the mortals who held the planar balance against fallen angels. Requires attunement. A legendary longsword: +3 (11 attack damage), the finesse property (quick strikes, +20 percent attack speed), unbreakable like every relic. Primordial Craftsmanship: light as a feather, never breaks; a fall costs you ten blocks less. Aerial Attunement: while attuned and held you can fly and hover at about walking speed (the flight ability, and Tensura's Flight lent); put the blade away and you float down on a Slow Falling cushion. You also resist wind attacks (Tensura). Control Winds (use, once a Minecraft day, 8 percent of your magicules, no concentration needed): a gust that hits every foe in a cone 12 blocks ahead for 3 damage and throws it back, and sends foreign missiles in the cone flying away; or, sneaking, an updraft that lifts you and your allies and pets within 6 blocks and gives them Slow Falling for 20 seconds. Tabletop rules replaced: spell save DC 20 = knockback and missile deflection; control winds modes = gust or updraft; cannot be cast again until dawn = once per Minecraft day; flying speed equals walking speed = the plain flight ability.
item.nusmp.windcutter.desc: A feather-light silver blade with winged guards, a gift of an air elemental lord. Its bearer can fly and hover, and falls softly. Control Winds, once a day, is a gust that throws foes and missiles back, or, sneaking, an updraft that lifts you and your allies.
item.nusmp.tripolar_sword.card: A sword abandoned by its owner for a better one; the betrayal tainted its magic forever. Legendary. +2 to hit and damage (10 attack damage). The sword rolls a d6 at the start of each Minecraft day, the first time you hold it: on a 1 or 2 it lashes out at you (1d10 damage, never enough to kill you) and your blows are clumsy for the day (-40 percent damage); on a 3 or 4 it is a plain sword; on a 5 or 6 it strikes hard for the day (+60 percent damage). The roll is kept on the sword until the next dawn, so putting it away does not re-roll it. Tabletop rules replaced: advantage / disadvantage on attack rolls = +60 percent / -40 percent outgoing damage; doubled damage rolls = folded into the +60 percent (PvP-safe); start of each day = the first time it is held each day; 1d10 damage = the same, capped so it cannot kill.
item.nusmp.tripolar_sword.desc: A marbled blade with a four-pointed star guard, abandoned by its owner and bitter for it. Each dawn it rolls a die: it lashes out at you and is clumsy all day, behaves as a plain sword, or strikes far harder.
item.nusmp.the_dagger_of_many_daggers.ca: A leaf-bladed dagger with a gold ring; spun, it pulls copies of itself out of the throws that might have been. Requires attunement. A +1 magical dagger that acts as normal when used in melee (5 attack damage, quick). Temporal Loop (use, 4 percent of your magicules, 30 second cooldown): the dagger is thrown and multiplies in the air: 2d4 copies (2 to 8), one every other tick, each dealing 2 damage to the foe in your crosshair (24 blocks); every fourth copy was destined to miss and falls short; against another player at most 3 copies land. Tabletop rules replaced: one charge regained after an hour = a 30 second cooldown; extra ranged attacks = the copies; copies that were destined to miss = every fourth copy; roll 2d4 = the same dice.
item.nusmp.the_dagger_of_many_daggers.de: A leaf-bladed dagger with a gold ring that pulls copies of itself out of the throws that might have been. Temporal Loop sends two to eight copies at the foe in sight (a fourth of them fall short).
item.nusmp.flamecutter.card: Crafted by a cruel deep dwarf king who bound a primordial fire elemental lord in its blade; the lord was freed by a young hero and reforged it as a gift. Requires attunement. A legendary longsword: +3 (11 attack damage), finesse (quicker strikes), eternally warm and unbreakable; every blow burns (+2 damage and 3 seconds of fire). Igneous Attunement: while attuned and held you are immune to fire (Fire Resistance, fire damage cut by 90 percent, Tensura's Flame Attack Nullification lent), and you can stand on and walk across molten rock as if it were solid ground (sneak to sink in). Wall of Fire (use, once a Minecraft day, 10 percent of your magicules, no concentration needed): a wall of flame 7 blocks wide and 3 high stands 4 blocks ahead for 8 seconds; foes inside burn (1 damage a half second, at most 6 from one wall, plus fire). Tabletop rules replaced: immune to fire damage = Fire Resistance + 90 percent fire reduction + Tensura nullification; walking on lava = standing on the lava's surface; wall of fire spell = the damaging wall; not until the next dawn = once per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.flamecutter.desc: A flame-shaped blade with a fire lord in it, warm to the touch. Its bearer is immune to fire, walks on lava, and every blow burns. Wall of Fire, once a day, stands a burning wall before you.
item.nusmp.heart_of_the_flame.card: A huge two-handed greatsword whose blade is a row of floating golden plates. Requires attunement. A heavy, slow greatsword (11 attack damage, you move a little slower). Speaking the command word 'Burn' (use, 2 percent of your magicules, 1 s cooldown) heats the blade: every hit then deals 4 extra damage of fire and sets the foe alight for 4 seconds. The heat lasts until you put the sword away (it cools within three seconds of being sheathed) or speak the word again. Tabletop rules replaced: 3d6 slashing = a heavy greatsword; extra 2d6 fire = +4 damage and fire; sheathe = putting it away from the hand.
item.nusmp.heart_of_the_flame.desc: A huge greatsword whose blade is a row of floating golden plates. Use speaks the command word: the blade heats and every hit burns, until you sheathe it or speak again.
item.nusmp.bianca.card: Crosshead's Mysterious Wonderwares, a marvel of dwarven craftsmanship: a heavy repeater crossbow with six ammo cylinders of three bolts each and a bayonet fixed to the front. A real crossbow (it loads and shoots like a vanilla one, Quick Charge counts). Her six cylinders hold 18 bolts. Reload Cylinders (sneak + use, 1 s cooldown): all six cylinders are filled at once from the arrows in your pack (free in creative). While at least three bolts are in the drum every shot is a volley of three bolts in a spread (the two extra bolts leave the drum; the arrow the crossbow took comes back to you); with fewer than three she fires one plain bolt. Volley bolts cannot be picked up again. The bayonet deals 1d6 piercing as a blow of the frame (5 attack damage). Tabletop rules replaced: a single action reloads all cylinders = one reload; three bolts in a single attack on the same roll = three bolts in one shot; targets = the spread.
item.nusmp.bianca.desc: A dwarven heavy repeater: six cylinders of three bolts feed a volley of three in every shot, and a bayonet is fixed to the front. Sneak + use reloads all cylinders from the arrows in your pack.
item.nusmp.sorrows_edge.card: A black crescent axe with a spirit in it that speaks to the one who chose it as a weapon. A heavy axe (10 attack damage) that deals 1d4 necrotic (+2.5 damage) on every hit. A chaotic spirit curses the wielder with a form of the Geas spell: each Minecraft day, the first time you hold it, a percentile die is rolled. At 50 or above you keep your sanity and nothing happens. Below 50 the spirit makes a demand for the day: Blood (kill something within five minutes or take 4 damage and long Weakness and Slowness) or a Fast (eat nothing until dawn; each meal makes you nauseous and hungry). The geas is lifted at the next dawn. Tabletop rules replaced: the DM chooses what the spirit demands = one of two demands chosen by the die; percentile roll = the same die; geas = the daily demand.
item.nusmp.sorrows_edge.desc: A crescent starry axe whose chaotic spirit speaks to its wielder. Each blow adds necrotic harm. Each day it rolls: at 50 or above you keep your sanity, below it the spirit makes a demand (blood or a fast).
item.nusmp.the_dragons_truth.card: Eight dragon-tooth daggers inside a belt of returning, 1d8 damage per dagger. A belt of eight daggers, drawn as a ring of teeth in hand. Throw a Tooth (use, 1.5 s cooldown): a dagger flies to the foe in your crosshair (20 blocks) for 4 damage, and a d8 draconic breath blasts through it for 5 more of that type: 1 acid (poison), 2 cold (slow, frost), 3 fire (burning), 4 lightning, 5 poison (strong), 6 necrotic (wither), 7 radiant (glowing, blinded), 8 thunder (knocked back). The belt returns the dagger. Extraction (sneak + use, once a Minecraft day, 6 percent of your magicules, 10 s cooldown): the creature in front of you (10 blocks) must answer: you learn its health, armour, effects and who it hunts, it glows for 10 seconds and Tensura's Analytical Appraisal is lent for 30 seconds; a creature of 250 health or more refuses. Tabletop rules replaced: 2d8 breath damage = 5 damage; DC 18 Intelligence save = the boss health gate; any question = a status report; once a day = once per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.the_dragons_truth.desc: Eight dragon-tooth daggers in a belt of returning. Use throws one at the foe in sight and a d8 draconic breath blasts through it; once a day, sneak + use makes the creature in front of you answer.
item.nusmp.giant_jawblade.card:
Rare Grade greatsword, two-handed and heavy: 9 damage, slow (0.9 attacks a second). Engravings: Crushing, Severance.
Charge. Right-click charges the Jawblade, up to three times (a charge lasts ten seconds after the last one). Each charge slows you for three seconds (Slowness III: about half your pace), as the card says you may only move at half speed while you charge it. The next blow is multiplied by (3 + charges) / 3: 33% harder at one charge, 67% at two, twice as hard at three (4d6, 5d6 and 6d6 against 3d6), shoves the foe back, and at three charges staggers it (Slowness II, two seconds). The charges are spent by the blow. Against another player the extra damage is held to 15% of their maximum health.
Replaced from the tabletop: the action and bonus action it needs to swing became the slow swing and the charge; the +1, +3 and +6 to hit and the advantage on the attack became the shove and the stagger (a blow that always lands, in a game with no to-hit roll).
item.nusmp.giant_jawblade.desc: A slab of jawbone, too heavy to swing quickly. Right-click to charge it up to three times (you move slowly while you do): the next blow hits 33, 67 or 100 percent harder and shoves the foe back.
item.nusmp.the_lumberjack.card:
Rare Grade battleaxe: 8 damage, 1 attack a second. Engravings: Severance, Sturdy.
Fell the Tree. Right-click a natural tree (logs with leaves that grew there; a log house or a single log will not do) within five blocks. Up to 96 connected logs are broken through the normal block-breaking rules, so claims and protection are respected (leaves are left to decay on their own); it does nothing in the Dungeon. The tree falls the way you face: every foe along its line (3.6 blocks wide, as long as the tree is tall) takes 7 bludgeoning damage and is slowed, and 3.5 more for every six blocks it stands from the stump (at most 24; against a player the core's 30% limit holds). Five seconds' cooldown.
Replaced from the tabletop: the attack roll against the tree (2 to 4 damage points per hundred feet) became simply felling the whole tree at once; the Dexterity save became a corridor you can step out of; the 2d6 and the extra 1d6 per twenty feet became 7 and 3.5 per six blocks.
item.nusmp.the_lumberjack.desc: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay." Right-click a natural tree to fell it the way you face; foes in the line of the falling trunk are crushed, harder the further from the stump.
item.nusmp.white_whip_of_welting.card:
Rare Grade towel (improvised whip): 4 damage, fast (2 attacks a second), +1.5 blocks of reach while held. Engravings: Swift, Breathing Support.
Snap the Towel. Right-click snaps the rolled towel at the foe in your sights, up to six blocks away: 4 bludgeoning damage. The towel is Wet for a minute after you stand in water or rain, and for two minutes after you sneak and use it beside water (Soak the Towel, within three blocks of any water). A wet towel also stings every blow and every snap: 2 more damage and Weakness for four seconds, the humiliation of the card.
Replaced from the tabletop: the 1d6 became 4; the Wisdom save against the humiliation was not rolled (a wet towel always stings, but only for 2 damage); wetting the towel became standing in or beside water.
item.nusmp.white_whip_of_welting.desc: A tightly wound towel with a long reach. Right-click snaps it at a foe; sneak and use it near water to soak it, and a wet towel stings, humiliates and weakens.
item.nusmp.whirling_blades.card:
Rare Grade, the right (hot, red) sword of a PAIR of whirling blades: 5 damage each, fast (2 attacks a second). Engravings: Severance, Swift. Pair: needs the other half. Hold one in the main hand and the other in the off hand: the off-hand sword adds a second blow of 60% of the first (own cooldown of 0.6 seconds), and the pair-only effects wake. One half alone keeps its abilities at a small penalty.
Twin edges. This blade's blows burn (three seconds on fire); the left blade's chill (Slowness and Tensura frost). With both in hand every swing carries the burn and then the chill.
Spin Attack. Right-click joins the swords' ends and spins: every foe within 3.5 blocks takes 6 piercing damage (85% of that with one blade) and is knocked back. Four seconds' cooldown, shared by both blades.
The two blades are two items that come together and exist once in a world.
Replaced from the tabletop: 1d6 for each sword became the 5 damage of one blade plus the off-hand blow; the bonus action became the right-click and its cooldown; the roll against everyone within 5 feet became a certain hit within 3.5 blocks (limited to 30% of a player's health by the core); the cold and hot blades are from the card's art.
item.nusmp.whirling_blades.desc: The hot, red-bladed one of two curved swords that come as a pair: its blows burn. With the cold one in your off hand a second blow follows with its chill. Right-click joins their ends in a spin attack that hits everything around you.
item.nusmp.warmages_longsword.card:
Unique Grade longsword, requires attunement (sneak and hold use for five seconds). 9 damage, 1.6 attacks a second, and +2 force damage on every blow. Engravings: Magic Weapon, Magic Interference, Barrier Piercing.
Battleworn and Knowledge of the Warmage. The +2 to attack became part of the 9 damage; the +2 in Arcana and History became Tensura's: Magic Sense lent to you while you hold the sword, and your magicule well 5% deeper.
Magic Missile. The sword holds five missiles a day (they all come back when a new day begins). Right-click fires one at the foe in your sights, up to 24 blocks: 1d4+1 force damage (2 to 5).
Arcane Barrage. Sneak and right-click fires every missile still in the sword at once, spread over up to three foes in front of you; each foe takes its missiles as one blow (limited to 30% of a player's health by the core). With no foe in your sights nothing is fired and nothing is spent.
Replaced from the tabletop: the attunement by a spellcaster is plain attunement; the action became the right-click and a half-second cooldown; the long rest became the new day.
item.nusmp.warmages_longsword.desc: A silver longsword set with five violet gems. +2 force on every blow, a keener sense of magic, and five Magic Missiles a day: right-click fires one, sneak and use fires every missile left.
item.nusmp.sword_crystal.card:
Rare Grade crystal short sword: 5 damage, 1.8 attacks a second, and half of all freezing damage held off while you carry it. Engravings: Elemental Boost, Stagnation.
Prick the Crystal. Right-click pricks your finger (1 damage if you can spare it) and spends one of the four charges: your arm becomes a crystal blade for a minute, with 273 crystal HP. While it lasts every blow is +2 damage and adds 3 cold, Tensura frost and a slow. Each blow wears the arm by 11 HP (about 25 blows); when it breaks, the shards bite you for 2d4 cold damage (never enough to kill: it leaves you at 1 HP at the least). Sneak and right-click lets it melt away early, with no backfire.
Moonlit recharge. While you hold the sword out of doors under the open sky at night, one charge comes back for each night (checked every five seconds), never above four.
Replaced from the tabletop: the +2 short sword became +2 damage while the arm is crystal; each activation consumes a charge as on the card; the long rest in the moonlight became one night out of doors.
item.nusmp.sword_crystal.desc: "Stay cool, Bird Boy." Right-click pricks your finger and encases the arm in crystal for a minute: 273 HP of icy blade that chills what it cuts. Four charges, one back each moonlit night. When it breaks you take 2d4 cold.
item.nusmp.the_stabshroom.card:
Rare Grade dagger: 5 damage, fast (2.4 attacks a second). Engravings: Ruination, Vitality. Poison Resistance is lent to you while you hold it.
Venom. Every blow adds 2.5 poison damage and a couple of seconds of Poison.
Natural 20 (a fully swung blow, one time in twenty): double damage, and the foe is Poisoned (a long Poison for twenty seconds) and Weakened.
Natural 1 (a fully swung blow, one time in twenty): the dagger bursts into spores. You and everyone within two blocks are poisoned for a moment and blinded for a second and a half.
Replaced from the tabletop: the +1 to attack and damage became part of the 5; the Constitution save against the spores was not rolled; a natural 1 or 20 is a d20 rolled on each full-strength swing (a half-swing does not roll); the hour of Poison became twenty seconds.
item.nusmp.the_stabshroom.desc: A fungal dagger that glows and poisons. Every blow adds poison; a natural 20 stabs twice as deep and leaves the foe poisoned and weakened, a natural 1 bursts the spores in everyone's face. Its wielder resists poison.
item.nusmp.twin_hook_swords.card:
Normal Grade, one of a PAIR of hook swords: 3.8 damage each, fast (2.4 attacks a second). Engravings: Swift, Sturdy. Pair: needs the other half. Hold one in the main hand and the other in the off hand: the off-hand sword adds a second blow of 60% of the first (own cooldown of 0.6 seconds), and the pair-only effects wake. One half alone keeps its abilities at a small penalty.
Sweep the Leg. Right-click hooks the nearest foe within 4.5 blocks in your sights: if it is tall and narrow (two legs) or flies, is no boss and has no more than 80 health, it takes 3.5 piercing damage, is dragged toward you and held fast for a second and a half, and is weakened for two seconds; against anything else it takes 2.5 and the hook slips (85% of that with one sword). Four seconds' cooldown, shared by both swords.
Off-hand hook. The second blow also snares the foe for a second.
Climber's Hook. Only with both swords in hand: pushed against a wall in the air, the hooks bite and you climb slowly (for up to four seconds until you touch the ground again); sneaking holds you still where you hang.
The two swords are two items that come together and exist once in a world: giving, looting or finding one gives both.
Replaced from the tabletop: the Athletics contest became a rule about the foe's build and size; the pull to prone became the drag and the hold; the advantage on the climb became the wall climb.
item.nusmp.twin_hook_swords.desc: The right sword of a pair of hook swords. Right-click sweeps the leg of a two-legged or winged foe and drags it off its feet. Hold the left sword in the off hand: a second blow follows each strike, and the hooks hold you to a wall so you can climb.
item.nusmp.bottle_blade.card:
Rare Grade bottle and water blade: 5 damage, 1.8 attacks a second; an empty bottle strikes at 40% of that. Engravings: Elemental Boost, Breathing Support.
Shake and Open. Right-click: a long stream shoots out and freezes: up to four foes in a narrow line in front of you, ten blocks, take 5 cold damage, Slowness II for three seconds and Tensura frost. The bottle is then empty; with nothing in the line nothing happens.
Control Water. Sneak and right-click. With an empty bottle and water at hand (you in water, rain, or a water source within six blocks in your sights) the bottle fills again. With a full bottle it throws a wave round you instead: every foe within five blocks is shoved back, slowed and takes 2 damage, and the bottle is empty, so the sword cannot be used until it is refilled, as the card says.
Replaced from the tabletop: the Control Water spell became the wave and the refill; the stream that freezes became cold damage with a slow.
item.nusmp.bottle_blade.desc: A green bottle with a blade of water. Right-click shakes it open: a long stream shoots out and freezes the foes in its line. Sneak and use it at water to refill, or, while full, to Control Water and throw a wave round you. An empty bottle is only a bottle.
item.nusmp.disintegration_dagger.card:
Rare Grade dagger: 5 damage, fast (2.4 attacks a second). Engravings: Ruination, Severance.
Disintegration. When a blow of the dagger kills a creature, ash rises from the body at once, and just over half a second later it blows apart: every foe within four blocks of it takes 6 fire damage (3 if more than two blocks away, the card's half damage for those who dodge) and burns for three seconds. It hurts no ally and no pet and breaks no block; the creature's drops are kept; only one such blast burns at a time. Only a fatal blow struck by hand counts.
Replaced from the tabletop: the end of the turn became twelve ticks; 6d4 fire became 6 or 3; the Dexterity save became distance from the body; "completely disintegrating" became the blast (the loot stays, so nothing is lost).
item.nusmp.disintegration_dagger.desc: A jagged black dagger. What it kills crumbles to ash, and a moment later the body blows apart, scorching the foes around it.
item.nusmp.dream_glass.card: +3 greatsword, heavy, two-handed, requires attunement. A transparent two-handed sword of blue stained glass with metallic decorations inside the blade; swung, it seems to fade in and out of existence. Ethereal Form (use, once per day, 40 tick cooldown): the blade turns ethereal for two minutes (an hour of the tabletop card, shortened): your blows ignore the armour a target wears, as if only its natural hide protected it. Magic armour, barriers, absorption and Tensura barriers still hold. Dream Draw (sneak + use, 10 s cooldown): the blade fades out of the world and back: you turn invisible for 1.5 s and your next blow within 6 s lands +4 damage from nowhere (this stands for 'summon the blade in your hand as a bonus action'). The tabletop +3 is the weapon's damage and the 'two-handed' rule is its slow, heavy swing.
item.nusmp.dream_glass.desc: A greatsword of blue stained glass that fades in and out of the world. Once a day its Ethereal Form lets blows pass through worn armour for two minutes; sneak + use draws it from nothing for a surprise blow.
item.nusmp.axe_of_the_crimson_saint.card: Battle axe, very rare, requires attunement. A cursed axe. Wielding it takes one heart from your maximum health (the curse). Each dawn it asks 'Quante mula sant vene ad sacrifico?' (how much are you willing to sacrifice?). Use: offer a heart of maximum health (up to four hearts, +1.5 damage each); offering a fifth time answers 'Nodol' (nothing: no bonus and no price) until it asks again. Sneak + hold use for two seconds: 'Todol' (everything): six more hearts are taken, never leaving you under three hearts in all, and the axe gains +9 damage and a one in four chance of a critical blow (+50% damage). The price is lifted the moment you stop holding the axe and at dawn the question comes again. The tabletop 'crit on 16 or higher' is the one in four chance; '+3 to attack and damage rolls' is folded into the +9.
item.nusmp.axe_of_the_crimson_saint.desc: A cursed battle axe: wielding it costs a heart of maximum health. Each dawn it asks how much you will sacrifice: use offers a heart for more damage, sneak + hold gives everything for a great blow and a one in four critical.
item.nusmp.palladion.card: Weapon (longsword), legendary, requires attunement by a creature of good alignment. Ancient and indestructible, forged to fight otherworldly foes. +3 to attack and damage is its high base damage. Against celestials, fiends, fey, elementals and the undead (the undead tag, Tensura daemons and spirits, blazes, ghasts, vexes, withers) each hit deals 6 extra holy force damage. Extraplanar Sentinel: it grants the Tensura skill Magic Sense while held, twinkles when such creatures are within 32 blocks (120 feet), and sneak + use outlines every one of them for five seconds. Banishing Strike: a critical hit on such a creature (the natural 20) banishes it for five seconds: slowed, weakened, blinded and paralysed (a boss-sized creature only staggers); once every 45 seconds. 'Begone!' (use, costs 8% mana, 30 s cooldown): every such creature within 7 blocks takes 4 damage and is banished; other foes are only driven back. Alignment: the blade was forged to serve the good: striking a villager, an iron golem or someone's pet dims it for five minutes (no bonuses).
item.nusmp.palladion.desc: An indestructible blade forged against otherworldly foes. It hits celestials, fiends, fey, elementals and the undead for extra holy force, senses them, and a critical blow can banish one. "Begone!" drives them back.
item.nusmp.dagger_of_betrayal.card: 1d8 necrotic damage, +1, 3d8 special damage; rare, requires attunement. 'Only those you trust can betray you.' A spiralling tri-bladed dagger with three red crystals. Looking into the victim's eyes (the victim faces you when you strike): +4 necrotic damage. Used on a creature that considers you an ally (a teammate, your pet or summon, a villager or an iron golem): +13 necrotic damage (at most 30% of a player's health). After such a betrayal there is a Constitution save, about even odds: on a failure you suffer Weakness and Mining Fatigue for eight seconds (disadvantage on your next two rolls).
item.nusmp.dagger_of_betrayal.desc: A spiralling tri-bladed dagger with three red crystals. It bites harder when the victim looks you in the eye, and far harder against one who trusts you, at the price of a sour conscience.
item.nusmp.humbling_longsword.card: Longsword, 1d8 slashing, versatile (1d10), requires attunement, +1. Held in two hands (an empty off-hand) it deals +1.5 damage. Humbling: a creature this blade has beaten down below 35% of its health (and that is not boss-sized) gives up the fight: it drops its target, cowers in Tensura's fear and is slowed and weakened for a few seconds. Demand Surrender (use, costs 3% mana, 15 s cooldown): every foe within 6 blocks that is at half health or less surrenders the same way. 'Advantage on Persuasion' became that surrender; the Arcana check to learn its properties became attunement, which shows them.
item.nusmp.humbling_longsword.desc: A plain steel longsword that humbles its foes: a creature it has beaten low gives up the fight. Held in two hands it cuts deeper. Use demands the surrender of every wounded foe near you.
item.nusmp.mountainguards_greataxe.card: Rare greataxe, heavy, two-handed, requires attunement, 1d12+2 slashing. Dwarven Forged: +2 to attack is its high base damage, and the wielder stands firm (knockback resistance). Last Line of Defense (use, once per day): the handle rings on the floor and a wave of gold energy ripples out: for one minute you and your allies (teammates, pets, summons) within 9 blocks cannot be frightened and every three seconds are given a temporary shield (absorption of about 10 health) that fades after four seconds; when the minute ends the shield is gone.
item.nusmp.mountainguards_greataxe.desc: A dwarven-forged double-bladed greataxe that stands its ground. Once a day, slamming its handle sends out a wave of gold: for a minute allies near you cannot be frightened and keep a shield.
item.nusmp.eschaton.card: Weapon (rapier), legendary, requires attunement by a bard, sorcerer or wizard. Forged from metal conductive to arcane energy. While attuned it is your spellcasting focus. The blade charges with the magicules you spend: a spell that costs 10% of your maximum magicules is worth about three charges (read from Tensura's magicule storage, so grimoire spells, Tensura skills and relic costs all count). The charges are lost at dawn (the long rest). 5 charges: arcane edge, +2.5 damage (the spellcasting modifier replaces Strength). 15: the blade splits into a whip: +3 blocks of reach and +1.5 damage. 30: it strikes twice, the second blow 0.3 s later at 60%. 50: +4.5 force damage. 75: every hit also casts a cantrip (a flame, a frost or a spark, rotating) with 'advantage' (the target glows) and 'disadvantage on its saves' (Tensura's magic interference). Read the Charge (use): shows the charge. Discharge (sneak + use, costs 4% mana, needs 15 charges): all charges are spent in a nova of force around you.
item.nusmp.eschaton.desc: A rapier of arcane-conductive metal that charges with the magicules you spend on spells and lets them go in five gifts: arcane edge, whip reach, a second strike, force damage and a cantrip. The charge fades at dawn.
item.nusmp.contingency_plan.card: Weapon (dagger), very rare, requires attunement, +2. This dagger stores one spell. Sneak + use with a potion in your off-hand: the potion's effects are touched to the blade and stored (the empty bottle comes back). Use: choose the circumstance: your health falls under 30%; you are set on fire; you are running out of air; you fall from a great height; three foes close in; you are poisoned or withered. The stored spell takes effect on you, and only you, the first time the circumstance is met, whether or not you want it, and then the contingency ends; the dagger cannot be loaded again until the next dawn. The dagger must be on your person (anywhere in your inventory) and attuned to you.
item.nusmp.contingency_plan.desc: A winged dagger that holds one potion's spell in reserve. Use picks the circumstance, sneak + use with a potion in the off-hand stores it; when the circumstance comes it takes effect on you by itself, and the dagger rests until dawn.
item.nusmp.time_bender_dadao.card: Greatsword class, three tiers of attunement which unlock with time. The tiers open as you carry the dadao in hand: Tier I, from the start: it cannot be lifted by anyone but you (attunement). Tier II after one Minecraft day in hand: Slow Time (use, once per day): for eight seconds foes within 14 blocks are slowed, tired and caught in Tensura's movement interference while you gain Thought Acceleration, Speed III and Haste II: another turn. Tier III after three days in hand: Dimension Toss (sneak + use, once per day): the foe in front of you takes 9 psychic damage and is tossed into another dimension for six seconds: blind, rooted and spatially blockaded (a boss-sized creature only staggers). The 'one round' is six seconds.
item.nusmp.time_bender_dadao.desc: A black dadao with a vein of cyan light, bound to you alone. Its tiers open with the time you carry it in hand: one day for Slow Time, three days for the Dimension Toss (sneak + use).
item.nusmp.gold_circlet.desc: A dragon's circlet of fire. Breathe a nine-block cone of flame that burns what it strikes and lights what can burn; fire you deal keeps burning. Carry another dragon circlet and the breath grows.
item.nusmp.gold_circlet.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 3, toughness 1.5). Legend grade: a Djinn may be bound to it.
Damage type: fire. Fire Breath: Dragon circlets together: breath is a cone nine blocks long and about 35 degrees either side of where you look. It deals 8 damage of the circlet's own element (through the balance law, capped on players), plus a quarter more for every OTHER dragon circlet (gold, silver, steel) you carry anywhere in your pack, and with all three circlets it carries the sting of the other two elements as well. Using it costs 3% of your existence points and it recharges in 45 seconds.
Fire: creatures hit burn for five seconds and the first flammable block in the way catches fire (only where mob griefing is on and you may build).
Dragon Fire: fire damage you deal to a creature sets it burning for five seconds. Fire hurts you 30% less and Tensura's flame attack resistance is lent to you while worn.
Tabletop became: "breath weapon" is the cone; "1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns" is vanilla burning (about a point a second); "a creature that can reach it can use an action to extinguish" is water, or simply waiting; "multiple circlets combined" is carrying more than one.
item.nusmp.silver_circlet.desc: A dragon's circlet of ice. Breathe a freezing cone that slows and chills; at half health or less every melee blow carries an extra d8 of cold. Carry another dragon circlet and the breath grows.
item.nusmp.silver_circlet.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 3, toughness 1.5). Legend grade: a Djinn may be bound to it.
Damage type: cold. Freezing Breath: Dragon circlets together: breath is a cone nine blocks long and about 35 degrees either side of where you look. It deals 8 damage of the circlet's own element (through the balance law, capped on players), plus a quarter more for every OTHER dragon circlet (gold, silver, steel) you carry anywhere in your pack, and with all three circlets it carries the sting of the other two elements as well. Using it costs 3% of your existence points and it recharges in 45 seconds.
Cold: creatures hit are slowed and chilled (frost, slowness).
Winter's Fury: while your health is half your maximum or less, every melee blow you strike deals an extra d8 of cold (held to 6 against another player) and slows its target briefly. Cold hurts you 30% less and Tensura's cold resistance is lent to you while worn.
Tabletop became: "hit points equal to or less than half" is half your health; "1d8 cold" is rolled as a d8; the breath weapon is the cone.
item.nusmp.steel_circlet.desc: A dragon's circlet of thunder. Breathe a percussive cone that hurls and dazes; once a day grow to a Large creature for three minutes. Carry another dragon circlet and the breath grows.
item.nusmp.steel_circlet.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 3, toughness 1.5). Legend grade: a Djinn may be bound to it.
Damage type: thunder. Thunder Breath: Dragon circlets together: breath is a cone nine blocks long and about 35 degrees either side of where you look. It deals 8 damage of the circlet's own element (through the balance law, capped on players), plus a quarter more for every OTHER dragon circlet (gold, silver, steel) you carry anywhere in your pack, and with all three circlets it carries the sting of the other two elements as well. Using it costs 3% of your existence points and it recharges in 45 seconds.
Thunder: creatures hit are hurled back and dazed (nausea).
Siege Monster (second act, once a day, 5% of your magicules): you swell to a Large creature for three minutes: half again as tall (the scale attribute, so your reach grows too), +4 melee damage, and twice as fast at breaking blocks (the "double damage against objects and structures"). A single blow of 10 or more breaks your concentration and you shrink back; so does taking the circlet off. Lightning hurts you 30% less and Tensura's electricity resistance is lent to you.
Tabletop became: "once per long rest" is once per Minecraft day; "Enlarge/Reduce" is the scale attribute plus damage; "minutes equal to your Charisma modifier" is three minutes; "concentration" is the hard-hit rule.
item.nusmp.tiny_duck_crown.desc: A tiny gold crown with a bill. At dawn there is an even chance that the ducks of the countryside come and follow you until midnight; say the word and five of them help you with luck and a quick hand.
item.nusmp.tiny_duck_crown.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 1). (The card calls it a bracelet; it is worn as a tiny crown.)
Legacy of Karl: +1 Luck (the card's +1 Wisdom).
Every dawn the crown rolls percentile dice: under 50 nothing happens; 50 or higher and the ducks come. There are no ducks in the game, so chickens stand in for them. The size of the flock is that many d8: 4d8 in natural habitat (the Overworld), 2d8 on a mountain, 1d8 in another dimension. Up to 24 of the chickens within 32 blocks come to you and follow you until midnight (the flock count itself is the number of ducks that can still help you). If you put the crown on after dawn, the roll is made at once; after midnight there is no roll.
King of Ducks: five ducks of the day's flock assist you: Luck II for three minutes and Haste for one, and five chickens appear for fifteen seconds to flutter about you (they cannot hurt anyone). You can do it until the flock is spent (the flock divided by five).
Tabletop became: "advantage on your next roll" is the luck and haste; "your DM rolls" is the game rolling the dice; "1 mile" is 32 blocks; ducks "cannot attack" is that they are only chickens.
item.nusmp.unicorn_crown.desc: Blessed by wise unicorns: magic glances off you. Three charges of Healing Touch (they return at dawn), Detect Evil, Druidcraft and Pass without Trace at will, and your hair is any colour you like. An evil deed ends the attunement.
item.nusmp.unicorn_crown.card:
Requires attunement (good alignment). Worn on the head (armour 2, toughness 0.5).
Blessed by wise unicorns: "advantage on saving throws against magic" is 25% less magic damage and Tensura's magic resistance skill lent while worn.
Unicorn Magic, at will: Detect Evil and Good (every hostile creature within 24 blocks glows for ten seconds), Druidcraft (the crop or sapling you look at grows as if fed bone meal), Pass without Trace (you and friends within 8 blocks gain Tensura's presence concealment for a minute).
Healing Touch: three charges; touch (look at) a creature within reach, or yourself, to heal 2d8+2 health and cleanse poison, hunger, nausea, infection and magic poison. 1d3 charges come back at dawn.
Hair Colour: change your hair's colour; the crown shimmers round your head in it (eight colours in turn).
Evil deed: killing a villager, a trader, an iron golem, a tamed pet or a unicorn ends your attunement in a flash of rainbow light. The crown stays with you (nothing is ever deleted); attune it anew to use it.
Tabletop became: "Charisma spellcasting" and "disappears" are the at-will acts and the end of attunement; "1d3 charges daily at dawn" is the same.
item.nusmp.circlet_of_the_phoenix.desc: Feathered gold from the Fire Plane. Fire hurts you half as much, your magicules run deeper, and no fall hurts you. It holds a secret for the day you would die.
item.nusmp.circlet_of_the_phoenix.card:
Requires attunement (the card asks for a spellcaster; any attuned wearer works here). Worn on the head (armour 2, toughness 0.5).
Heart of the Fire Plane: fire hurts you 50% less, Tensura's flame attack resistance is lent to you, and your maximum magicules rise by 10% (the card's +2 to spellcasting).
Feather of the Phoenix: no fall ever hurts you (the unlimited Feather Fall), and the Feather Fall act gives twenty seconds of slow falling.
Up in Flames (hidden): when a blow would kill you (not the void, not a command), the circlet bursts: creatures within 3 blocks take 2d10 fire (half on a coin-flip, the Dexterity save), you rise at full health with a few seconds of near-invulnerability, then are weak and glowing for a minute. The circlet will not do it again for three days. Your equipment is never lost.
Tabletop became: "turn into ash and wake after 1d4 hours on the Plane of Fire" is the revival with a weakness and a three-day wait.
item.nusmp.crown_of_the_conjurer.desc: A crown of antler tines with six charges (1d4+2 return at dawn). Conjure Fey costs one charge for a small fey creature; each extra charge makes it stronger, and two more skip the circle. Your mind is steady: you shrug off knockback.
item.nusmp.crown_of_the_conjurer.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the head (armour 2, toughness 0.5).
Six charges, 1d4+2 back at dawn.
Conjure Fey (the first act): spend 1 charge: after a three-second circle a fey creature (strength 1: a sylphide) steps out and fights for you for about 75 seconds (longer for the stronger ones); set Strength (the second act) to add 1, 2 or 3 extra charges and a stronger creature (undine, salamander, a unicorn); Swift Casting (the third act) spends 2 more charges to skip the circle. The creature is a time-limited ally of yours, never more than six summons at once.
Steady mind: you take 20% less knockback (the card's proficiency bonus to concentration saves), and your summons live a quarter longer.
Tabletop became: "conjure fey" is the Tensura spirit ladder (a vanilla vex or golem stands in if a Tensura creature is absent); "CR" is the strength; "change the casting time to 1 action" is skipping the circle.
item.nusmp.diadem_of_fabulous_truthiness: A silver diadem set with green gems. Once a day it casts a Zone of Truth on one creature: it glows, its disguises fall away, and you read its health and existence and see truly for two minutes.

Worn on the head (armour 1).
Zone of Truth (once a day): on the creature you look at (24 blocks): it glows for thirty seconds, invisibility and presence concealment fall away, a hostile one is confounded, you read its health and its maximum existence in chat, and Tensura's eye of truth is lent to you for two minutes.
Tabletop became: "900gp (Fantasy Costco coupon)" is nothing; the footnote joke stays: "This coupon does not actually qualify for any discounts"; "a single target rather than a radius" is the single creature.
item.nusmp.dark_unicorn_crown.desc: Hexed by dark unicorns: magic glances off you. Three charges of Void Beam (they return at midnight), Detect Evil, Thaumaturgy and Pass without Trace at will. Feeding a horse is aiding a unicorn, and ends the attunement.
item.nusmp.dark_unicorn_crown.card:
Requires attunement (a creature that is not good). Worn on the head (armour 2, toughness 1.0).
Hexed by dark unicorns: "advantage on saving throws against magic" is 25% less magic damage and Tensura's magic resistance skill lent while worn.
Dark Unicorn Magic, at will: Detect Evil and Good (hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow), Thaumaturgy (a booming voice: weak hostile creatures within 8 blocks flinch in fear for three seconds), Pass without Trace.
Void Beam: three charges (1d3 back at MIDNIGHT); costs 2% of your magicules; a beam of dark energy at a creature within 36 blocks: 4d6 necrotic (wither) damage, half if it dodges (four in ten do), and a failed save also withers it for two seconds.
Aiding a good unicorn (feeding a horse) ends your attunement in a vortex of shadow. The crown stays with you; attune it anew to use it.
Tabletop became: "DC 20 Dexterity save" is the dodge chance; "120 feet" is 36 blocks.
item.nusmp.ruby_boots_of_planestriding.d: Click the heels of the ruby boots three times and step to the next place they know: first home (your bed), then up to four places you taught them. Three charges, 1d3 back at dawn. The Dungeon cannot be strode to or from.
item.nusmp.ruby_boots_of_planestriding.c:
Requires attunement. Worn on the feet (armour 2, toughness 1.0).
Planestriding: three charges (1d3 back at dawn). Spend one: click your heels three times (a three-second ritual) and step to the NEXT place the boots know: first home (your bed, or the world's spawn), then up to four places you taught them with Learn this Place (the second act). Places may lie in other dimensions (the planes). If there is no room to stand at the other end the charge is returned. The Dungeon cannot be strode to or from.
Tabletop became: "Plane Shift to a location you are familiar with" is the circle of places; "There's no place like..." is the first place, home.
item.nusmp.boots_of_the_indomitable.desc: Cursed: they will not come off while you live (the Curse of Binding; only death, creative mode or a command frees you), and you sink when you swim. But nothing can move you, and once a day a fall of six blocks or more does you no harm: it lands on the creature below.
item.nusmp.boots_of_the_indomitable.card:
Worn on the feet (armour 3, toughness 1.0). Cursed.
The curse: they will not come off (the Curse of Binding on the boots: it holds while you live; a grindstone keeps curses, so only death, creative mode or a command frees you), and you sink when you try to swim, and you are noisy: you sneak more slowly.
Immovable: knockback cannot move you at all (the card's "you cannot be forced to move").
Once a day, a fall of six blocks or more does you no harm: the damage lands on a creature standing within 3 blocks of where you land, which is also knocked flat for two seconds (half of them step aside and take nothing). If nobody is there you are still unhurt.
Tabletop became: "dc15 dex save" is a coin flip; "knocked prone" is a heavy slowness.
item.nusmp.mudwalkers.desc: Mud-caked boots. Soul sand, mud and shallow marsh water barely slow you. Three times a day slide six blocks the way you look, leaving the ground slick with mud for a minute.
item.nusmp.mudwalkers.card:
Worn on the feet (armour 1).
Marsh-walkers: soul sand, mud and the like barely slow you (the movement efficiency attribute), and shallow water slows you less.
Mud Slide (three times a day): slide six blocks the way you look; the ground you cross is coated in slippery mud for a minute: creatures other than your friends that stand in it are slowed and now and then thrown off their feet.
Tabletop became: "ignore difficult terrain" is the movement efficiency; "20 ft" is six blocks; "grease spell" is the mud patch; "bonus action" is the short cooldown.
item.nusmp.boots_of_the_high_ground.desc: You jump higher and fall softer. Once a day shout that you have the high ground: for a minute your melee blows hit 30% harder and anyone who comes within three blocks is struck for you. Step down and it ends.
item.nusmp.boots_of_the_high_ground.card:
Worn on the feet (armour 2, toughness 0.5).
You jump higher and fall softer (the card's advantage on checks to leap over dangerous terrain).
"It's over, I have the high ground!" (once a day): the ground rises under you: you hop up, and for one minute your melee blows hit 30% harder (advantage), and anyone hostile who comes within three blocks of you is struck by a free blow of yours (your attack damage, once a second per creature, up to three at a time). It ends when the minute is up or when you step down from where it rose.
Tabletop became: "reaction: a single melee attack" is the free blow; "advantage" is +30% damage; "you say it as a bonus action" is the act with a short cooldown.
item.nusmp.greaves_of_the_wind_walker.de: Cursed: the greave will not come off. It makes you quicker and wind-proof, and holds five charges (1d4+3 return at dawn) for eight wind spells: Gust, Feather Fall, Dust Devil, Gust of Wind, Warding Wind, Wind Wall, Control Winds, Wind Walk.
item.nusmp.greaves_of_the_wind_walker.ca:
Requires attunement. Worn on the feet (armour 3, toughness 2.0). God grade: a Djinn may be bound to it. Cursed.
The curse: the greave will not come off (the Curse of Binding: it holds while you live; a grindstone keeps curses, so only death, creative mode or a command frees you).
+1 armour and +1 Dexterity are armour and +10% movement speed; Tensura's wind attack resistance is lent to you.
Five charges, 1d4+3 back at dawn. Eight spells:
Gust (free): shoves creatures in a cone of six blocks.
Feather Fall (1): you and friends within 8 blocks float down for half a minute.
Dust Devil (2): a whirling pillar drifts away in front of you for eight seconds, scouring and blinding what it touches.
Gust of Wind (2): a strong wind in a line of fourteen blocks that throws creatures back.
Warding Wind (2): for ten minutes arrows and bolts lose 60% of their damage and Tensura's wind protection covers you.
Wind Wall (3): a wall of wind ten blocks wide stands four blocks ahead for ten seconds; arrows and bolts that reach it are blown apart.
Control Winds (3): the wind carries you for a minute (Tensura's air flight; a slow fall and a high jump if it is absent).
Wind Walk (5, and 3% existence): you and friends within 6 blocks become wind for two minutes: Speed III, flight where Tensura has it, half seen.
Tabletop became: "replaces your right foot over 3 days" is the unremovable curse; "+1 AC and Dexterity" is armour and speed; "DC 18" is not rolled (the spells simply work).
item.nusmp.waterwalkers.desc: Brown boots with a water-drop gem. Switch Liquid to Solid on and the water under your feet freezes to thin ice that melts behind you (sneak to sink); beneath the surface the boots drive you on.
item.nusmp.waterwalkers.card:
Worn on the feet (armour 1).
Liquid to Solid (a switch): while on, the water under and around your feet freezes to thin ice that melts again behind you, like frost walking; sneak to sink through. Switch it off to swim.
Aquatic Booster Boots: you swim a third faster (the card's +10 ft).
Tabletop became: "Dexterity save on waves" is that the ice melts behind you and the water can take you; "bonus action" is the switch.
item.nusmp.sandals_of_sneaking.desc: Silver gladiator sandals laced with blue light. Your footfalls make no sound and no sculk hears them, you move faster sneaking, creatures far off lose your trail, and your presence is hard to feel.
item.nusmp.sandals_of_sneaking.card:
Worn on the feet (armour 1).
Silent: your footfalls make no sound and raise no vibration (no sculk sensor or warden hears them). You sneak 50% faster (the card's advantage on Stealth) and Tensura's presence concealment is on you. While you sneak, creatures more than 8 blocks away that were following you lose your trail every second (the erased footprints).
Tabletop became: "you leave no footprints, and erase old ones" is the lost trail.
item.nusmp.dragon_fire_boots.desc: Scaled boots with dragon-head toes. Speak the word and jets of fire lift you for half a minute of flight. Once a day cast a fireball from the soles; in the air it may throw you off course and crash you.
item.nusmp.dragon_fire_boots.card:
Worn on the feet (armour 2, toughness 0.5).
Fire Jets (the command word; 2% of your magicules, thirty seconds of flight, a 30-second recharge): jets of fire lift you; they sputter for the last five seconds and cut out with a gentle fall. Fire hurts you 40% less and Tensura's flame attack resistance is lent to you.
Fireball (once a day): a burst of fire where you look (40 blocks): everything hostile within 5 blocks takes 11 fire damage and burns. If you are flying there is a four in ten chance the kick throws you off course: you crash (at most four health, never fatal) and the flight ends.
Tabletop became: "flying speed of 50 ft" is the flight; "fireball, DC 13 Dexterity save or lose control and crash" is the crash chance.
item.nusmp.boots_of_burglery.card:
Worn on the feet (armour 2, toughness 1). No attunement.
Quiet Feet: you sneak faster, take 2 blocks less fall damage, and while you are sneaking Tensura's presence concealment is kept on you (the Stealth +3).
Misty Step: three times a day (the uses come back at dawn), use the boots to blink up to nine blocks along your look to a safe place to stand, in a puff of mist.
Through the Wall: the thief's modification. Sneak while using Misty Step and, if a wall begins within three blocks ahead and is at most five blocks thick, you slip through it to the first place with room to stand behind it, even if you cannot see that place. If there is no room, nothing happens (the use is still spent).
item.nusmp.boots_of_burglery.desc: A thief's black boots. You creep faster and Tensura's presence concealment stays on you while you sneak. Three times a day, Misty Step: blink up to nine blocks, or, sneaking, slip through a wall in front of you to the far side.
item.nusmp.handy_towel_cape.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the back.
A Towel Is Massively Useful: +1 armour, a little knockback resistance and a quarter less frost damage, always.
Bound Across Cold Moons (switch on and off): wrap the cape round you. While wrapped you are slower (both hands are full), take no freezing damage at all, shed powder-snow frost, and Tensura's cold resistance is lent to you.
Relaxing Beneath the Stars: sneak and hold for five seconds. You heal 6 hit points and get Regeneration; under the open sky at night you heal 12 instead (the card's doubled rest). Cooldown one minute.
Great Practical Value: dry off in an instant: you stop burning and shed frost and chill. It also works as a towel and a blanket. "42!"
item.nusmp.handy_towel_cape.desc: A warm, soft, very absorbent hooded cape: +1 armour and a quarter less frost damage. Wrap it round you for complete cold immunity (but slower, hands full); hold still under the night sky for a double rest; snap it dry in a moment.
item.nusmp.cape_of_bees.card:
Worn on the back. No attunement.
Release the Swarm: once a day (back at dawn), flap the cape open. A swarm of bees flies at the creature you are looking at within 16 blocks (or the point you look at) and follows it for six seconds, stinging every second the creatures within 3.5 blocks of it (up to four) for 1 damage each and poisoning them (players are only slowed). It never does more than 6 damage to one creature.
item.nusmp.cape_of_bees.desc: Black and yellow stripes. Once a day flap it open and a swarm of bees follows the creature you look at for six seconds, stinging up to four things around it and poisoning them.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_the_first_snow.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the back.
Winter's Embrace: +1 armour, sixty percent less freezing damage, and Tensura's cold resistance while worn.
Gone in a Flurry: twice a day (back at dawn), snowflakes swirl round you for eighteen seconds (the card's 3 rounds). You run faster, creatures within 3.5 blocks are chilled and slowed for three seconds when it starts, and while it lasts one melee blow in each second is turned aside (no attack of opportunity).
item.nusmp.cloak_of_the_first_snow.desc: Winter's embrace: +1 armour, sixty percent less frost damage and Tensura's cold resistance. Twice a day, Gone in a Flurry: for eighteen seconds snow swirls round you, you run faster and one melee blow each second is turned aside.
item.nusmp.autumn_cloak.card:
Worn on the back. No attunement.
Woodland Armour: +1 armour while you stand in a forest or taiga biome.
Leaf Swirl: once a day (back at dawn), on command the leaves swirl round you for one minute. The card's Blur spell becomes: a quarter of all blows against you, in melee or shot, miss.
item.nusmp.autumn_cloak.desc: A cloak of falling leaves: +1 armour among the trees (forests and taiga). Once a day, on command, the leaves swirl and blur you for a minute: a quarter of the blows against you miss.
item.nusmp.darkened_cloak_of_elvenkind.c:
Requires attunement. Worn on the back. (The card's final, Very Rare form: the earlier upgrades are folded in.)
Hood: use it to pull the hood up or down. With the hood up Tensura's presence concealment is kept on you and you sneak faster, and creatures more than eight blocks away cannot pick you out as a target (the card's disadvantage to see you); one you have just hurt always can. Lowering the hood ends Greater Invisibility and Pass Without a Trace at once.
Charges: the cloak has 5 charges; at every dawn 2 to 5 come back (1d4+1). Hood up only.
Pass Without a Trace (1 charge): a minute of stealth for you and friends within ten blocks; for you, creatures more than three blocks away cannot pick you out.
Darkness (2 charges): foes within eight blocks are blinded for six seconds and you see in the dark for half a minute.
Greater Invisibility (3 charges): you are invisible for thirty seconds.
item.nusmp.darkened_cloak_of_elvenkind.d: Hood up, and creatures more than eight blocks away cannot pick you out; you sneak faster. Five charges (two to five come back each dawn) buy Pass Without a Trace, Darkness and Greater Invisibility. Lower the hood and they end.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_levitation.card:
Requires attunement (the card's lawful alignment does not exist here). Worn on the back. A sentient cloak; Djinn Metal Vessel.
Protection: +3 armour, +1 toughness, and no fall damage at all.
Levitate (switch on and off): while it is on you can fly freely like in creative mode, and hover. Switched off, or the cloak taken off, the flight is taken away again.
Smother: costs 2% existence points, cooldown twenty seconds. The cloak wraps a creature within five blocks, dealing 5 damage and holding it fast (Slowness VI), weakened and blinded for a few seconds. A creature of far greater existence slips free.
Sentience: the cloak acts on its own. Struck below two fifths of your health it smothers the attacker (held, weakened and blind, no damage), at most once every thirty seconds.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_levitation.desc: A sentient crimson cloak. +3 armour, no fall damage, and a toggle to hover and fly. Smother wraps a creature in reach, blind and held fast; struck below two fifths of your health, the cloak smothers your attacker by itself.
item.nusmp.cape_of_projection.card:
Worn on the back. No attunement.
Flawless: +1 Luck (advantage on all smouldering).
Projection: whoever hits you takes a quarter of the blow back (at most 6 damage; once a second), and you loudly say it was their fault.
Smoulder: soft creatures (not bosses, not players, not beings of far greater existence) within eight blocks lose interest in you for five seconds. Cooldown 45 seconds.
item.nusmp.cape_of_projection.desc: Your hair is flawless and you are lucky with the charming. Whoever strikes you takes a quarter of the blow back (at most 6), and you loudly say it was their fault. Smoulder makes soft creatures near you lose interest for five seconds.
item.nusmp.mantle_of_selflessness.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the back.
Healing Wave: costs 4% mana, cooldown fifteen seconds. Every friend within eight blocks (players, pets, allies; never you) heals 6 plus 1 to 4 hit points (the card's extra 1d4). One time in twenty (the natural 20) the wave comes twice and costs nothing extra.
Selfless: the mantle's own healing never touches its wearer. Even unasked, every ten seconds it heals 2 hit points to each friend within six blocks who is under half health.
item.nusmp.mantle_of_selflessness.desc: A white and gold mantle that heals everyone but its wearer. Healing Wave mends every friend within eight blocks (7 to 10 hit points; one time in twenty, twice) for a little mana; badly hurt friends near you are eased a little unasked.
item.nusmp.bracers_of_phasing.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the hands.
Phase: four times a day (the card's four charges, all back at dawn) use the bracers and for thirty seconds you walk through walls: you become a ghost (spectator mode: you cannot touch or strike anything). When the time is up the bracers lift you clear of any stone you are still inside; if there is no room within five blocks they hold you up to fifteen seconds longer, then bring you back to where you began. Your game mode is saved and restored on logout, login and shutdown. The Dungeon's stone is magic and cannot be parted. Creative and spectator players are unaffected.
item.nusmp.bracers_of_phasing.desc: Four times a day, phase out: for thirty seconds you walk through walls (you become a ghost, unable to touch or strike anything). The bracers lift you clear of any stone you are still inside. The Dungeon's stone cannot be parted.
item.nusmp.bracer_of_initiative.card:
Worn on the hands. No attunement.
Initiative: +10% attack speed and +2 Luck (the +2 to initiative and charisma checks); your first blow on a creature that is not yet fighting you lands 3 harder.
Roll Initiative: eight seconds of Speed II and Haste II. Cooldown thirty seconds. Your hair streams heroically in a breeze that works for you everywhere.
item.nusmp.bracer_of_initiative.desc: Dice dangle from the straps. You swing a little faster, you are lucky, and your first blow on a creature that is not yet fighting you lands 3 harder. Roll Initiative: eight seconds of Speed II and Haste II.
item.nusmp.phantoms_bracelet.card:
Worn on the hands. No attunement.
Ghost Hand: once a day (back at dawn) your hand goes ghost and reaches through solid stone along your look for up to six blocks, to the first chest, barrel or other container, ender chest, lever or button. Flip a coin: heads, you open or work it as if you stood beside it; tails, your ghostly fingers pass over it. The use is spent either way.
item.nusmp.phantoms_bracelet.desc: Once a day your hand goes ghost and reaches through a wall to the first chest, lever or button within six blocks. Flip a coin: heads, you work it; tails, your fingers pass over it.
item.nusmp.bracers_of_manhandling.card:
Worn on the hands. No attunement.
YEET (Seize and Throw): cooldown ten seconds. Seize a creature within 3.5 blocks and fling it along your look. A creature about your size flies about six blocks; a smaller one twice as far, a larger one (1.6 times your volume or more) half as far, one more than four times your volume or over 250 health cannot be lifted. A creature of far greater existence wrenches free. It takes 4 damage when it lands (2 for others it lands among). Your blows also knock back a little harder.
item.nusmp.bracers_of_manhandling.desc: YEET. Seize a creature in reach and fling it along your look: small ones twice as far, large ones half, giants not at all; it takes a hard landing. Your blows knock back a little harder.
item.nusmp.bracers_of_arcane_blades.card:
Worn on the hands. No attunement.
Throw Arcane Daggers: cooldown 0.7 seconds. Two daggers of pure arcane energy fly from the bracers to the creature you look at within 24 blocks: 5 force damage (magic: it ignores armour), or 3.5 each if there is a second creature within four blocks of the first.
Arcane Blades (switch on and off): the daggers stay in your fists: bare-handed blows (empty main hand) deal 3 more damage with a violet glow. Only two daggers exist at a time, and they never need a sheath.
item.nusmp.bracers_of_arcane_blades.desc: Reach for a blade and a dagger of arcane energy is there. Throw two at once (5 force damage that ignores armour, or 3.5 each on two foes); or turn the daggers on to strike bare-handed for 3 more.
item.nusmp.bear_bracer.card:
Requires attunement. Worn on the hands.
Bear Paw (switch on and off): say the command word and your hand becomes a bear's paw: bare-handed blows (empty main hand) deal 3 extra slashing damage with a claw sweep. Say it again to put the hand back. While worn you also resist knockback a little more.
item.nusmp.bear_bracer.desc: Say the command word and your hand is a bear's paw: bare-handed blows cut for 3 more and you stand firmer against knockback. Say it again to put the hand back.
item.nusmp.bracelets_of_faithful_friends:
Requires attunement. Worn on the hands.
Bind a Friend: look at a friend within six blocks (a player, or a pet of yours) and use the bracelet: they become the other half of the pair (the card's second bracelet; release the bond by sneaking and using it). While you are within ten blocks of each other you both carry Resistance (the advantage on saving throws).
Pull Back: once a day each of you, when a blow would kill you and the other is within ten blocks, is left on one hit point and given Resistance II for three seconds (the stabilising).
Rest Together: when you wake with your friend within sixteen blocks, you both heal 6 more hit points (the doubled rest).

Bind a friend (a player, or a pet of yours) as the other wearer. While you are within ten blocks you both carry Resistance; once a day each pulls the other back from a killing blow; waking close together mends you both.
item.nusmp.crest_of_foresight.card:
Worn at the neck. No attunement. Djinn Metal Vessel.
Foresight: Tensura's danger sense is lent to you while worn; explosions hurt 20% less, shots 15% less, falls 30% less (the +2 to Dexterity saving throws).
Moment of Foresight: once a day (back at dawn), costs 1% existence points. You gain +2 armour for ten minutes and twenty seconds of Tensura's future vision.
item.nusmp.crest_of_foresight.desc: A golden crest with a clock of too many hands. Tensura's danger sense is yours; explosions, shots and falls hurt less. Once a day, the moment of foresight: +2 armour for ten minutes and twenty seconds of future vision.
item.nusmp.sigil_of_the_faint_flame.card:
Unique Grade necklace. Requires attunement. Fitting within the palm of the hand, made of splendid gold and encircled with eight spirals set with perfect sapphires, this sigil is warm as the sun even in the coldest shadow.
Passive. Cold hurts you half as much, fire a quarter less, and Tensura's Flame Attack Resistance is lent to you while it is worn. Fire spells you cast (grimoire fire, Tensura flame, a fireball) hit 25% harder: the +2 to spell attacks and save DCs of the card, made into damage.
Charges. It holds up to 10 charges and regains 1d8+2 at every dawn; they only answer while the sun is up and are lost at sunset (from the moment the sun goes down they do nothing until the next dawn).
Reprisal (reaction, automatic). When a magic or fire blow from a living caster lands on you, the sigil spends one to three charges (one per 5 damage of the blow, at most three, the card's spell level), halves the damage and throws a fireball back at the caster (6, 8 or 10 damage by the charges spent, and they burn for 4 seconds). It needs a second between uses and cannot answer itself.
Faint Flame (3% mana, 15 s cooldown). A ring of fire four blocks wide: every foe in it takes 5 fire damage and burns for 3 seconds; you gain Fire Resistance for 20 seconds and Tensura's Flame Attack Resistance.
Sunlit Warmth (30 s cooldown). The cold lets go of you (frost and slowness are lifted), you regenerate for 8 seconds and gain Fire Resistance for 45 seconds.
Tabletop made game: charges per dawn and the loss at sunset stay as they are; spell attack and DC bonuses became +25% fire damage; the spell level of Reprisal is read off the damage; the daily fireball slot became the thrown-back fireball.
item.nusmp.sigil_of_the_faint_flame.desc: A gold sigil set with sapphires that stays warm in the coldest shadow. Your fire spells hit harder; a spell aimed at you is halved by a charge, and a fireball goes back at the caster.
item.nusmp.true_heart_clasp.card:
Rare Grade necklace. A small clasp that can be fastened to the user's ear, like a clip-on earring. It lets the wearer feel what people truly intend.
Passive. +1 Luck (the "advantage and +2 to insight checks" of the card) and Tensura's Danger Sense is lent to you while it is worn.
True Intentions (2% mana, 20 s cooldown). Your insight reads every hostile creature (and anything hunting you) within 24 blocks: those that mean you harm (they have you in their sights) glow for 10 seconds and are counted; the others are counted as at peace. Tensura's Danger Sense and Telepathy are lent for 10 seconds, so you also feel what is behind you.
Tabletop made game: insight checks and advantage became Luck, a read of who is hunting you, and two lent Tensura skills (a skill id that Tensura does not know is simply skipped).
item.nusmp.true_heart_clasp.desc: A clip-on heart of pink-red gem. It lets you feel what people truly intend: you are a little luckier, and a burst of insight shows who means you harm.
item.nusmp.brooch_of_poeur.card:
Legend Grade necklace. Can be a Djinn's Metal Vessel. One-of-a-kind. This diamond-encrusted brooch glows with energy at your touch. Wait, those are not diamonds, that is cubic zirconium. It is close enough. It LOOKS fancy, and that is all that matters.
Passive. Frost hurts you half as much; +8% maximum magicules.
Cheap Gems (automatic). When you cast a grimoire spell that costs 5% of your magicules or more, make an intelligence check: d20 + 4 against a DC that starts at 12 for a 5% spell and rises by 2 for every further 5%, up to 20 at 25% or more. On a success the spell costs nothing: the magicules it took come back at once. The check can pay off once every 30 seconds. (Needs the cast hook of the grimoire in GrimoireBook: see the report.)
Starburst (6% mana, 45 s cooldown). A burst of frost shards seven blocks wide: foes take 6 cold damage and are slowed for 6 seconds.
Tabletop made game: spell slots became magicules (Tensura's pool), the slot check became the d20 check against the spell's cost; the DC ladder by spell level became a ladder by the spell's cost.
item.nusmp.brooch_of_poeur.desc: A snowflake brooch of cut gems, close enough to diamonds. Sometimes a costly spell costs you nothing at all; the bigger the spell, the harder the check. It can also burst in a starburst of frost.
item.nusmp.holy_handgrenade.desc: Count to three, no more, no less. Hold to count, then it is lobbed: the evil are smitten, the good are mended. Roll badly and it fizzles, stays in your hand, or goes off in it.
item.nusmp.snugglable_doll.card:
Rare Grade charm. Requires attunement. A blue stitched plush cat with big cyan X-button eyes and a wide, toothy grin; a ghostly grey cat looms behind it.
Passive. Tensura's Telepathy is lent to you while it is worn, so you can speak with your familiar.
Come Alive (3% mana, 2 minute cooldown). Snuggles, a tame cat, appears at your side for five minutes: +30 maximum health (the "four times your level" of the card), +3 bite damage and +4 armour (the proficiency bonus). It fights foes for you. Calling it again sends the old one away.
Cuddle (30 s cooldown). Snuggles is healed fully and regenerates, and you heal 4 hit points.
Tabletop made game: Find Familiar became the summoning of a stronger tame cat; AC, attack and damage bonuses became armour, bite and health.
