djinn_weapon.act.thunder_throw.desc: Hurls a bolt along your gaze that pierces up to five foes, slows them, and jumps on to the nearest others.
djinn_weapon.act.judgement_step.desc: Dashes forward in a trail of lightning, striking and slowing everything you pass.
djinn_weapon.act.sun_cleave.desc: A wide arc of sunfire in front of you: it burns every foe it touches and shoves them back.
djinn_weapon.act.ember_wall.desc: Raises a wall of flame two blocks ahead: foes in it burn and are thrown back; you shrug off fire for five seconds.
djinn_weapon.act.tide_spear.desc: A jet of water along your gaze: it hits everything in its line and pushes it away.
djinn_weapon.act.frost_surge.desc: A cone of freezing water: foes are hurt, frozen and slowed to a crawl.
djinn_weapon.act.cyclone_sweep.desc: Spins a ring of wind round you that throws every foe near you outward and up.
djinn_weapon.act.updraft_leap.desc: Leaps high on a column of wind (and floats down gently), lifting the foes at your feet.
djinn_weapon.act.bloom_heal.desc: A garden opens round you: you and your allies are healed and mended, foes are hurt and rooted by vines.
djinn_weapon.act.thorn_snare.desc: Thorns lash up to three foes in front of you: they are hurt, rooted and poisoned.
djinn_weapon.act.titan_slam.desc: Brings the axe down: a shockwave round you hurts every foe near, harder close in, and throws them into the air.
djinn_weapon.act.rock_breaker.desc: A crushing blow on up to three foes ahead: the more armour they wear the harder it lands, and it leaves them weakened and fragile.
djinn_weapon.act.resonance_wave.desc: A cone of sound: foes are hurt, thrown back and silenced.
djinn_weapon.act.dissonance.desc: A burst of clashing chords round you: foes near you are hurt, dizzied and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.ember_rush.desc: Pounces forward in a streak of fire, setting alight everything in the path.
djinn_weapon.act.brand.desc: Brands the foe in your sights: it burns, glows, and takes more damage from everyone for eight seconds.
djinn_weapon.act.dawn_arrow.desc: Looses a shaft of dawn light that never drops: it strikes the first two foes in its line, twice as hard against the undead.
djinn_weapon.act.radiant_burst.desc: A flash of first light round you: foes are hurt and blinded, you and your allies are healed.
djinn_weapon.act.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning leaps from foe to foe, a little weaker at each jump.
djinn_weapon.act.storm_pillars.desc: Marks three places (on your foes, else ahead of you): a pillar of storm light falls on each a moment later, stilling what it hits.
djinn_weapon.act.crescent_wind.desc: Two crescents of wind sweep out to either side of your gaze, cutting everything in them and leaving the wounds bleeding.
djinn_weapon.act.heavenly_dash.desc: A dash on the wind, high and long, that cuts every foe on its way.
djinn_weapon.act.abyssal_reap.desc: A wide sweep of the scythe: foes are hurt and filled with dread, and a share of the harm comes back to you as health.
djinn_weapon.act.drowning_pull.desc: Pulls every foe near you in on a black whirlpool: they are hurt, slowed and lose their breath.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.temp: A temporary weapon: %s's Djinn Equip made it. It lasts as long as the Equip; your own item is kept safe and returns when it ends.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.admin: A weapon of %s's Djinn (admin). It does not depend on a Djinn Equip.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.dark: Black rukh: it hits harder and drinks more Magoi.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.act2: Sneak + right-click, Full Equip only: %s (%s%% of your Magoi, %s s)
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.rules: It cannot be dropped, stored or moved away from its slot; it is always back in your hand.
djinn_weapon.msg.returned: The Djinn weapon fades. Your own items are back.
djinn_weapon.msg.busy: The Djinn is gathering an Extreme Magic: the weapon is still.
djinn_weapon.msg.magoi: Your Magoi is too low for that.
djinn_weapon.msg.nothing: There is nothing in reach to strike.
djinn_weapon.cmd.nodjinn: That player holds no Djinn: name one (weapon give <player> <djinn> [dark]).
djinn_weapon.cmd.cleared: Removed %s Djinn weapon(s) from %s and ended the loan.

nusmp.compat.codex.footer: Nothing here has been run in a game. The files were read and checked; the build server only compiles.
nusmp.compat.codex.tip.lore: Two mods, one binding: what this mod works with, and what it does not.
nusmp.relic_pedestal.exhausted: The pedestal holds nothing: every relic of its kind already walks this world.
message.nusmp.trial.sealed: The archway seals. Nothing leaves until the trial is done.
item.nusmp.shadow_key.tooltip: Dropped by a Floor Warden. Opens the Warden's gate before the Boss Peak.
entity.nusmp.floor_warden.bar: Floor Warden, Keeper of the Seal
message.nusmp.gatekeeper.warden_open: The Shadow Key turns. The Warden's seal breaks.
message.nusmp.gatekeeper.warden_sealed: Sealed. Only a Shadow Key opens the Warden's gate.
message.nusmp.gatekeeper.boss_sealed: Sealed by the floor's master. Defeat what waits beyond the altar.
message.nusmp.peak_altar.idle: The altar waits for a challenger.
message.nusmp.peak_altar.active: The floor's master walks. Finish it.
message.nusmp.peak_altar.done: The altar is spent. The Vault stands open.
message.nusmp.trap.pitfall: The floor gives way beneath you!
message.nusmp.trap.snuffer: The glyph drinks the light. %s flame(s) go out.
message.nusmp.trap.no_light: The glyph smothers it: no light can be set down here.
message.nusmp.puzzle.riddle: The stone whispers the order of the sigils:
message.nusmp.puzzle.wrong: Wrong order! The sigils sear you and go dark for %s s.
message.nusmp.puzzle.locked: The sigils are dark for %s more second(s).
message.nusmp.puzzle.solved: The sigils blaze. A door unseals.
message.nusmp.puzzle.solved_nodoor: The sigils blaze, but nothing answers.
message.nusmp.puzzle.done: The riddle is solved. The way is open.
message.nusmp.puzzle.quiet: The sigils are quiet. Nothing stirs.
message.nusmp.puzzle.no_stone: The sigil is cold: no riddle stone answers it.
message.nusmp.gatekeeper.puzzle_sealed: The door answers only to the sigils, not to a key.
message.nusmp.labyrinth_gloom_warning: The dark presses in. Light a lantern or find a lit room.
message.nusmp.labyrinth_gloom: The gloom of the Labyrinth saps you. Hold a light.
message.nusmp.labyrinth_hunger: Your stomach is empty. Eat: the Labyrinth gives no rest.

nusmp.forge.tier.none: Place a relic on the left.
nusmp.forge.engrave.help1: Weapon on the left, an engraving book
nusmp.forge.engrave.help2: in the Core slot. The book is used up.
nusmp.forge.msg.idle: The forge is ready. Place a relic, then choose.
nusmp.forge.msg.no_item: Place a relic or a weapon in the first slot.
nusmp.forge.msg.not_allowed: This item cannot take that work.
nusmp.forge.msg.no_sockets: This relic has no socket. Only weapons and armour of Rare grade and above carry one (two from Legend).
nusmp.forge.msg.sockets_full: Every socket of this relic is already filled.
nusmp.forge.msg.need_socket_core: A Spirit Core or a Devil Core is needed in the Core slot.
nusmp.forge.msg.need_empty_core: An Empty Element Core is needed in the Core slot to draw a Core out.
nusmp.forge.msg.nothing_bound: No Core is bound in this relic.
nusmp.forge.msg.no_catalyst: Place the catalysts of the next grade in the catalyst slots.
nusmp.forge.msg.at_top: This relic already stands at Genesis grade.
nusmp.forge.msg.need_book: An engraving book is needed in the Core slot.
nusmp.forge.msg.not_a_weapon: Only the weapons of this world can be engraved.
nusmp.forge.msg.not_an_engraving: That book holds no Tensura engraving.
nusmp.forge.msg.engraving_cap: The forge has added all the engravings it may add to this weapon (three).
nusmp.forge.msg.engraving_present: The weapon already carries that engraving. It will not be replaced.
nusmp.forge.msg.engraving_conflict: That engraving conflicts with one the weapon already carries.
nusmp.forge.msg.upgrade_ok: The relic has risen a grade.
nusmp.forge.msg.upgrade_unattuned: The relic is not attuned to you.
nusmp.forge.msg.upgrade_wrong_catalyst: These are not the catalysts of the next grade.
nusmp.forge.msg.upgrade_need_count: There are not enough catalysts for this step.
nusmp.forge.msg.upgrade_no_energy: Not enough magicules and aura for the ritual.
nusmp.forge.msg.upgrade_failed_kept: The ritual failed, but the catalysts held. The relic is unharmed.
nusmp.forge.msg.upgrade_failed_lost: The ritual failed and the catalysts were lost. The relic is unharmed.
nusmp.forge.msg.socket_refused: The binding was refused. Read the notice in the chat.
nusmp.forge.msg.drawn_out: The Core has been drawn out and returned to you.
item.nusmp.demon_shovel.card:
Rare shovel. Made by a demon for unknown purposes: evil mining, evil hole digging or, dare it be said, evil gardening.
Necrotic Blade: every hit deals 3.5 extra necrotic damage and withers the target for two seconds.
Evil Mining: while held, you break blocks 50% faster.
Evil Gardening (use, 20 s cooldown): up to twelve crops, saplings and plants within five blocks grow as if bone-mealed. Does nothing inside the Labyrinth or the Dungeon.
Evil Hole Digging (sneak + use, 2% of your magicules, 15 s cooldown): a pit of shadow opens three blocks round the spot you point at; foes in it take 5 damage, are slowed and weakened for three seconds and are pulled down.
item.nusmp.demon_shovel.desc: A fabulously lavender shovel made by a demon for unknown, probably evil, purposes. It hits with necrotic force, digs fast, coaxes the garden to grow (evil gardening) and opens a pit of shadow under your foes (sneak + use).
item.nusmp.dragoons_halberd.card:
Rare halberd (+1). The traditional weapon of the Dragoons, a military force trained to fight dragons. Reach +0.75.
Dragonslayer: hits against dragons, wyverns, drakes and wyrms deal 4 extra damage.
Drop Attack: a blow landed while falling (a fall of a block and a half or more) bursts in a two-block radius for 3.5 extra damage of the chosen element: Fire (sets alight), Frost (slows), Lightning (briefly paralyses) or Wind (throws up).
Choose the Element (use): cycles Fire, Frost, Lightning, Wind.
Dragoon's Leap (sneak + use, 8 s cooldown): leap up and forward, ready to come down on something.
item.nusmp.dragoons_halberd.desc: The halberd of the Dragoons, who train to fight dragons. It hits draconic creatures harder, and a blow struck while falling bursts in two blocks with an element of your choice (use to change it); sneak + use leaps.
item.nusmp.efreetis_kusarigama.card:
Rare sickle (reach, two-handed), requires attunement. Damage 1d6 slashing + 2 fire.
Solid Flame Blade: +2 to attacks; every hit adds 2 fire damage and sets the target alight. Reach +1.5, fire damage reduced by a quarter.
Grip of the Fire Genie (use, 15 s cooldown): the chain wraps a foe within nine blocks. It is pulled to within three blocks, rooted for six seconds (one round), and takes 3.5 fire damage when first gripped and every two seconds after. Bosses are slowed but not pulled. The grip breaks if you swap items, the foe dies or gets more than fourteen blocks away.
item.nusmp.efreetis_kusarigama.desc: A flame sickle on a long chain with an ember at its end. It reaches further, burns what it cuts, and the Grip of the Fire Genie wraps the chain round a foe, pulls it in and scorches it for six seconds.
item.nusmp.ilmare_gin_the_starlight_silv:
Rare weapon (katana), requires attunement. 1d8 slashing, finesse, versatile (1d10), thrown (20/60, 1d8 piercing).
+1 weapon; versatile: with an empty off-hand every hit deals 1.5 extra damage.
Starlight Throw (use, 5 s cooldown): throw the katana along your sight line up to twenty blocks (the old 20 ft was too short for a world of blocks). It deals 4.5 damage to the first foe in your sights, or bites into the block you aimed at.
Star Step (sneak + use, 2 s cooldown, within five seconds of the throw): teleport to the impact, gripping the weapon. Works on foes and on solid objects alike; needs room to stand.

A slim midnight-blue katana flecked with starlight. Use throws it along your sight line (twenty blocks); within five seconds sneak + use steps you along the starlight to where it struck and into your hand.
item.nusmp.katana_of_carnage.card:
Rare, requires attunement. +2 magical katana of sharpness (the printed text is cut off after this line; the rest is a fitting invention).
Sharpness: one blow in twenty severs: +40% damage and a poisoning wound for four seconds.
Carnage (invented): each kill within eight seconds of the last adds a stack (up to five) of +1 damage per stack; at five stacks each kill also heals one heart.
Bloodlust (use, 10 s cooldown): spends all stacks for three seconds of speed and haste per stack, and heals half a heart per stack.
item.nusmp.katana_of_carnage.desc: A +2 katana of sharpness with a blood-stained charm: one blow in twenty severs. Every kill within eight seconds of the last feeds Carnage (up to five stacks of added damage); use spends the stacks on speed, haste and a little blood back.
Very rare longsword (versatile), requires attunement by a Fighter or Ranger. 1d8 (1d10) +2 slashing.
Folded Steel: +2 weapon.
Deflection: when a melee blow strikes you while you hold the katana, there is a 45% chance (once every three seconds) that it is turned aside entirely, and you answer it with a normal attack of 6 damage.
Swift and Deadly (use, once per day, 5% of your magicules): Steel Wind Strike: 7 damage to each of up to five foes within eight blocks, and you end the strike beside the last of them.
A +2 folded-steel katana. It may turn a melee blow aside and answer it (one in two, every three seconds), and once a day Steel Wind Strike flickers you between up to five foes within eight blocks.
item.nusmp.lightworkers_scepter.card:
Heavy weapon, two-handed, sentient, requires attunement (clerics and paladins). A voice within gives guidance on compassion, mercy and virtue.
Ability scores (Intelligence and Wisdom +5, saves +2): +10% maximum magicules and +15% resistance to magic and darkness.
Psychic Resistance: fear, confusion, insanity and hypnosis slide off you.
Ward of Light: resisting a magical blow heals you two points, up to twenty a day.
Rechannel Energy (use, five a day): heals you ten points (and regenerates) and friends within eight blocks six each.
Soothing Presence (sneak + use, three a day): for a minute everyone within six blocks is soothed: friends regenerate and shake off fear, hostile mobs forget their anger.
Soulgate (once a day, automatic): a blow that would kill you is turned aside and you wake at four hearts, strongly protected for four seconds.
Mighty Ethereal Light (worn-relic key, once a day, 15% of your magicules): smite every foe within ten blocks of the one you are looking at (or of the spot ahead) for 14 damage, 21 against the undead.
Smite the Undead: hits against the undead deal 4 extra damage.
item.nusmp.lightworkers_scepter.desc: A feather-winged scepter with a kind voice. Rechannel Energy mends you and your friends (five a day), Soothing Presence calms a ring of six blocks (sneak + use), and the worn-relic key calls Mighty Ethereal Light. Once a day it pulls you out of a killing blow.
item.nusmp.mjolnir.card:
Rare warhammer. 1d8 bludgeoning. Can also be used as a projectile and be summoned back. Able to cast Lightning Bolt once per day.
Worthy: lightning damage to you is halved; hits against wet foes (in water or rain) deal 3 extra damage.
Hammer Throw (use, 4 s cooldown): the hammer flies up to twenty-four blocks down your sight line, strikes up to three foes for 8 damage and is back in your hand at once.
Lightning Bolt (sneak + use, once per day): a bolt along your sight line, 1.6 blocks wide, up to 24 blocks: 12 lightning damage to every foe in it (18 in a thunderstorm) and sets them alight.
item.nusmp.mjolnir.desc: The hammer of knotted steel. Use throws it down your sight line (it is back in your hand at once); sneak + use calls a Lightning Bolt once a day. It shrugs off lightning and shocks wet foes.
item.nusmp.overprotective_halberd.card:
Very rare halberd, requires attunement (spellcaster). The Vasteel crest is etched into it: it must have belonged to a Knight of Vasteel.
+2 weapon (reach +0.75).
Hover (use, 4% of your magicules): the halberd rises and hovers round you for three minutes. Whenever a creature within three blocks hits you in melee, it strikes that creature for 8 damage, once every two seconds (one round is six seconds, a reaction here is two). It works whether or not you hold it, as long as you carry it. Use again to call it back.
item.nusmp.overprotective_halberd.desc: A Vasteel halberd trailing red ribbons. Use sends it hovering round you for three minutes: it strikes back at whoever hits you in melee, once every two seconds, even when it is not in your hand. Use again to call it back.
item.nusmp.phoenix_flame.card:
Rare weapon (halberd), requires attunement. Heavy, reach, two-handed. 1d10 slashing.
Command Word (use): speak the word and flames erupt from the blade. While it is ablaze, every hit adds 7 fire damage (2d6) and sets the target alight, and the flames light the dark around you (night vision). They last until you speak again, drop the halberd or stow it.
Reach +1; fire damage to you reduced by 30%.
item.nusmp.phoenix_flame.desc: A halberd whose blade is a swept-wing phoenix. Use speaks the command word: flames erupt, light the dark around you and add fire damage to every hit. They burn until you speak again, drop the halberd or stow it.
item.nusmp.primal_chaos.card:
A rapier forged by the Gods designed specifically to destroy the creatures of the void. Though it is pointy and works on others too. 1d4 radiant. (The card is only partly drawn: the hilt and the lunge are invented.)
Radiant Point: every hit adds 2.5 radiant damage; against void creatures (the End's folk, shulkers, phantoms, vexes, wardens, anything called void) it adds 8.5 and locks them in place for two seconds.
Void Rend (use, 8 s cooldown): lunge five blocks, piercing up to five foes in a line for 5 damage (11 against void creatures, which cannot slip away for three seconds).
item.nusmp.primal_chaos.desc: A rapier of light forged by the gods to destroy the creatures of the void, though it is pointy and works on others too. It adds radiant damage, far more against void creatures, and Void Rend lunges through a line of foes.
item.nusmp.ravens_wing.card:
Rare, requires attunement. +2 glaive, 1d10+2 slashing, heavy, reach, two-handed. Reach +1.
Psychopomp (once per short rest): Toll the Dead (use, 2 minutes): a bell tolls in a creature's bones for 4.5 damage, 9 if it is already wounded; a creature that holds its ground (40%, always a boss) takes half. Spare the Dying (sneak + use, 2 minutes): the nearest dying friend within ten blocks (half health or less) is steadied: healed three hearts and regenerating.
Raven Sense (worn-relic key, three a day): ravens scout for you: every creature within thirty blocks is outlined for ten seconds and you gain Tensura's magic sense and danger sense for three minutes.
item.nusmp.ravens_wing.desc: A +2 glaive with a raven's wing for a blade. Use tolls the dead at a creature in sight, sneak + use spares a dying friend, and the worn-relic key sends ravens to scout (three a day).
item.nusmp.rift_breaker.card:
Rare spear (6.5 damage, quick). Requires attunement.
The tip of this spear is a strange crystal, sharp enough to pierce the fabric of reality.
Reach. +0.5 blocks of reach while held.
Rift Strike (four times a day, short cooldown). Two rifts open, one by you and one by the creature you see within 18 blocks, and the spear strikes it from any direction (9 damage). Sneak-use instead: the spear flies the rift line and cuts up to four creatures on it (8 damage each).
Dimension Door (once a day). Blink up to 24 blocks along your look to a safe spot; the Tensura skill Spatial Motion is lent for ten seconds if it exists.
Escape Rift (once only; sneak and hold, 3% magicules). Drive the butt into the ground three blocks ahead: a circle of teleportation 3 blocks across opens for six seconds. Anyone who steps into it (you included) is carried 30 to 60 blocks away to a safe spot. The spear is destroyed.
Tabletop became: 'once per long rest' = once per Minecraft day; '60 ft' = 18 blocks, '10 ft circle' = a 3 block doorway; 'an unknown location determined by the DM' = a random safe place 30 to 60 blocks away; 'one round' = 6 seconds; 'throw (range 60 ft)' = the sneak-use rift line.
item.nusmp.rift_breaker.desc: A spear with a crystal tip sharp enough to pierce reality. Once a day a Dimension Door; four times a day it strikes through a rift at a creature up to 18 blocks away (sneak: it flies the rift line and cuts everything on it). Once only, drive it into the ground to open an escape circle: the spear is destroyed.
item.nusmp.scimitar_of_the_seasons.card:
Unique scimitar (7.5 damage, quick).
Changing of the Seasons. The edge follows the calendar: a Minecraft year is four seasons of eight days each, spring first.
Command Word (use; use again to dismiss). While it is on, every blow adds 2d6 (7) of the season's kind: radiant in spring (and a glow on the target), fire in summer (the target burns), necrotic in autumn (Wither) and cold in winter (frostbite and Slowness). Two seasonal bites are at least 8 ticks apart.
Tabletop became: 'bonus action' = a use of the weapon; 'the weapon's appearance changes' = the glow colour of the bite (the held model is one model for all seasons); the real-world season = the in-game day count.
item.nusmp.scimitar_of_the_seasons.desc: A jade scimitar on a twisted branch. Speak the word (use it) and every blow bites for 2d6 extra of the season's kind: radiant in spring, fire in summer, necrotic in autumn, cold in winter. A season lasts eight Minecraft days. Use it again to dismiss the effect.
item.nusmp.silver_wind_mountain_glaive.c:
Rare glaive (10 damage, slow). Requires attunement.
A giant's double-headed glaive, nearly 12 feet from blade to blade. Heavy, two-handed, long reach (+1.5 blocks); the Tensura skill Wind Attack Resistance is lent while held.
Charges. Ten charges; about one comes back every 2.7 minutes (7 to 8 a day) while the glaive is in your hand.
Forceful Strike (1 charge). A gust cone 8 blocks long: foes in it are thrown back and cut for 3, missiles are pushed away.
Whirlwind Maneuver (2 charges, twice a day). For five seconds a storm 4 blocks out spins round you: you cannot walk, and every half second foes inside are dragged in and cut for 3.
Become the Hurricane (5 charges, 1% existence points). Steel Wind Strike: up to five foes within 9 blocks are cut for 8 each in a row.
Tabletop became: 'Strength 20 and speaking Giant' to attune = the glaive is simply heavy and slow; Gust of Wind, Whirlwind and Steel Wind Strike = the effects above; charges per long rest = a slow trickle while held.
item.nusmp.silver_wind_mountain_glaive.d: A cloud giant's double-headed glaive with ten charges. Forceful Strike blasts a gale in front of you, Whirlwind roots you in a spinning storm that drags foes in, Become the Hurricane strikes up to five foes like a steel wind. Charges come back, about seven a day.
item.nusmp.spider_sword.card:
Rare scimitar (5.5 damage, quick). Requires attunement.
Coated with a poisonous resin: every blow adds 3 magic damage and Poison (6 seconds on creatures, 3 on players). The Tensura skill Poison Resistance is lent while held.
Spider Climb. A short dash, then for ten seconds you stick to walls: push against one to climb it, sneak to hold still; the Tensura skill Sticky Steel Thread is lent for the same time.
Web Snare. Spin a web at the creature in your sights within 14 blocks: heavy Slowness and Weakness (8 seconds; 3 on players).
Tabletop became: 'Dash action' = the Spider Climb use; 'walk on webs' = the climb and the lent thread skill; 'spin webs of any size' = Web Snare; 1d10 poison = 3 damage and Poison.
item.nusmp.spider_sword.desc: A scimitar coated in poisonous red resin: every hit adds poison. Dash and the soles stick: for ten seconds you climb walls like a spider. Spin a web to bind a thief in place.
item.nusmp.stick_of_youth.card:
Rare club (5 damage). No attunement. (The card prints no rarity.)
To grown-ups it looks like a plain stick. In young hands it takes the form of any common weapon.
Take Form (use). The stick cycles club, sword, axe, spear, dagger and back. Club: a plain blow. Sword: 120% and the creatures at the target's side take 30%. Axe: 140%; a raised shield is knocked down and cooling down. Spear: 110%; the creature behind the target takes 40%. Dagger: 85%.
Tabletop became: 'adulthood' = no check: everyone is young at heart (a stated choice); 'proficiency bonus only if proficient with the chosen weapon' = the form multipliers above; 'any weapon from the table' = five forms.
item.nusmp.stick_of_youth.desc: A knotted wooden stick that looks like a plain club. In young hands it can take the form of any common weapon: use it to turn it from club to sword, axe, spear and dagger, and each form strikes the way that weapon does.
item.nusmp.sun_gift.card:
Rare twin glaive (11 damage). Requires attunement (the card asks for level 15: a stated drop). The card prints no rarity.
Heavy, two-handed, +1.5 blocks of reach; Light Attack Resistance is lent while held. Every blow adds 2d6 (7) radiant damage.
Charges. Four charges; one returns about every 2.8 minutes of daylight (clear sky, no rain) while the glaive is in your hand, 3 to 4 a day.
Guiding Bolt (1 charge). A bolt of light up to 24 blocks: 8 radiant damage and the target glows.
Fireball (2 charges). Fire where you look, 4 blocks across: 11 damage and burning. No blocks are harmed.
Flame Strike (3 charges). A column of fire and light, 3 blocks across: 14 fire and 10 radiant damage.
Firebolt (no charge). One bolt of fire for 6 damage; the card allows it only while stunned: it is at will here.
Tabletop became: 'spell save and attack modifiers' = fixed damage; 'recharges 1d4+1 per day on sunlight' = charging in daylight.
item.nusmp.sun_gift.desc: A twin-bladed glaive that drinks sunlight: every blow adds radiant damage. Four charges (they come back in the sun) cast Guiding Bolt, Fireball and Flame Strike; a Firebolt needs no charge.
item.nusmp.the_last_horseman.card:
Rare scythe (11 damage, slow). Requires attunement (the card asks for level 15: a stated drop). The card prints no rarity.
Reach +1.5 blocks; Darkness Attack Resistance is lent while held. Every blow adds 4.5 necrotic damage.
Damage reduces maximum health. Each blow takes 4% of the target's maximum health (at most 30%) for five minutes; it comes back sooner when the target logs out.
Spare the Dying. The most hurt ally (or you) within 6 blocks is steadied: 4 health and Regeneration.
Speak With Dead. Every undead creature within 24 blocks glows for ten seconds; you see in the dark and are told how many there are.
Find Steed: Nightmare (once a day, 2% magicules). A saddled skeletal horse, tamed to you, fast and fire-proof, for five minutes; you mount it.
Charges. Two charges; one returns each Minecraft day.
Create Undead (1 charge, 1% existence points). Three wither skeletons rise as your servants for three minutes.
Word of Ruin (1 charge, 2% existence points). Power Word Kill became a death word that never kills outright: 12 plus a third of the target's maximum health (capped on players) and Wither.
item.nusmp.the_last_horseman.desc: A scythe wreathed in violet flame. Its blows add necrotic damage and eat away at the target's maximum health. It can steady the dying, sense the dead, summon a Nightmare to ride, and with its two charges raise undead or speak a Word of Ruin.
item.nusmp.the_legacy.card:
Rare warhammer (10 damage). Requires attunement. The card prints no rarity.
The head levitates above the handle. +3.5 blocks of reach while held; Electricity Resistance is lent. Every blow adds 1d8 (4.5) thunder damage.
Toss the Head. The head flies up to 36 blocks along your look and strikes up to six creatures on the line for 10. The hammer is headless for eight seconds: its blows are an improvised club (40%) and carry no thunder.
Recall (sneak-use). The head slams back at once and strikes the foes within 5 blocks for 5.
Tabletop became: '30 ft attack range' = +3.5 blocks of reach; '120 ft toss' = 36 blocks; 'headless, 1d6 improvised' = 40% blows.
item.nusmp.the_legacy.desc: A warhammer whose head levitates above its handle: it reaches 3.5 blocks farther and every blow adds thunder. Toss the head up to 36 blocks to hit everything on the line; until it returns the hammer is a poor improvised club.
item.nusmp.the_librarians_maul.card:
Rare maul (9 damage, slow). No attunement. The card prints no rarity.
Strength and Intelligence both land the blow. Intelligence became experience: every experience level adds 0.15 damage (at most 6). With the off hand empty (two-handed, the d12) the whole blow is 15% heavier.
Quiet Please. The book slams shut: foes within 4 blocks take 7 damage, are slowed and silenced (6 seconds; 2 on players).
Tabletop became: 'Intelligence modifier' = experience levels; 'versatile 1d8 / 1d12' = the off-hand bonus.
item.nusmp.the_librarians_maul.desc: A granite book on a pole. Strength and learning both land the blow: every experience level adds damage, and with the off hand empty it hits like the two-handed 1d12. Quiet Please slams the book shut: nearby foes are hurt, slowed and silenced.
item.nusmp.time_hammer.card:
Legendary warhammer (12 damage). Requires attunement. Can be a Djinn Metal Vessel.
Forged by an ancient chronomancer. Spatial Attack Resistance is lent while held.
Stop (three times a day, 1.5% existence points, long cooldown). Time Stop: every foe within 12 blocks is frozen (heavy Slowness, Weakness and mining fatigue) for five seconds (three on players) and forgets its target; you move at Speed III and Haste III for the same time.
Hammertime. In the last two seconds of the stop (and a second after) your next blow with the hammer is a thunderous smite: +12 lightning damage, a shove and Slowness. Once per stop.
Tabletop became: 'Time Stop' = the freeze above, never a true halt; 'Thunderous Smite' = the smite; 'last round' = the last 40 ticks.
item.nusmp.time_hammer.desc: A chronomancer's stone hammer. Three times a day raise it and say Stop: every foe near you freezes for five seconds while you move at haste. Strike in the last two seconds and call Hammertime for a thunderous smite.
item.nusmp.vanguard_hammer.card:
Rare warhammer (8.5 damage). Requires attunement.
War Cry (once a day, long cooldown). You smash the ground and shout: every foe in a 12-block cone (60 degrees either side) takes 4 damage and may be frightened (75% on creatures, 40% on players, less with Tensura resistance): the Tensura effect Fear for a minute (8 seconds on players), and creatures run from you.
Tabletop became: 'DC 15 Wisdom save' = the fear chance; '1 minute' = 1200 ticks; 'must Dash away' = the Fear effect plus a flee order; '40 ft' = 12 blocks.
item.nusmp.vanguard_hammer.desc: A banded steel warhammer with a crimson ribbon. Once a day let out a war cry and smash the ground: every creature in a 12-block cone is frightened for a minute and runs from you.
item.nusmp.willbreaker.card:
Rare war hammer (8 damage). No attunement. The card prints no rarity.
The cries of its previous owners. On a critical hit the air fills with battle cries: the target and the foes within 3 blocks of it may be frightened (75% on creatures, 40% on players): the Tensura effect Fear for a minute (8 seconds on players).
Battle Cries (long cooldown). Call them on purpose: every foe within 6 blocks may be frightened.
Tabletop became: 'Critical Hit' = a vanilla critical blow (jumping and falling); 'Wisdom saving throw' = the fear chance.
item.nusmp.willbreaker.desc: A war hammer that carries the battle cries of its dead owners. A critical hit fills the air with them: the target, and the foes beside it, may be frightened. Call the cries on purpose to frighten everything close.
item.nusmp.dreamcore_woven_wand.card: Requires attunement. Spell focus: spell costs are 5% lower and chanting 5% faster. Dream Scryer (3 dreams a day in all, shared by the three dream keys): Sweet Dream (use) lets a creature in sight sleep well: an ally or you gain Regeneration and a little Absorption and lose fear, nausea and darkness; a foe drifts into a pleasant dream, is slowed and weakened and drops its target. Nightmare (sneak-use) traps a foe in fear, nausea and a stumble (a boss or another player only briefly). Wake (third key) ends every dream-like effect on a creature and gets a sleeper up. Read the Dream (fourth key, free) says whether a creature is in a nightmare, a neutral dream or a sweet dream, by the helpful and harmful effects on it. Tabletop replaced: +1 to spell attacks, damage and DC became a small Tensura spell-cost and chant-speed bonus; the command word became a key; the nightmare / neutral / sweet dream became the effects on the creature; 3 uses per day is a shared daily counter.
item.nusmp.dreamcore_woven_wand.desc: A twisted wand wrapped in crimson cloth, with a pink and blue dream-crystal at its tip. Use it to give a creature a sweet dream, sneak-use for a nightmare; two more keys wake a sleeper and read a creature's dream. Three dreams a day.
item.nusmp.lich_wand.card: Requires attunement. While you hold it: you need no air (Water Breathing), your food never falls below four drumsticks, the sleepless night never counts against you (no phantoms), and Tensura darkness attacks hurt less. Healing you receive grows 15% stronger but leaves you gaunt (Weakness for 5 seconds, at most once every 10 seconds). Each dawn the wand stores three different random necromancy spells out of eight (Ray of Sickness, Chill Touch, Vampiric Touch, Animate Dead, Blight, Bestow Curse, Fear, Speak with Dead); use casts the next stored one on the foe in sight (a spell with no target is not spent), sneak-use reads what is stored. Tabletop replaced: eyes of fire are the pale aura; no food or sleep became the hunger floor and the phantom reset; the withered flesh became the gaunt weakness; 3 random necromancy spells of random levels became 3 of 8 fixed-strength spells per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.lich_wand.desc: A bone wand ending in a skeletal claw, wreathed in green flame. You need no air, your belly never empties and the night never tires you, but healing leaves you gaunt. Each dawn it stores three random necromancy spells; use casts the next, sneak-use reads them.
item.nusmp.scepter_of_the_double_moon.ca: Requires attunement; can hold a Djinn. Magic damage you deal with an element is changed by the sky, doubled after the dice and rounded up (against a player no more than 45% of their health per blow). Day: fire, radiant and thunder doubled, cold halved. Night: cold, necrotic and lightning doubled, fire halved. Twilight (a dimension with no clear day and night): cold, necrotic, radiant and thunder doubled; fire, force and lightning halved. The element is read from the damage type of the spell (fire, freezing, lightning, sonic, holy, darkness, wither, magic). Use fires a Celestial Ray (a bolt of the favoured element: fire by day, frost by night, thunder at twilight); sneak-use reads the sky. Also +8% maximum magicules, spells cost 10% less, and you lend the Magic Sense skill. Tabletop replaced: spell damage dice became the final damage of an elemental hit; day, night and twilight became the world clock and the dimension type; the rubies and moons are cosmetic.
item.nusmp.scepter_of_the_double_moon.de: A marble orb set with rubies under two brass crescents. By day your fire, radiant and thunder spells hit twice as hard and cold half as hard; by night cold, necrotic and lightning double and fire halves; where there is no day or night the cold, necrotic, radiant and thunder double. Use for a Celestial Ray of the element the sky favours.
item.nusmp.serpant_head_staff.card: Requires attunement by a spellcaster. A +2 quarterstaff (eight damage) and a +2 spell focus (spells cost 10% less). Ten charges, 1d6+4 return at every dawn; when you spend the last one there is a 1 in 20 chance the staff falls dormant until the next dawn (it is never destroyed). Petrifying Gaze (use, 3 charges): the foe in sight within 12 blocks must pass a save against a DC of 13 plus your Luck (up to 6) or turns to stone for 4 seconds (Tensura petrification and a root); a boss is only slowed. Venom Strike (sneak-use toggles it): while on, each melee hit spends 1 charge and a snake head bites the nearest foe within 4.5 blocks (or the one you hit) for 3.5 magic damage and Poison. You lend Poison Resistance. Tabletop replaced: DC = your spell save DC became 13 plus Luck; 30 feet became 12 blocks (stretched for a ranged feel); 15 feet reach became 4.5 blocks; the d20 on the last charge became the dormancy chance.
item.nusmp.serpant_head_staff.desc: Silver serpents twined round a staff, each head holding an icy crystal. A +2 quarterstaff with ten charges that return at dawn. Use for a Petrifying Gaze (3 charges); sneak-use toggles Venom Strike, where each hit spends a charge and a snake head bites for you.
item.nusmp.staff_of_blood_magic.card: Requires attunement; for spellcasters. Casts spells without magicules and pays in blood: Blood Bolt (use, level 1: 5 damage), Blood Lance (sneak-use, level 3: 11 damage and slowed), Crimson Nova (third key, level 5: 20 damage to every foe within 6 blocks, weakened). The cost is one d10 per spell level, each pip a quarter heart scaled to your maximum health, never more than 60% of it and never enough to kill: two health is always left. Spells cost you 15% less when you do use magicules for other spells. Tabletop replaced: no spell slots became no magicule cost; 1d10 HP per spell level became the blood price above; a spell with no target costs nothing.
item.nusmp.staff_of_blood_magic.desc: A bone-grey staff circled by broken crescents round a red orb. It casts without magicules, paying in blood instead: use for a level 1 Blood Bolt, sneak-use for a level 3 Blood Lance, the third key for a level 5 Crimson Nova. It never takes your last two health.
item.nusmp.staff_of_ember_visions.card: Requires attunement. A +2 spell focus: spells cost 10% less and chanting is 10% faster; you lend Flame Attack Resistance. Three charges, back to full at every dawn. Ember Visions (use, 1 charge): harmless embers rise round you and a small magical flame follows you for 10 minutes in the shape you chose. Humanoid: burns up to two foes within 3.5 blocks (3 fire damage a second). Beast: ranges 6 blocks, burns two foes for 2 and quickens you. Hummingbird: lights every foe within 14 blocks (Glowing) and quickens you. Reshape Flame (sneak-use, free) changes the shape, now and for the next casting. Tabletop replaced: the animated flame creature became a light spirit that follows you (no entity, no state to clean up); reshape as an action became a free key.
item.nusmp.staff_of_ember_visions.desc: A slim black staff crowned with an ember-bud and a pale flame-bird. A +2 focus with three charges that return at dawn. Use to raise a small flame in the shape you chose for ten minutes; sneak-use reshapes it: humanoid, beast, hummingbird.
item.nusmp.staff_of_the_apprentice.card: Requires attunement. The staff is bound to one school of magic, rolled on a d8 the first time it is used, and holds two first-level spells of it: Abjuration (Shield, Protection from Good and Evil), Conjuration (Fog Cloud, Grease), Divination (Detect Magic, Comprehend Languages), Enchantment (Sleep, Charm Person), Evocation (Magic Missile, Burning Hands), Illusion (Silent Image, Color Spray), Necromancy (Ray of Sickness, Cause Fear), Transmutation (Feather Fall, Jump). Five charges, 1d4 back at every dawn. Use casts the first spell, sneak-use the second (1 charge each; a spell with no target is not spent). Study (third key, once a week) rolls a new school. Spells cost 5% less. Tabletop replaced: once a week replacing a spell became re-rolling the school; each spell became the nearest effect (Shield = Absorption and Resistance, Sleep = Tensura sleep on foes under 40 health, Magic Missile = three 2.5-damage darts, Detect Magic = Glowing on magical creatures, Comprehend Languages = the Telepathy skill and Luck, ...).
item.nusmp.staff_of_the_apprentice.desc: A gnarled staff of blue-violet crystals. It is bound to one school of magic (a d8) with two first-level spells of it; five charges, 1d4 back at dawn. Use for the first spell, sneak-use for the second; the third key studies a new school once a week.
item.nusmp.superlunary_staff.card: Requires attunement. Sunburst (use): every foe within 8 blocks is blinded half again as long as normal (the card's disadvantage on every save) and lit up with Glowing for 6 seconds. Breathless: you hold 8 more bubbles of breath and Tensura Silence is stripped from you every second, so you can speak spells anywhere. Starfinder: you see by starlight (Night Vision). Projection: Remember (third key) stores where you stand as an image (the last three places are kept); Project (sneak-use) draws a line of light towards each remembered place in this dimension and tells its distance and compass bearing. Tabletop replaced: images of things the caster has seen became remembered places; advantage on navigation became the night sight and the bearings; spell components became the silence cleanse.
item.nusmp.superlunary_staff.desc: A bronze staff with orbiting gold rings round a small sun. Use for a Sunburst that dazzles everything near you for half again as long. You speak freely out of breath and out of silence, and see by starlight. Sneak-use projects the places the staff remembers; the third key remembers where you stand.
item.nusmp.the_bifrost.card: Requires attunement; can hold a Djinn. While you wield it your body is ringed with Light Rukh like rainbows; you move 5% faster and have 10% more maximum magicules. Gate (use, once a week, 2% existence points): the rainbow bridge carries you and the friends within 3 blocks (allies, your pets and summons, never a spectator or creative player) to your bed or respawn anchor, or the world spawn if you have none; across dimensions it carries only you. It will not open inside the Labyrinth. Rainbow Road (sneak-use toggles it): footprints of light behind you and Speed I while you walk. Tabletop replaced: the Gate spell once per week became a seven-day cooldown and a fixed destination (home); rainbow footprints are particles only and change no block.
item.nusmp.the_bifrost.desc: A white and gold quarterstaff trailing rainbow light. While you wield it your body is ringed with rainbows. Once a week use it to open a Gate: the rainbow bridge carries you and your companions home. Sneak-use toggles Rainbow Road: footprints of light and a little speed.
item.nusmp.wand_o_wisp.card: No attunement. Seven charges. Faerie Fire (use, 1 charge): every foe within 10 blocks glows and takes 15% more damage from every blow for 20 seconds. Summon Wisp (sneak-use, 3 charges): a will-o-wisp joins you for one minute (at most two) and each second strikes one foe within 12 blocks for 3 magic damage. When every charge is spent the wand refills d8-1 at the next dawn; on a 0 it sulks and refills nothing that day (it does not break and no wisps turn on you). You lend Light Attack Resistance. Tabletop replaced: the wisp creature became a light spirit that follows you (no entity); the wand breaking and its wisps attacking you became the sulk; 60 feet became 12 blocks.
item.nusmp.wand_o_wisp.desc: A silver needle with a teal crystal grip and two fluttering wisps. Seven charges. Use for Faerie Fire (1 charge): foes around you glow and take 15% more damage. Sneak-use summons a will-o-wisp (3 charges) that fights for you for a minute. When it is empty it refills d8-1 at dawn; on a 0 it sulks.
item.nusmp.wand_of_spider_summoning.card: Requires attunement. Eight charges, 1d6+1 back at every dawn. Spider (use, 1 charge): a spider fights for you for one minute. Spider Swarm (sneak-use, 2 charges): four cave spiders. Large Spider (third key, 3 charges): a great black spider (Tensura's, or a strong spider where Tensura is absent). Spending the last charge has a 1 in 20 chance of putting the wand to sleep until the next dawn (it never turns into a spider and runs away). At most six summons of yours exist at once. You lend Poison Resistance. Tabletop replaced: the d20 on an empty wand became the dormancy chance; the swarm monster became four cave spiders.
item.nusmp.wand_of_spider_summoning.desc: A spiked black wand like a spider's leg with a magenta thorn blade. Eight charges, 1d6+1 back at dawn. Use to summon a spider (1 charge), sneak-use a swarm of cave spiders (2), the third key a great black spider (3), each for a minute.
item.nusmp.windwheel_staff.card: Requires attunement. A +1 arcane focus: spells cost 5% less; you lend Wind Attack Resistance and Electricity Resistance. Every spell you cast (a drop of at least 1% of your maximum magicules) stores wind charges equal to its level (one per 2% spent, 1 to 5) up to 10; the charges last one minute from the last one gained. Discharge (use): the foe in sight within 18 blocks takes 3.5 lightning damage per charge (1d6 on average); a target that passes its save (DC 13 and up) takes half. The card's last line reads as reversed (a failed save halves the damage); the sensible reading, a successful save halves, is used. Tabletop replaced: spell level became the share of magicules spent; the dexterity save became the save every relic uses against a foe; 1 minute stayed a minute.
item.nusmp.windwheel_staff.desc: A blue-steel ring on a red-brown staff, a pinwheel crystal spinning inside. A +1 focus. Every spell you cast (magicules spent) stores wind charges equal to its level for a minute; use to discharge them as lightning, 1d6 each (a target that braces takes half).
item.nusmp.divine_mercy.desc: A longbow whose limbs are the golden wings of an angel. Every arrow lands 3 harder and burns with radiant light, twice as much on a fiend or an undead. Once a day, sneak and use to pass the Sentence on the next arrow: a creature of 100 health or less takes a crushing blow unless it saves.
item.nusmp.divine_mercy.card:
Legend Grade longbow (requires attunement). A longbow whose limbs are the golden wings of an angel.
Blessed Arrows. Every arrow that lands deals 3 more damage and 7 radiant (holy) damage; 14 against a fiend or an undead.
Divine Sentence (sneak + use, once a day, 3% magicules). The next arrow that lands on a creature of 100 health or less passes the Sentence: a crushing blow of 55% of its maximum health (halved if it saves, 35% chance). Never an instant death; a player takes at most 30% of their health from it.
Lends Holy Resistance.
Tabletop became: +3 to attack and damage = +3 damage; 2d8/4d8 radiant = 7/14; instant death on a failed DC 15 Constitution save = a heavy blow, saving throw = a 35% chance to halve it.
item.nusmp.embrasure.desc: A longbow of living vine with a red crystal grip. Sneak and use to say "Protect me!": for one round (6 seconds) a magical shield wraps the bow and you. Twice, then it needs a short rest of four minutes.
item.nusmp.embrasure.card:
Special Grade longbow. Should I equip a shield? Or a bow? Why not both!
Protect me! (sneak + use). For one round (6 seconds) a magical shield wraps the bow: Resistance, Speed and 2 hearts of absorption. Two uses, then four minutes of short rest.
Tabletop became: +2 AC for this round = Resistance and absorption for 6 s; reaction = sneak + use; two uses then a short rest = a counter that locks for four minutes.
item.nusmp.the_dragons_spirit.desc: A slim recurve of dark wood with dragon-claw crystal tips. Its spirit gives you foresight (area and missile harm is softer). Sneak and use for Dragon's Claw (three half-strength arrows at three foes, twice a day); the worn-relic key calls Dragon's Sight (every few minutes) and Dragonstrike (once a day).
item.nusmp.the_dragons_spirit.card:
Rare Grade longbow (requires attunement). The serpent dragon's spirit flows through you.
Foresight. Danger Sense is lent and explosions and missiles hurt you 15% less (advantage on Dexterity saves).
Dragon's Sight (worn-relic key, every 3 minutes). An ethereal arrow to the point you look at: within 6 blocks every creature glows (invisible ones are revealed), traps (tripwires, pressure plates, dispensers, TNT, sculk sensors, spawners) are marked, and you get night vision, Haste and Eye of Truth for 15 s.
Dragon's Claw (sneak + use, twice a day, 2% magicules). Three ethereal arrows at up to three foes in sight, 5 damage each (a lone foe takes all three).
Dragonstrike (worn-relic key, once a day, 4% magicules). A spirit 20 blocks long and one wide flies along your sight through walls: 14 force damage, half on a save (40%).
Tabletop became: 30 ft = 6 blocks, 100 ft = 20 blocks, 5 ft wide = 1 block, Dex save = a 40% chance for half damage.
item.nusmp.the_reaver.desc: A black thorned longbow forged by a demon lord. Every arrow lands 2 harder. Twice a day, sneak and use to loose a Barbed Arrow on a demonic chain: it bites deep and drags a Large or smaller foe onto the bow's spike.
item.nusmp.the_reaver.card:
Unique Grade longbow (requires attunement). Crafted by a sinister demon lord for a dark hero who sold his soul for power.
Demonic Bonus. Every arrow that lands deals 2 more damage.
Barbed Arrow (sneak + use, twice a day, 2% magicules). A chained arrow: 10 blocks, up to 20 at a smaller blow. It deals 6 plus 3.5 embedded; a creature of Large size or smaller (no more than two blocks in either measure), not a boss, that fails its Strength save (30% resists) is dragged to the bow and impaled for 7 more.
Tabletop became: 2 charges regained at dawn = 2 uses per Minecraft day; 50/100 ft = 10/20 blocks; DC 17 Strength save = a 30% chance to resist.
item.nusmp.warlute.desc: A crimson lute with a blade for a tail and a crossbow at the neck. Load and shoot it as a crossbow, or cut with the blade. Sneak and use to strike the Chord of Valor on an ally: Luck, Strength and Speed for a minute, stronger if you struck with the lute in the last round.
item.nusmp.warlute.card:
Rare Grade lute-crossbow (requires attunement). Load and shoot it as a crossbow, or strike with its blade.
Chord of Valor (sneak + use, 3 a day, 1% magicules). The ally in your sight (never yourself, once a day each) gains Luck, Strength, Speed and Inspiration for a minute.
Rhythm of Battle. If you struck with the lute (blade or bolt) in the last 6 seconds the chord is one step stronger.
Tabletop became: advantage on the next roll = Luck and Inspiration; Charisma modifier uses = 3; Bardic Inspiration die +1/+2 = one amplifier step on the beat.
item.nusmp.aegis_of_the_abyss.desc: A black shield carved as a snarling demon whose mouth holds a galaxy. +3 armour; spells hit you 25% softer and Magic Resistance is lent. Arcane Hunger swallows a spell by itself, twice a day, for yourself or an ally within two blocks, and feeds you absorption; one of more than 90 damage cracks it for the day.
item.nusmp.aegis_of_the_abyss.card:
Legend Grade shield (requires attunement).
AC +3: +3 armour and 2 toughness while held. It blocks like a shield while use is held.
Spellguard. Magic Resistance is lent and spells hit you 25% softer.
Arcane Hunger (automatic, twice a day). The shield swallows a spell aimed at you or at an ally within 2 blocks and feeds you absorption hearts (half the damage swallowed, up to 10). A spell of more than 90 damage cracks it: it hungers no more that day.
Tabletop became: reaction = automatic; 10 ft = 2 blocks; advantage on saves, disadvantage on spell attacks = resistance and 25% less spell damage.
item.nusmp.celestial_support.desc: A winged kite shield of speckled stone with a blue rim. +2 armour. When a heavy melee blow lands (a third of your health) you strike back at once, and a blow that would drop you to zero leaves you standing instead, once every five minutes.
item.nusmp.celestial_support.card:
Unique Grade shield (requires attunement).
Defense: +2 armour while held; blocks while use is held.
Riposte. When a melee blow of at least 35% of your maximum health lands on you, you strike back at once (8 damage, every 5 seconds).
Death Save (+2 on death saving throws). A blow that would drop you to zero leaves you standing on a half-heart, with Regeneration and Resistance, once every five minutes.
Tabletop became: critical hit = a blow of 35% of your health; reaction attack = an immediate riposte; +2 death saves = a five-minute survival once.
item.nusmp.heros_shield.desc: An ice-blue kite shield with a silver maze and a glowing gem. +3 armour, steadier on your feet, and nonmagical weapons strike you 25% softer. Use it to hurl it at a foe (6 blocks, 18 at a disadvantage); it bashes hard in melee.
item.nusmp.heros_shield.card:
Legend Grade shield (requires attunement, lawful alignment: the attunement ritual stands for it).
Magic shield: +3 armour, 2 toughness, 30% knockback resistance (the +3 on all saving throws).
Resistance to nonmagical weapons: blades, fists, arrows and thrown things hurt you 25% less.
Shield Throw (use, 2.5 s cooldown). The shield flies to the first creature in sight (6 blocks; up to 18 at 70% of the blow): 8 damage and a shove, and is in your hand again. In melee it bashes for 8.
Tabletop became: 30/90 ft = 6/18 blocks; 2d6+mod = 8; resistance = 25%.
item.nusmp.thunder_shield.desc: A round steel-blue shield veined with live lightning. +3 armour. While it is in your hand, lightning cannot hurt you or your allies within twelve blocks.
item.nusmp.thunder_shield.card:
Rare Grade shield (no rarity printed, rated Rare).
Grants +3 armour while held and blocks while use is held; lends Lightning Resistance.
Storm-Proof. While it is in your hand, lightning cannot hurt you or your allies (pets, summons, team mates) within 12 blocks.
item.nusmp.bewitching_lyre.desc: A serpentine lyre of glossy pink wood with eight charges. Use to sing an Enchantment: foes within ten blocks save or lose the will to fight; sneak to spend a charge and no one saves. Perform for a willing audience of twelve (the second act) to win every charge back.
item.nusmp.bewitching_lyre.card:
Rare Grade lyre (requires attunement by a bard: the attunement ritual stands for it).
Bewitching Song (worn-relic key, 10 s cooldown, 2% magicules). Foes within 10 blocks save against the song (50%, 20% for a boss) or lose their will to fight: Slowness, Weakness, Fear and their target forgotten for 8 s. Sneak while using to spend one of its 8 charges: nobody saves.
Performance (hold use for 3 s). With at least 12 willing listeners within 12 blocks (no enemy, none hunting you) a 70% good performance brings all 8 charges back.
Tabletop became: expend a charge = sneak to spend; 12 creatures and a DC 15 Performance check = 12 listeners and a 70% roll.
item.nusmp.eye_of_the_deep_one.desc: A dark green ring of tentacles round a glowing blue eye. You see in the dark and are hard to shove or seize. After each long rest it rolls a boon for you (a d4). Use for an Eldritch Blast; the second act closes tentacles on a foe in reach.
item.nusmp.eye_of_the_deep_one.card:
Rare Grade ring (requires attunement by a warlock: the attunement ritual stands for it).
Vision of the Abyss. Night vision while worn, and Darkness resistance.
Strength of the Old One. 30% knockback resistance (resisting a grapple); the second act closes tentacles on a creature in reach: held fast for 4 s (2 s for a boss), weakened and bruised.
Eldritch Blast (first act). A beam 20 blocks long: 5 magic damage.
Ancient Twisted Magic. After each long rest (sleeping through the night, or every two days awake) a d4 is rolled: 1 Warded Mind (spells hit you 10% softer), 2 Sharpened Mind (+10% magicule regeneration), 3 Twisted Blast (+2 necrotic on Eldritch Blast), 4 Abyssal Hide (+1 armour).
Tabletop became: 100 ft dark vision = night vision; grapple bonus = knockback resistance and a grapple act; spell DC / attack = the four boons above.
item.nusmp.horn_of_leroy.desc: A black hunting horn with a heart cut into the bell. Blow it and every ally within a hundred blocks charges with you for five minutes. Fell eight hostile creatures before the time is up and your luck grows for good; fail and you are handed a bucket of chicken. The horn crumbles and is whole again after five days.
item.nusmp.horn_of_leroy.card:
Legend Grade horn.
Alright Chums, Let's Do This (worn-relic key). Every ally within 100 blocks (pets, summons, team mates) charges with you for 5 minutes (6 hours of a 24-hour day): Strength, Speed, Resistance and Inspiration; you get Strength II and Luck V (+10 persuasion). Fell 8 hostile creatures before the time is up and you gain +1 Charisma for good (+0.5 Luck, at most five times); fail, or fall, and a bucket of chicken appears. The horn crumbles and is whole again after five days (the cooldown).
Tabletop became: 500 ft = 100 blocks; permanent +1 Charisma = a permanent Luck bonus on a Luck attribute modifier; the crumbling = a five-day cooldown (the item is never destroyed).
item.nusmp.instant_cooking_pot.desc: A scorched grey saucepan that works like a microwave. Use it: the raw food in your hands or pack is cooked after a d4 of five-second steps.
item.nusmp.instant_cooking_pot.card:
Carried as a Charm. No attunement.
Cook (use): the pot takes up to sixteen raw foods from your hands (or, failing that, your pack): raw beef, porkchop, chicken, mutton, rabbit, cod, salmon, potato, kelp or chorus fruit. It rolls a d4 and cooks them for that many five-second steps (5 to 20 seconds); then it pings and the cooked food drops into your pack (or at your feet if it is full). One batch at a time; the timer is saved, so it still finishes if you log out or die.
Tabletop became: "works like a microwave" is the cooking table; "roll a 1d4, that is the time it takes" is the d4 of five-second steps.
item.nusmp.lucky_egg.desc: A black-and-silver egg on a gold chain. Twice a day kiss it: the next heavy blow against you is rolled again, never worse, and Luck rises for half a minute.
item.nusmp.lucky_egg.card:
Carried as a Charm. No attunement.
Luck: while carried, +1 Luck (loot and fishing).
Kiss the Egg (twice per Minecraft day, the long rest): the egg is armed for 30 seconds and you gain Luck II for the same time. The next real blow against you (2 health or more, after armour) is rolled again: it is cut to between 30% and 80% of what it was, so a reroll is never worse. The egg is used up for that blow.
Tabletop became: "interrupt action, force any die to be rerolled, like the Lucky feat" is the armed reroll of the next heavy hit; "twice per day" is twice per Minecraft day.
item.nusmp.lumpy.desc: A sentient felt hand puppet in a blue wizard hat who talks only to you, and mostly to insult you sweetly. Mage Hand pulls items and presses levers, Message calls other players, Detect Thoughts reads the minds around you.
item.nusmp.lumpy.card:
Carried as a Charm. No attunement.
Lumpy talks only to the one who wears him, through Tensura's Telepathy (lent while worn). He speaks in a sweet, child-friendly voice and says scathing things: after a hard blow, a kill, when you are at a quarter of your health or when you fall, at most once a minute.
Mage Hand (use): a spectral hand presses the lever, button, door, trapdoor or fence gate you look at within 8 blocks (not in the Labyrinth), and pulls every dropped item within 10 blocks to you.
Message: whispers your name and position to every other player within 64 blocks.
Detect Thoughts (costs a little mana): every creature within 16 blocks glows for 8 seconds and Lumpy reads out what the six nearest are thinking (whom they want to hurt). A wearer of the Ring of Memories who sealed a memory is a blank wall.
Tabletop became: the cantrips Mage Hand and Message and the 2nd-level spell Detect Thoughts are the three acts; telepathic speech is the lent Telepathy skill plus the chat remarks.
item.nusmp.monster_compass.desc: A red lacquered case with a slit-pupil eye. Open the lid and the needle points to the nearest hostile monster; the darker the eye, the stronger the monster.
item.nusmp.monster_compass.card:
Carried as a Charm. No attunement.
Open the Lid (toggle): while open, once a second the action bar shows an arrow (relative to where you face), the distance in blocks and the colour of the eye for the nearest hostile monster within 64 blocks. The darker the eye, the stronger the monster: pale gold, amber, ember red, crimson, black (a boss is always black); strength is its health plus three times its attack damage.
Tabletop became: "points to the nearest hostile monster" is the arrow; "the darker the eye the higher the challenge rating" is the five eye colours.
item.nusmp.official_looking_badge.desc: A gold badge of two crossed hammers that nobody can place, and everyone respects. Villagers trade kindly with you and luck is on your side; show it to make weak monsters back off.
item.nusmp.official_looking_badge.card:
Carried as a Charm. No attunement.
Respect: while carried you gain Hero of the Village (villagers trade kindly) and +1 Luck.
Show the Badge (use): ordinary hostile creatures within 8 blocks (under 60 health, no bosses) lose their nerve (Tensura Fear for 5 seconds) and stop hunting you for 10 seconds.
Tabletop became: +1 Charisma is +1 Luck; "advantage on Persuasion" is Hero of the Village; "advantage on Intimidation and Deception" is the badge that scares weak monsters off.
item.nusmp.orb_of_plagues.desc: A murky olive orb in a cage of black thorns, ten charges, 1d6+3 back at dawn. Rays of sickness and enfeeblement, a stinking cloud, blight and contagion; or smash it for a plague cloud that ruins the orb.
item.nusmp.orb_of_plagues.card:
Requires attunement. Carried as a Charm.
Charges: the orb holds 10 charges and regains 1d6+3 for every new Minecraft day, up to 10. Used with no charges left, roll a d20: on a 1 it shatters in a weak cloud, otherwise it only tells you it is empty.
Ray of Sickness (1 charge): the creature in your look within 20 blocks takes 2d8 magic damage and is poisoned for 10 seconds.
Ray of Enfeeblement (2): Weakness II, Slowness and Fragility for 18 seconds.
Stinking Cloud (3): a cloud of 4 blocks radius where you look: Poison and Nausea for 12 seconds.
Blight (4): 4d8 magic damage and Wither.
Contagion (5): one of six diseases (Blinding Sickness, Filth Fever, Flesh Rot, Mindfire, Seizure, Slimy Doom), each a pair of effects for 30 seconds.
Every effect lets the victim save (d20 plus a point per ten health against a difficulty class of 13 to 15): a saved throw halves the time (or the damage); a boss halves it again.
Plague Cloud (sneak and use): smash the orb: every creature within 7 blocks (not you) is struck with a disease, the save against 10 plus the charges left. The orb is destroyed.
Detect Poison and Disease (free): creatures within 24 blocks that are poisoned or sick glow for 8 seconds. While carried you are lent Tensura's Poison Resistance.
Tabletop became: spell slots are charges; ability checks are d20 saves; 35 ft is 7 blocks; Constitution saves are the health bonus; a ritual costs nothing.
item.nusmp.orb_of_the_dryad.desc: A carved golden-brown orb wreathed in green mist. It floats beside you and sheds light; once a day it flies at a creature, heals all it passes through, and hovers over its target healing for a few rounds.
item.nusmp.orb_of_the_dryad.card:
Requires attunement (the card asks for a druid or monk; any attuned bearer may use it). Carried as a Charm.
Nature's Light (toggle): the orb floats beside you and sheds light: you gain night vision while it shines.
Healing Flight (once per Minecraft day, the long rest): the orb flies at the friendly creature in your look within 20 blocks (or, if there is none, back to you). It heals every creature it passes through for 1d4+1 health, heals the target for 1d4+1 on arrival and again three more times, six seconds apart (the following three rounds), then returns to you if you are within 20 blocks (it does not heal on the way back). It is ethereal: it flies through one solid block but a thick wall stops it. It never heals hostile monsters.
Tabletop became: 100 ft is 20 blocks; 3 rounds is 18 seconds; the light radius is night vision because the world cannot be lit without editing blocks.
item.nusmp.pocket_time.desc: A round golden pocket watch with Roman numerals. Once a day it rolls a d12 and the day jumps forward to the next time the clock shows that hour.
item.nusmp.pocket_time.card:
Carried as a Charm. No attunement.
Pocket Time (once per Minecraft day): rolls a d12 and the day jumps forward to the next time the clock shows that hour (the hour or the one twelve hours later, whichever comes first; at most 12 hours). The whole world's time moves, not only yours. It does nothing in the Labyrinth or in a dimension whose time is fixed.
Tabletop became: "travel forward in time to that hour of the day" is a skip of the world clock to the next time that hour shows.
item.nusmp.ring_of_endless_rage.desc: A silver band with a ruby between two crescents. The blow that would kill you crushes the ruby: for 30 seconds you cannot die and cannot be healed, then three death saves decide how you wake. The ring is gone.
item.nusmp.ring_of_endless_rage.card:
Requires attunement (the card asks for a barbarian; any attuned bearer may wear it). Carried as a Charm.
The blow that would kill you (after armour and absorption) instead crushes the ruby: you are left on half a heart and rage for 30 seconds. While raging you cannot die (damage can never take you under half a heart), you cannot be healed, and you have Strength II and Speed. When the rage ends you roll three death saves (d20, ten or more holds): 3 saves wake you at half health with Regeneration, 2 at 30%, 1 at 10% weak and slow, none at half a heart, weak, slow and hungry. Nothing kills outright. The ring is used up and cannot be used again.
Tabletop became: "drop to zero hit points, crush the ruby" is the lethal blow; "stabilised, cannot die, cannot be healed" is the guarded 30 seconds; the death saves decide the aftermath instead of death.
item.nusmp.ring_of_memories.desc: A dark band wound with wire round a pale cyan crystal. It records where you have walked. Remember stores the journey, Relive plays it back in a ten-second trance once a day, Erase clears it.
item.nusmp.ring_of_memories.card:
Requires attunement. Carried as a Charm.
While worn the ring records your path every two seconds (the last five minutes of it, nothing older than a week).
Remember (use): stores that journey as the ring's one memory. Sneak and use to keep no recollection of it: the memory is sealed (its place stays hidden from you and no mind-reader finds it).
Relive (once per Minecraft day): a ten-second trance replays the memory as a ghostly trail of light; near the place it plays out on the spot, from afar as a small replay before you, sparser the farther you are. You cannot move and cannot see your surroundings, and any damage breaks the trance. At its end you are told where and how long ago it was.
Erase (sneak and use): the memory is gone for good, making room for another.
Tabletop became: "record up to 1 hour" is up to five minutes of trail; "within the past week" is a week of game time; "once a day" is once per Minecraft day; "unaware of surroundings" is slowness and blindness.
item.nusmp.ring_of_power.desc: An infinity stone of power and destruction in a clawed rose-bronze ring. More strength, extra force with every weapon blow, and once a day Disintegrate.
item.nusmp.ring_of_power.card:
Requires attunement. Carried as a Charm; can be bound as a Djinn Metal Vessel.
Power: +2 attack damage while worn (strength, ignoring the usual limit).
Destruction: every weapon attack you make deals 1d8 more force damage (at most 4 more on a player).
Disintegrate (once per Minecraft day, costs 3% existence points): a ray of 30 blocks that deals 10d6 force damage to the creature in your look; a creature it kills turns to dust and drops nothing (the experience still falls). Damage on players goes through the usual cap.
Tabletop became: +2 STR is +2 attack damage; "1d8 force on weapon attacks" is the same die on every blow; 1/day Disintegrate is the once-a-day ray.
item.nusmp.ring_of_regeneration.desc: A wooden band carved with vines and green leaves. Every twenty seconds you regain 1d6 health while you are hurt, and crippling effects, poisons and sicknesses wither away twice as fast.
item.nusmp.ring_of_regeneration.card:
Requires attunement. Carried as a Charm.
Regeneration: while you are hurt and have at least a half heart, the ring heals you 1d6 health every 20 seconds, and Tensura's Self-Regeneration is lent to you while it is worn.
Regrowth: every five seconds each crippling effect on you (Slowness, Weakness, Mining Fatigue, Wither, Poison, Blindness, Nausea and Tensura's Fragility, Infection, Corrosion, Paralysis, Petrification) is cut in half, and ends when under five seconds are left.
Tabletop became: 1d6 HP every 10 minutes is 1d6 every 20 seconds; lost limbs regrowing after 1d6+1 days is the fast fade of crippling effects (the game has no lost limbs).
item.nusmp.ring_of_rock_eating.desc: Your belly learns to digest stone: eat cobblestone, gravel and flint to fill your hunger, and a hungry belly grinds a rock or two by itself. The Mines' own metal hardens you a little.
item.nusmp.ring_of_rock_eating.card: Ring, rare (attunement). This ring was crafted with the strongest materials the Mines of Dimlodir have to offer. While you wear it your body digests rocks. Eat Rocks (use): eats up to eight pieces of stone, cobblestone, deepslate, andesite, diorite, granite, tuff, basalt, blackstone, sandstone, terracotta, netherrack or end stone from your inventory (one food point each; gravel and flint half a point; quartz and amethyst a point and a half; ores are never eaten) for as much hunger as you are missing, with a little saturation, 2 seconds of cooldown. When your hunger drops to four drumsticks or less the ring eats up to two rocks by itself every five seconds. The Mines' metal also gives +1 armour and 10% knockback resistance while worn. Replaced rules: 'gain nourishment from rocks' is the food bar; the strongest materials are the small armour and knockback bonus.
item.nusmp.ring_of_the_game.desc: Every few minutes you think of The Game and lose: a stab of psychic pain and maybe a loud curse that draws monsters. In return you can pass The Game on to the foes around you.
item.nusmp.ring_of_the_game.card: Ring, rare (cursed). A plain black iron ring engraved in Infernal: The Game. Curse: every few minutes (the card's 30 minutes is about two and a half real minutes of play, counted even while the ring is off, so swapping it does not reset it) you think of The Game and lose it: you take 1d4 psychic damage (never the last health point, never more than 30% of your maximum), and you make a Wisdom save (DC 15 with +2): on a failure you curse loudly, everyone within 32 blocks reads it in chat and up to twelve hostile monsters within sixteen blocks turn on you. Pass the Game (use, about three minutes cooldown): you speak The Game aloud and every hostile foe within ten blocks loses it: 2 to 5 magic damage and confusion for five seconds. The Game resists magic: nothing in this relic can be dispelled or silenced. Replaced rules: the unremovable ring and 'one ring at a time' are not enforced (the curse timer is the cost of wearing it); saving throws are a d20 roll against the DC; Infernal is flavour.
item.nusmp.ring_of_the_mimic.desc: It trembles near mimics within ten blocks and lights them up. Its Guidance brings luck for a minute, but on a bad roll it spins, devours your finger and breaks its bond.
item.nusmp.ring_of_the_mimic.card: Ring, uncommon (attunement). Anything you can do, I can do better. While attuned the ring trembles in the presence of mimics within ten blocks (30 ft), even unrevealed: they glow and the ring says so. Guidance (use, bonus action, no concentration, 30 seconds cooldown): Luck I for a minute and a short Inspiration, for a stand-in for the +1d4 to a skill check. Curse: on a natural 1 (1 in 20 each use) the ring begins to spin and devours your finger: you take 1d12 damage (never lethal, at most 30% of maximum health), the ring's attunement is broken, and for ten minutes you are slower and clumsier (attack speed -15%, mining speed -25%) until magic mends the finger (eat a golden apple) or the time passes. The ring can be attuned again, to a new finger. Replaced rules: the skill check is Luck and Inspiration; slashing damage is plain damage; 'regain the finger through magical means' is a golden apple or time.
item.nusmp.rose_petal.desc: A ghost-white rose that blooms into a thorned halberd: more damage and reach, thorns for those who strike you. With its twelve charges (2d6+2 back at dawn) it ensnares a foe, drags crowds in with vines, or makes you a Great Tree or a Primal Beast.
item.nusmp.rose_petal.card: Wondrous item, artifact (attunement; the card says by a paladin: any wearer here). Partial card (the text may continue below the image): what is printed is played in full and a remainder is invented. Bloom (use, toggle): the rose becomes a halberd in the hand: +2 attack damage and +1.5 blocks of reach while it is open; use again to fold it. Invented remainder: while in halberd form, anything that strikes you in melee takes 2 thorn damage. Snare: 12 charges, regains 2d6+2 at dawn (stored on the item). In halberd form, spells cost charges: Ensnaring Strike (1): your next blow within half a minute adds 3-4 damage and roots the target for six seconds; Grasping Vine (4): thorned vines in a nine-block radius deal 5 damage to each foe, root it for five seconds and drag it a little towards you; Guardian of Nature (4): choose Primal Beast (strength, speed, night vision and jump boost for a minute) or, sneaking, Great Tree (ten points of temporary health, resistance and regeneration for a minute). Replaced rules: +2 to attack and damage rolls is +2 damage; spell save DC is the foe's saving chance replaced by the damage and roots above; 30-foot and 20-foot areas are nine blocks.
item.nusmp.silver_tongued_lyre.desc: A devil's lyre: spells cost a little less, you can cast Hideous Laughter at a foe eighteen blocks away, and once a day a Hellish Dissonance rips necrotic damage through every humanoid and celestial that can hear it.
item.nusmp.silver_tongued_lyre.card: Wondrous item, rare (attunement by a bard; any wearer here). Infernal Muse: your spells cost 5% less. Devil's Grin: Hideous Laughter (use, 2% of your magic, 20 seconds cooldown): the foe you face within eighteen blocks (the card's range plus 30 ft) is slowed to a crawl, weakened and left nauseous and confused for six seconds (three if it shakes it off, a 45% chance). Hellish Dissonance (use once per day, 3% of your magic): every hostile humanoid or celestial that can hear you within eighteen blocks (90 ft) takes 4d6 necrotic damage, halved with a 45% save (a celestial saves at disadvantage), and is weakened for twelve seconds (the card's disadvantage on attack rolls). Replaced rules: spell attack bonus is the small spell cost cut; Wisdom saves are percent chances; humanoid and celestial are matched by entity id (people, illagers, piglins, goblins, orcs, lizardmen, the walking dead, angels).
item.nusmp.soup_spoon_of_improbability.d: Merely having it emboldens you: a little more damage and a quicker arm. Once a day try a steady sip: it holds off weakness, slowness and the like for a while, but a spill costs you the boldness until dawn.
item.nusmp.soup_spoon_of_improbability.c: Trinket, one of a kind (grade as printed: unknown, played as special). At first glance it does not seem to do much. Merely having it emboldens you: +1 attack damage and +0.2 attack speed while it is on you (the card's +1 to Strength and Dexterity checks). Steady Sip (use once a day): you try to drink with the spoon; 60% of the time it is a perfect sip (the card's DC 15 Dexterity check): for five minutes, weakness, slowness, mining fatigue, blindness, nausea, darkness, confusion and fear of mild strength (up to level II) fade at once (the card's no disadvantage for an hour). If you carry a potion it is the liquid you drink and you get its effects; with none it is a cool sip of water. On a failure you spill it, are embarrassed, and lose the spoon's boldness until the next dawn (the long rest).
item.nusmp.spirit_lantern.desc: It sheds a cold blue light that lets you see in the dark and picks out undead near you. Hold its light on fresh remains and the ghost of the dead rises to tell you how it died.
item.nusmp.spirit_lantern.card: Wondrous item, uncommon. This lantern emits a cold blue light in a 20 ft radius: while it is on you, dark places are lit to your eyes (night vision where the light is low) and undead within six blocks glow so you can see them. Shine on the Dead (hold the use button for five seconds, ten seconds cooldown): if something died within six blocks in the last day while you carried the lantern (it must have been near you at the time), the ghost of the dead rises above the remains with a swirl of cold light for five seconds and you read where it died, how long ago, to whom, and what it held. It is silent and shows nobody else who was there. Replaced rules: a minute of shining is five seconds; acting out the last five minutes of life is that report (the death place, the killer and the item in hand), as the game does not record more.
item.nusmp.the_forgotten_ring.desc: An elven ring of malice. Vanish at will; mobs lose you beyond six blocks. You stay hidden until you strike, cast, use it again or take it off, and your first blow from hiding hits half again as hard.
item.nusmp.the_forgotten_ring.card: Ring, legendary (attunement). No mortal crafted this ring; it emanates anger, malice and hatred. Vanish (use, 2% of your magic, 5 seconds cooldown): you turn invisible, and monsters lose you beyond six blocks. You stay hidden until you attack, deal spell damage, use the ring again, or take it off. Your first blow from hiding hits for half again its damage (the trickster's strike). Replaced rules: 'anything you wear or carry is invisible with you' is vanilla's rule (armour and held items still show); the bonus action is the same use; casting a spell is dealing magic damage.
item.nusmp.witchs_ring.desc: Turn into a small beast (cat, frog, bat, owl, rat, raven, spider or goat) for two card-hours a day. Sneak and use it to change the beast, once a night.
item.nusmp.witchs_ring.card: Ring, uncommon (attunement). It lets you turn into a beast for up to two card-hours (five minutes) a day. The first time, the ring rolls a d8 for your beast: cat, frog, bat, owl, rat, raven, spider or goat. Shapechange (use, 3 seconds cooldown): become the beast, shrunk to its size, with its gifts: cat (night vision, jump, quickness), frog (high jump, water breathing, swimming grace), bat (night vision, slow falling, jump), owl (night vision, slow falling, luck), rat (speed, night vision), raven (slow falling, high jump, luck), spider (night vision, high jump, a poisonous bite), goat (very high jump, strength, 50% knockback resistance). Use again to end it early; the unused time is kept until dawn. Change the Beast (sneak and use, once a day, the card's each night): the ring picks the next beast on the list (warlocks and druids choose: here everyone chooses by stepping through the list). Replaced rules: the Monster Manual stat blocks are the effects above; the daily time is in game ticks.
