item.nusmp.bucket_of_disguise.desc: You truly believe you are invisible, and the thoughts of everyone near you drift into your head. Whatever has you in its sights thinks about it out loud.
item.nusmp.bucket_of_disguise.card: Wondrous item (grade as printed: unknown, played as special), attunement implied. Created by the Trickster God. You truly believe you are invisible: you are told so once each day, and are certain of it. The quality only the attuned discover: you hear thoughts that are not your own: every five seconds the thoughts of a creature within twelve blocks drift into your head, and a creature that has you in its sights (within sixteen blocks) gives away its intent first. A mild Tensura thought communication is lent while worn. Replaced rules: the wearer's belief in invisibility is only a belief: the bucket does not make you invisible.
item.nusmp.corpse_mask.desc: It drinks in the faces of humanoids that die near you (five at most). Twice a day wear one for five minutes: its own kind will not pick you as a target. Sneak and use it to choose the face.
item.nusmp.corpse_mask.card: Wondrous item, rare. Face of the Dead (use, twice a day): for five minutes (the card's 1 hour) you take the appearance of a humanoid you saw die while wearing the mask: creatures of that face's kind (the same entity, the walking dead for an undead face, the raiders for an illager face) will not pick you as a target and drop you if they have. The mask stores the faces of up to five humanoids that die within 24 blocks; a sixth replaces the oldest, but only a minute after the last face was stored. Next Face (sneak and use): choose which stored face is at hand (the newest is chosen on its own). Replaced rules: visual appearance cannot change in this game, so the disguise is the behaviour of mobs toward you; an hour after a death is a minute.
item.nusmp.death_knights_helmet.desc: Necrotic and poison blows glance off, fear cannot take you, and every day worn adds a heart of stamina, to four. But each dawn Death's Call tests you: fail and it burns your mind and takes the stamina back, harder every time.
item.nusmp.death_knights_helmet.card: Very rare helmet (heavy, plate), attunement. Knight's Stamina: wearing it you resist necrotic damage (wither) by half, you are immune to poison (a lent Tensura resistance) and cannot be frightened. Each dawn you wear it you gain +1 Constitution (one more heart of maximum health, +2) up to +4. Curse, Death's Call: every day you wear the helmet you make a Wisdom save (d20 +2) against a DC of 12 on the first day, rising by 2 each day worn. On a failed save your mind burns for 2d8 psychic damage (never the last health point and at most 30% of your maximum) and you lose all the Constitution the helmet gave; each later failure adds 2d8 (4d8, 6d8, and so on). Taking the helmet off for a whole day starts its history again. Replaced rules: the daily save is rolled the first time the helmet is seen worn on a new day; Constitution is maximum health.
item.nusmp.frank.desc: A wooden bunny mask that is a trickster spirit. Cursed: set it down and it becomes a little brown bunny that follows you, and your blows weaken. Once a day it grants an hour of Foresight, if you do as Frank says.
item.nusmp.frank.card:
Requires attunement. Cursed: becoming attuned extends the curse to you. Unique grade. Worn on the head (armour 2, toughness 0.5).
Curse: while you carry Frank attuned but do not wear it, it is a little brown rabbit named Frank that follows you everywhere, and your blows are 30% weaker (disadvantage on attack rolls). Eating a golden apple (the nearest Remove Curse) lifts the weakness and sends the rabbit away for a day.
Foresight (once a day, 20 minutes): Frank grants his Foresight. You see the immediate future (Tensura future vision and presence sense), your blows are 20% stronger and blows against you 20% weaker. You cannot be surprised.
The Twist: every few minutes Frank asks you to do something a little wicked: strike a peaceful creature, throw something away, or hold still crouched for ten seconds, within three minutes. Fail and Foresight ends at once; take the mask off and it ends too. Five failures bring a visit at night (the countdown message) and start a 28-day countdown; when it runs out the world 'ends' for you with 30 seconds of darkness, nausea and weakness, and counts down again. Only a wish, an enchanted golden apple, breaks the countdown (and lifts the curse for three days).
Tabletop became: 'advantage/disadvantage' are damage factors; 'One Hour' is twenty minutes; a 'wish spell' is an enchanted golden apple; the countdown never kills.
"Wake up... Come, closer. 28 days, 6 hours, 42 minutes, 12 seconds. That is when your world will end."
item.nusmp.goggles_of_dwarvenkin.desc: Copper goggles with amber rune-gems. See in the dark, understand dwarven speech, mine a little faster, and once in a while grow a magnificent beard. Stone Cunning shows ore, hidden stone and traps.
item.nusmp.goggles_of_dwarvenkin.card:
Uncommon grade (Special). Worn on the head (armour 1).
Darkvision: night vision while worn. Dwarven language: Tensura thought communication is lent while worn. Stone Cunning: mining speed +10%; the act of the same name (20 seconds) marks with light every ore, hidden stonework (infested blocks, suspicious sand and gravel) and trap (pressure plates, tripwire, TNT, dispensers, spawners, sculk sensors) within 14 blocks, the nearest 40 shown and all counted. It changes no block.
Beard: at every dawn there is a 20% chance you grow a magical beard that lasts the day and gives +20% knockback resistance.
Tabletop became: '+2 to Investigation and Perception for traps and stonework' is the Stone Cunning scan; 'darkvision 60 ft' is night vision; 'comprehend Dwarven' is lent thought communication.
These goggles are handed out to non dwarven miners to use in dangerous and dark environments by dwarven companies. The goggles are a prized possession and there has been many contests to compare the magical beards that appear during work breaks.
item.nusmp.helm_of_whispers.desc: A spiked helm wreathed in green whispers. Read minds at will, dominate a creature three times a day, scream into every mind around you once a day. The voices never stop, and may drive you mad at dawn.
item.nusmp.helm_of_whispers.card:
Legendary grade; requires attunement; a Djinn may be bound to it. Worn on the head (armour 3, toughness 1.5).
Helm of Telepathy (DC 16): Tensura telepathy is lent while worn, and the act Detect Thoughts (15 seconds) makes every creature within 16 blocks glow for eight seconds and tells you what the nearest four want. Advantage on saves against enchantment: Tensura abnormal condition resistance while worn. Advantage on Intimidation: a hostile creature of no great stature (under 60 health) that has chosen you and comes within five blocks may lose its nerve (frightened and weakened).
Dominate Person (3 a day): the creature you look at (within 14 blocks) serves you for a minute: it will not attack you and fights your other foes. Bosses and pets are immune; a creature with more than three times your existence (EP) saves; a player is only frightened for five seconds.
Psychic Scream (once a day, costs 3% existence points): every foe within 10 blocks takes 7 psychic damage, is frightened for six seconds and stunned for two.
Curse, Voices: even with the helm off, each dawn you make a Wisdom save (d20 + 3 against DC 16); on a failure you suffer madness (Tensura insanity, 90 seconds, with darkness). It never kills.
Tabletop became: saving throws are d20 rolls or an existence comparison; 'long-term madness' is a long but temporary Tensura insanity.
item.nusmp.helmet_of_headbutting.desc: A riveted horned helmet. Headbutt for 1d8 and a stun on a critical hit. You are stubborn (hard to push), you cannot concentrate, and your head splits now and then.
item.nusmp.helmet_of_headbutting.card:
Grade rare (printed rarity unknown). Worn on the head (armour 3, toughness 0.5).
Headbutt (act, 2.5 seconds): a lunge at what you face within 2.8 blocks: 1d8 bludgeoning damage and a shove. On a critical hit (you were falling, or a natural 20) it does half again as much and stuns for 2.5 seconds (Tensura paralysis with heavy slowness).
Stubborn: +25% knockback resistance. Cranky, with a splitting headache at all times: your casting is 30% slower (Tensura chant speed), and every three minutes a bout of nausea for 3.5 seconds.
Tabletop became: '1d8' is a rolled d8; 'critical hit' is a falling blow or a natural 20.
item.nusmp.jellyfish_cap.desc: A translucent jellyfish cap. Poison cannot touch you, you breathe and swim like a fish, and guardians leave you be unless you strike first. A creature that strikes you from nearby is stung by poison cells.
item.nusmp.jellyfish_cap.card:
Requires attunement. Unique grade. Worn on the head (armour 1).
Immune to poison: the Poison effect is removed as it lands, and Tensura poison nullification is lent. Jellyfish Grace: water breathing, Dolphin's Grace and +50% swim speed (the 60 ft swimming speed), and Tensura water breathing. Guardians and elder guardians never choose you as a target unless you have hurt them first (the nearest thing to 'jellyfish are friendly').
Jellyfish Wrath: when a creature within nine blocks strikes you, the cap lashes it with poisonous cells: 1d6 poison damage (half if it saves: more than three times your existence) and three seconds of Poison. Six seconds between stings.
Tabletop became: 'DC 15 Constitution save' is the existence comparison; 'hair never wet' and 'drawn to the sea' are flavour only.
Created by a benevolent sea witch, this cap is infused with the power of giant jellyfish.
item.nusmp.lens_of_straight_creepin.desc: A red-orange monocle on a bead chain. While you wear it, it remembers what moves past. Once a day it shows the tracks left nearby in the last ten minutes, and makes every creature close by glow.
item.nusmp.lens_of_straight_creepin.card:
Grade Special (printed rarity unknown). Worn on the head (armour 1).
Memory: while worn, every two seconds the lens notes where up to twelve creatures within 24 blocks stand (monsters, animals and people marked differently); it keeps the last 240 tracks of this session.
See Tracks (once a day): every track within 40 blocks that is under ten minutes old lights up in the air (up to 60, monsters dark, others light), and every creature within 24 blocks glows for ten seconds. If the lens has not been worn long enough there are no tracks to show.
Tabletop became: 'footprints, tracks or markings of anything that moved through the area recently' is the lens's own bounded memory plus a glow; it cannot see before it was worn.
(Fantasy Costco coupon price: 700gp)
item.nusmp.mask_of_difference.desc: A swirling blue mask with a mind of her own: chatty, restless and always up for adventure. She never lets you sleep, brings luck, wins friends at will, and can suggest and command once a day.
item.nusmp.mask_of_difference.card:
Requires attunement (printed: by a creature non-neutral in any axis alignment; not enforced). Rare grade. Worn on the head (armour 1).
Charisma saves and Performance: Luck +1, and Tensura abnormal condition resistance while worn. Relentless Mind: you cannot sleep or be put to sleep (a bed throws you out; Tensura sleep and drowsiness are removed) and the phantoms never count you.
Natural Charm: Friends (act, 20 seconds): a minute of Hero of the Village and Luck. Suggestion (once a day): the creature you look at is charmed for 40 seconds (same rules as the Helm of Whispers' domination). Imperious Voice, Command (once a day): every foe within nine blocks stops for three seconds and forgets whom it was chasing.
Sentience: Difference is a chatty, restless, chaotic neutral voice: she speaks every four minutes, and if you stand within four blocks of the same spot for twenty minutes she makes a scene (nausea). She misses her brother: carry Indifference too and she says so.
Tabletop became: 'cast at will' is an act with a short cooldown; spells per day are uses per day; the mask 'deciding when to cast' is flavour (it talks, it does not seize control).
(Magic Items Collection. Made by Enderlook. Credits: Concept art from Planescape.)
item.nusmp.mask_of_indifference.desc: A blank grey mask of a quiet mind. Fear and charm slip off you, nobody can read you, and what you say angers no one. Calm Emotions once a day. Your own luck suffers for your lack of charm.
item.nusmp.mask_of_indifference.card:
Requires attunement (printed: by a creature neutral in at least one axis alignment; not enforced). Rare grade. Worn on the head (armour 1).
Advantage against being charmed or frightened: Tensura abnormal condition resistance while worn, and each second a mind effect (fear, confusion, mind control, hypnosis) has an even chance to be shrugged off. Poker Face: Tensura presence concealment while worn; and you are unable to express yourself: Luck -1 (Persuasion and Performance fail).
Dull News: a neutral creature (wolf, bee, iron golem, piglin) you strike does not get angry.
Calm Emotions (once a day): every foe within nine blocks drops its target, is weakened for ten seconds, and rage (Tensura rampage and ogre berserker effects) is lifted from you and your friends.
Sentience: Indifference is a quiet, vague voice; he says as little as possible, and carrying his sister makes him sigh.
Tabletop became: 'Insight checks fail' is concealment; 'Persuasion fails' is a Luck penalty; 'calm emotions' is the act.
item.nusmp.mask_of_mind_melting.desc: A squid-headed mask with three red eyes. Press it to a creature that is out cold: its mind is destroyed and you keep one memory as experience. The mask may take one of yours in exchange.
item.nusmp.mask_of_mind_melting.card:
Grade Special (printed rarity unknown). Worn on the head (armour 1).
Retrieve Memory (act, 2 minutes): look at a creature within 3.5 blocks that is out cold (asleep, under Tensura sleep, paralysis, petrification or hypnosis, or at 15% health or less). Its mind is destroyed: it becomes an empty husk with no will (its AI is off) and you gain a memory as experience points (twice half its maximum health, 10 to 120) with a line of what you remember. Players, pets, bosses and relic summons are immune.
The price: a 30% chance that the mask steals one of your own memories in exchange: you lose one to three experience levels (never more than you have) and are blinded for five seconds.
Tabletop became: 'unconscious' is out cold as above; 'a single memory' is experience; 'steals one of your memories' is a loss of levels.
item.nusmp.mask_of_the_raven_queens_disc: Mask of the Raven Queen's Disciple
A navy and silver raven mask with a purple gem. It steadies the mind and sharpens the senses, and it strikes a little harder for her cause. Once a day it spares one who is dying.

Requires attunement (printed: by a Cleric or Warlock; not enforced). Rare grade. Worn on the head (armour 2, toughness 0.5).
Wisdom from Beyond: Tensura spiritual attack resistance (Wisdom saves) and magic sense (Wisdom skills) while worn. My Queen: +1 attack damage (the Strength bonus; the Charisma one is not separate).
Forgiving Queen, Spare the Dying (once a day): touch a creature at death's door (health at 30% or 6 points or less), or yourself, and it is lifted to at least six health, poison and withering stilled; if nobody is dying you heal four. The purple gem flares.
Tabletop became: 'Wisdom saving throws and skills' are lent Tensura skills; 'Cleric or Warlock of the Raven Queen' is anyone; the cantrip is a once-a-day act.
item.nusmp.mask_of_the_witchdoctor.desc: A tribal mask of stacked planks with a green gem. Three times a day the gem casts a random spell on a creature: Witch Bolt, Hex, a frog polymorph or Hypnotic Pattern. You resist poison and are immune to disease and hypnosis.
item.nusmp.mask_of_the_witchdoctor.card:
Requires attunement (printed: by a Druid, Warlock or Shaman; not enforced). Uncommon grade (Special). Worn on the head (armour 1).
Voodoo Remedy (3 a day): the gem rolls a d4 and casts on whom you look at (or the nearest foe) within 18 blocks. 1 Witch Bolt: 7 lightning damage and two seconds of slowness. 2 Hex: 20 seconds of weakness II, slowness and Tensura curse. 3 Polymorph into Frog: for 15 seconds the creature is a harmless, hopping, croaking frog in spirit (it cannot hurt, slowed, forgets its target); nobody is replaced or lost. 4 Hypnotic Pattern: every foe within five blocks of the target is entranced for eight seconds.
Immunity: Tensura poison resistance is lent; Tensura hypnosis and infection (disease) are removed as they land.
Tabletop became: 'a d4' is a real d4; polymorph is a non-destructive effect; the immunities are removal of the matching Tensura effects.
item.nusmp.mind_stone.desc: An infinity stone of Vision and Mind set in a silver helm crowned with pale leaves. Thought runs quick, magic and blasts glance off you, and once a day it speaks Mass Suggestion to everything near.
item.nusmp.mind_stone.card:
Requires attunement. Legendary grade; a Djinn may be bound to it. Worn on the head (armour 3, toughness 1.5).
+3 to DEX and INT saving throws: Tensura thought acceleration is lent while worn, magic damage is cut by 20% and explosion damage by 20%. +1 to all Charisma checks: Luck +1.
Mass Suggestion (once a day, costs 4% existence points): every foe within 12 blocks is charmed for three minutes unless it saves (more than three times your existence); a charmed creature will not attack you and fights your other foes. Players are only frightened for five seconds; bosses are immune.
Tabletop became: 'saving throws' are lent skills and resistances; 'DC 17' is the existence comparison; 'eight hours' of suggestion is three minutes.
Infinity stone: Vision and Mind infused into a stone.
item.nusmp.soul_searchers.card: Head, Rare. Look at a creature within 16 blocks and use Sense Alignment: the glasses read its true alignment (Lawful, Neutral or Chaotic against Good, Neutral or Evil) from what the game knows of it: pets, villagers and golems are Lawful Good, undead Lawful Evil, other monsters Chaotic Evil, players Good, Neutral or Evil by the players they have killed (0, 1-2, 3 or more; a curse makes them Chaotic Evil). The religion check against Charisma is existence: a soul whose maximum EP is over twice yours slips past the glass, and the week is spent all the same. Usable once every 7 days (168000 ticks), never twice on the same creature (the last 24 are remembered); a player who is read is told. While worn, Tensura's Magic Sense is lent to you.
item.nusmp.soul_searchers.desc: Stained glass sunglasses that read souls. Once every seven days, look at a creature and learn its true alignment; never twice on the same one, and a player knows when they were read. Tensura's magic sense is yours while you wear them.
item.nusmp.the_mad_kings_crown.card: Head, special. The extra spell slot becomes +20% maximum magicules (Tensura max_magicule) while the crown is worn. You must wear it constantly: wear it for 2 days (48000 ticks) without taking it off for more than a day and the nightmares begin: you wake with nausea and darkness, weakness never leaves you and now and then you hear whispers of a bloody throne. After 6 days the exhaustion is heavy (Mining Fatigue too). It never kills; take the crown off for a day and the count starts again.
item.nusmp.the_mad_kings_crown.desc: A spiked helm-crown that swells your magicules by a fifth: one more spell slot, in the mod's terms. Wear it for two days straight and the nightmares of power, ruling and blood begin, and the weakness with them; take it off for a day to be free of it.
item.nusmp.the_orb_of_ancient_sight.card: Head, special, needs attunement. One use per day: Ancient Sight. Every creature with a magical effect within 24 blocks (120 ft) glows for 20 seconds (other players are listed but not made to glow), the chat lists what effect each carries (up to eight, then a count), and Tensura's Magic Sense is lent to you for the same 20 seconds.
item.nusmp.the_orb_of_ancient_sight.desc: Once a day, the orb opens its eye: every creature carrying a magical effect within twenty-four blocks glows for twenty seconds, you read which effects each carries, and Tensura's magic sense is yours for the same time.
item.nusmp.trickster_mask.card: Head, special. Skeleton Guise: put the mask on and for 3 hours (3000 ticks) everyone who looks at you sees a full skeleton: the undead do not pick you out as a target (unless you struck them) and Tensura's presence concealment hides you from the rest. Taking the mask off ends it. After it ends it cannot be used until the next dawn (once per Minecraft day).
item.nusmp.trickster_mask.desc: A teal skull mask. Put it on and, for three hours (3000 ticks), everyone who looks at you sees a full skeleton: the undead do not pick you out and your presence is concealed. Once it ends or comes off it is dead until the next dawn.
item.nusmp.arcane_tricksters_glove.card: Hands, special. Mage Hand becomes an invisible hand with no trail: Invisible Mage Hand reaches up to 8 blocks to the creature you look at and lifts something from its hands (or from a villager's pockets) into your bags; the chance is 80% minus the creature's maximum health in percent, between 25% and 80%, and a creature that catches the hand turns on you if it is hostile. With no creature in sight it brings the dropped item you look at (up to 12 blocks) to you. Bosses and other players cannot be robbed. The Arcana-for-Stealth rule becomes +1 Luck.
item.nusmp.arcane_tricksters_glove.desc: Your Mage Hand turns invisible. Reach up to eight blocks to lift something from a creature's hands or a villager's pockets, or fetch a dropped item from twelve blocks away. The frail are easy to rob; a hand that is caught turns the creature on you.
item.nusmp.bears_grip.card: Hands, rare. Advantage on grapple and athletics checks becomes +0.1 jump strength, +25% water movement efficiency and +15% knockback resistance. Bear Grapple seizes the creature within 3.5 blocks and holds it: Slowness VI and Weakness for 4 seconds, unless its existence is over twice yours.
item.nusmp.bears_grip.desc: Clawed leather gloves. You climb, leap and swim like a bear (higher jumps, easier swimming, a firmer stand against knockback), and Bear Grapple seizes the creature in reach and holds it still for four seconds.
item.nusmp.dragons_fire_gauntlet.card: Hands, legend, needs attunement. Immunity to fire (Fire Resistance, 90% off any fire damage, +50% Tensura flame resistance); understanding Draconic becomes Tensura's Dragon Ear. Once a day (1% EP): Burning Hands at the 4th level, a cone 5 blocks long, 14 fire damage, set alight. The gauntlet has 3 charges and 1d3 come back at dawn: when an explosion, a projectile or a lightning bolt would hit you (the failed Dexterity save), a charge is spent and the blow is turned aside whole (at most once a second).
item.nusmp.dragons_fire_gauntlet.desc: Immune to fire, and Tensura's dragon ear lets you follow Draconic. Once a day, Burning Hands: a cone of fire five blocks long. Three charges (1 to 3 back at dawn) let the gauntlet turn aside an explosion, a shot or a lightning bolt that would hit you.
item.nusmp.gauntlet_mimic.card: Hands, rare. Shapechanger: the gauntlet cycles between bludgeoning, piercing and slashing; bare-handed blows strike 3.5 harder (1d6): bludgeoning adds knockback, piercing 2 more against 8 or more armour, slashing poisons for 3 seconds. Adhesive: on a hit it sticks, holding the target (Slowness V and webbed) for 3 seconds unless its existence is over twice yours (at most once every 3 seconds). Hungry: each time it sticks it saps 2 health from the wearer, but never when that would leave you at 6 health or less.
item.nusmp.gauntlet_mimic.desc: A living gauntlet. Bare-handed blows strike 3 harder and the mimic cycles between bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. It sticks to what it hits and holds it for three seconds, and each time it does it drinks two of your health (never below two hearts).
item.nusmp.gauntlet_of_the_stormcaller.c: Hands, rare, needs attunement. Nine charges (2 to 5 come back at each dawn). Thunderwave (1 charge): foes within 4 blocks take 6 lightning damage and are thrown back. Call Lightning (3 charges): a bolt falls where you look (up to 24 blocks) and deals 12 lightning damage to everything within 3 blocks of it (the bolt itself sets nothing alight). Shocking Grasp (free): touch a creature within 3.5 blocks for 5 lightning damage (7 against 8 or more armour) and a moment of Slowness; it works while stunned, and while you are stunned (paralysed, petrified, webbed, or Slowness V or more) and a foe is within 3 blocks the gauntlet shocks it for you every 3 seconds. Arcs of electricity show round you in battle. Tensura's electricity resistance is lent while worn.
item.nusmp.gauntlet_of_the_stormcaller.d: Nine gems, nine charges (2 to 5 back at dawn). Thunderwave (1 charge) throws foes back; Call Lightning (3) drops a bolt where you look; Shocking Grasp is free and works even while stunned, when the gauntlet also shocks the nearest foe by itself.
item.nusmp.glove_of_appreciation.card: Hands, unique. The card is partly cut off: the charge cap (5) and the rationing are invented. Every compliment gives a charge: a chat line that names you and contains a kind word (thanks, nice, great, amazing, ...) from another player gives one charge, at most one per giver per 10 minutes; winning over an animal (taming) also gives one. Up to 5 charges. High-Five (1 charge): say Thank you! and the glove flies up to 12 blocks to the creature you look at. A friend (player, villager, pet) is healed 6 and gets Regeneration for 5 seconds; an unwilling creature gets a wisdom save (its existence over twice yours) and if it fails it is high-fived against its will: it loses its target and staggers (Slowness II for 3 seconds).
item.nusmp.glove_of_appreciation.desc: A thumbs-up glove that grows warm with kindness: each compliment in chat that names you (or an animal you win over) gives it a charge, up to five. Spend one on a High-Five: a friend is mended, a foe that fails its save is high-fived into a stagger.
item.nusmp.gloves_of_opportunity.card: Hands, unique. A critical 1 on an attack against you becomes: one melee blow in twenty from a creature that holds something in its hands goes wide (no damage), and as a reaction (at most once every 5 seconds) the gloves take one item from its hands. Bosses and players are never robbed. Lift: on command, reach up to 4 blocks and take what the creature in front holds (chance 80% minus its maximum health in percent, between 25% and 80%). +1 Luck. The Dexterity 13 requirement has no meaning here and is dropped.
item.nusmp.gloves_of_opportunity.desc: When a creature that holds something swings at you and fumbles (one blow in twenty goes wide), the gloves take what it holds. Lift does the same on command to the creature in front of you. Bosses and players cannot be robbed.
item.nusmp.goristro_charger.card: Hands, rare, needs attunement. Unarmed strikes of 1d8 become +4.5 damage on bare-handed blows. Siege power (strength 25) becomes +2 attack damage and +0.5 attack knockback, and Tensura's Strengthen Body is lent while worn. Demonic Charge (3 per day, 1% EP): rush the creature you look at (up to 7 blocks: 20 ft is four blocks, stretched so a charge is worth making), arrive beside it and strike for 16 damage (3d10) with a heavy knockback.
item.nusmp.goristro_charger.desc: Gauntlets of riveted goristro bone. Siege power: +2 attack damage and heavy knockback. Bare-handed blows strike 4 harder. Three times a day, Demonic Charge: rush a target within seven blocks and strike it for 16 more.
item.nusmp.hellfire_gauntlet.card:
Worn on the hands. Requires attunement. Legend (can be a Djinn vessel).
A hardy body (the card's Constitution 18 became at least 24 maximum health) is needed: with less, the flames refuse to answer and the blows and powers below do nothing.
Strength +2: +2 attack damage. Flame resistance: Tensura's flame attack resistance is lent to you and fire damage is halved.
Fire Blows: every melee blow you strike deals 2d4 more fire damage (2 to 8) and sets the target alight for three seconds. A bare-handed blow also adds 1d8 (the gauntlet's claws, slashing). If either die comes up its maximum, a target that is medium or smaller (not more than half as large again as you) and whose existence is not more than twice yours is shoved back a block (the Strength contest).
Firebolt (use): the cantrip. A bolt of fire along your look (20 blocks): 4 damage a die, one die at the start, two from level 5, three from level 11, four from level 17; it sets the target alight. 1% mana, cooldown 1.5 seconds.
Awakened: the gauntlet wakes after it has dealt 60 burning blows (the game's reading of "when the DM decides"; the count is kept per wearer). It then carries 3 charges that all come back at each dawn:
- Fireball (1 charge, second ability): a burst of fire where you look (24 blocks), 12 fire damage and burning to every foe within 4 blocks. It touches no block.
- Hell-quake (1 charge): you smash the ground: every foe within 6 blocks takes 7 force and 7 fire damage, burns, and is knocked down (heavy slowness for two seconds).
- Aura of Fire (1 charge): for one minute you are fire resistant and whoever strikes you in melee takes 7 fire damage (once a second at most).
Tabletop rules replaced: the saving throws, the Athletics contest and the grapple rules.
item.nusmp.hellfire_gauntlet.desc: A black spiked gauntlet with ever-burning fire to the elbow. +2 attack damage, +2d4 fire on every blow, claws in a bare fist, firebolt on use. After sixty burning blows it wakes: three charges a day buy fireball, a hell-quake and an aura of fire. Needs a hardy body.
item.nusmp.proficiency_gloves.card:
Worn on the hands. No attunement. Special.
You take on the proficiency of whatever you pick up. Once a second the gloves look at what is in your main hand and lend what fits it, until you put something else in your hand:
- a sword, trident or mace: +1.5 attack damage.
- an axe: +1 attack damage and Haste I.
- a pickaxe, shovel or hoe: Haste II.
- a bow or crossbow: +1 Luck and Tensura's sniper skill.
- a shield: +1 armour and +0.2 knockback resistance.
- anything else you hold (a stick, a block, a relic): +0.5 attack damage and +0.5 Luck.
- an empty hand: nothing.
Tabletop rule replaced: "proficiency bonus with any weapon or tool you pick up" became these flat bonuses by the kind of item.
item.nusmp.proficiency_gloves.desc: Brown leather gloves with gold plates. You take on the proficiency of whatever you pick up: blades hit harder, axes too and quicker, tools dig faster, bows aim truer, shields hold firmer, anything else a little of both.
item.nusmp.the_gauntlet_of_gamelon.card:
Worn on the hands. No attunement. Rare. (The card is partial: it names four gems and "up to 3 spells per gem" but not the spells; the twelve below are invented to fit what it says: stones and ice bridges, elemental spells.)
Zelda's focus: your spells cost a tenth less mana and your maximum magicules are 5% greater.
The gauntlet holds four gems, three spells each. Sneak and use turns to the next of the twelve spells; use casts the spell that is turned up (2% mana, two seconds).
Earth: Levitate Stone (the foe you look at, 14 blocks, floats for 2.5 seconds, then sinks gently); Stone Skin (Resistance I for 30 seconds); Earth Spikes (6 damage and Slowness II to every foe in a cone of 5 blocks).
Fire: Flame Bolt (5 fire damage and burning at 18 blocks); Warding Flames (foes within 4 blocks burn for 4 seconds, take 2 damage and are pushed back); Flame Cloak (Fire Resistance for a minute).
Water: Ice Bridge (the still water at your feet's level, 10 blocks long and 3 wide, freezes to frosted ice that melts back by itself; only over water, never in the Dungeon, only where you may build); Healing Spring (6 health and Regeneration); Tidal Burst (foes within 5 blocks take 3 damage, are slowed and shoved away; you breathe water for 30 seconds).
Air: Gust Leap (a bound of six blocks and a slow fall); Wind Cutter (5 damage to every foe near the line of your look, 8 blocks); Updraft (a minute of slow fall and 20 seconds of Jump Boost II).
The page of "Schools of Magic" (Arcane, Twilight, Divine) is not an item and is not played.
item.nusmp.the_gauntlet_of_gamelon.desc: An ancient Hylian gauntlet with four gems: earth, fire, water, air. Three spells a gem. Use casts the turned gem's spell, sneak and use turns to the next. It sharpens your sorcery: spells cost a tenth less.
item.nusmp.chromatic_collar.card:
Worn at the neck. No attunement. Rare.
Dragon's Resistance (use, once a day): roll a d6. The result lasts until the next dawn's worth of time has gone (a day, the game's "long rest") and vanishes if you take the collar off:
1 acid resistance (Tensura's corrosion resistance lent, corrosion cured); 2 poison resistance (poison cured, Tensura's poison resistance lent); 3 fire resistance; 4 lightning resistance; 5 cold resistance (the three: half damage of that kind); 6 +1 armour and one of those resistances of your choice.
Choose the Resistance (sneak and use): the resistance a roll of 6 will give, turned through acid, poison, fire, lightning and cold in that order.
Tabletop rules replaced: the long rest (a day), "resistance" (half damage, or the cure and loan for acid and poison), +1 AC (+1 armour).
item.nusmp.chromatic_collar.desc: A black scaled collar set with five gems. Once a day roll a d6 for a dragon's resistance (acid, poison, fire, lightning or cold) that lasts until the next dawn; a 6 gives +1 armour and a resistance of your choice (sneak and use to choose).
item.nusmp.collar_of_the_penitent_dragon:
Worn at the neck. Requires attunement. Special.
Bahamut's blessing: Radiant Breath (use): your breath weapon, as a bonus action: a cone of radiant light 6 blocks long that deals 6 holy damage to every foe in it (9 to the undead). 3% mana, cooldown ten seconds.
Penitent path: creatures of dragon kind (any creature with dragon, wyvern, drake or wyrm in its name that is not a great boss) recognise you and will not pick you as a target, unless you hurt them first. Tensura's holy attack resistance is lent to you.
Tabletop rules replaced: dragonborn and alignment requirements (dropped; any wearer may attune), the breath weapon (a Minecraft cone), advantage on Persuasion with dragons (they simply do not hunt you).
A silver collar with a dragon's head. Bahamut's blessing: use it to breathe a cone of radiant light, and dragons will not hunt you unless you wrong them. Holy damage is easier to bear.
item.nusmp.eye_of_the_aboleth.card:
Worn at the neck. No attunement. Special.
Charm (use): the creature you look at within 10 blocks (30 ft) must save (the Wisdom save is Tensura existence: it resists if its maximum EP is more than twice yours; great bosses always resist). If it fails, a creature is charmed for one minute: it will not pick you as a target and turns on the nearest monster within 12 blocks. A player is only dazed (Weakness II and Slowness for eight seconds). 2% mana, cooldown fifteen seconds.
item.nusmp.eye_of_the_aboleth.desc: A silver loop around a yellow slit-pupil eye. Use it on a creature within ten blocks: unless its will is far above yours it is charmed for a minute and will not strike you. A player is only dazed.
item.nusmp.fenrirs_collar.card:
Worn at the neck. Requires attunement. Unique.
The card's lycanthropy requirement is dropped (any wearer may attune): the wolf is the collar's own power.
Metamorphose (use): take the cursed hybrid form: +4 attack damage, +20% movement speed, +6 maximum health, +0.3 knockback resistance, night vision, Tensura's godwolf sense and strengthened body lent.
Under the full moon at night, or while a Moon Vigil still holds (until the next full moon), you keep control: the form lasts 5 minutes. At any other time the wolf is not yours: the form slips after 90 seconds and the curse takes its price (Weakness for 30 seconds and Hunger).
Moon Vigil (sneak and use, once a day): a night at the full moon under the open sky. You heal 6 and Regeneration; until the next full moon (eight days) you hold the wolf.
Shed the Form (third ability): end the form at will, with no price.
Tabletop rules replaced: long rest (a day), the full moon (the moon phase of the world), "loss of control" (the cursed form's price).
item.nusmp.fenrirs_collar.desc: A crescent collar with a ruby. Use it to take the hybrid wolf form: stronger, faster, hardier, with a wolf's senses. At the full moon (or after a vigil under it) you keep your mind for five minutes; otherwise the wolf slips in ninety seconds and the curse takes its price.
item.nusmp.sunheart_medallion.card:
Worn at the neck. Requires attunement. Legend (can be a Djinn vessel).
Disease cannot take you: Tensura's infection is cured as it comes and poison resistance is lent. An evil wearer (one bound to a devil) burns: 4 fire damage every six seconds, never when it would leave them under three hearts.
The amulet holds 10 charges (kept per wearer; the count does not refill with the day). It is charged only by bathing in dawn's first light:
Greet the Dawn (use in the last 1500 ticks of the night or the first 1500 of the day, under the open sky, once a day): regain 1d8+3 charges, up to ten.
On command, Sacred Flame (use): 6 holy damage to the foe you look at (9 to the undead), no charge.
Charged powers (each pick by the Use Worn Relic key): Aura of Vitality (1 charge: Regeneration II for 20 seconds on you and friends within 10 blocks); Fire Shield (2: fire resistance and absorption for five minutes); Mass Cure Wounds (3: friends within 8 blocks heal 10); Greater Restoration (5: every harmful effect leaves you and friends within 6 blocks); Heal (6: 20 health to you or the friend you look at, and their harmful effects removed); Regenerate (7: 10 health and Regeneration III for a minute, and their harmful effects removed).
True Resurrection (sneak and use, once only): the amulet shatters into brilliant sunlight and is lost for ever. You and friends within 16 blocks are healed to full and carry a ward for ten minutes: the next blow that would kill each of them is nullified and leaves them on at least half their health.
Tabletop rules replaced: advantage on saves (cure and loan), 3d6 per round (4 every 6 seconds), 1d8+3 and the charge costs (kept exactly), spells (the nearest effects).
item.nusmp.sunheart_medallion.desc: A golden sun on a fine chain with ten charges, refilled by greeting dawn's first light. Sacred Flame on use; Vitality, Fire Shield, Mass Cure, Restoration, Heal and Regenerate spend charges; True Resurrection (once) shatters it. Disease cannot take you; the evil burn.
item.nusmp.witchers_medallion.card:
Worn at the neck. No attunement. Legend (can be a Djinn vessel).
The medallion alerts you of unusual events, monster presences and environmental influences, up to 20 blocks (20 m) away, and hums at the slightest threat: once a second it looks for monsters; when one comes near (or every five seconds while they stay) a line on your action bar tells you how many, how far the nearest is, and whether it lies ahead, behind, left or right; a great presence (a boss) makes it hum hard; a storm overhead makes it tremble. Tensura's danger sense and magic sense are lent to you.
Witcher Senses (use): for fifteen seconds you see in the dark, and every monster within 20 blocks glows. 2% mana, cooldown one minute.
item.nusmp.witchers_medallion.desc: A steel wolf's head with red eyes. It hums when monsters come within twenty blocks and tells you how many, how far and which way; it trembles before a storm and hums hard at a great presence. Use it for witcher senses: monsters glow for fifteen seconds.
item.nusmp.buffoons_pantaloons.card:
Worn at the belt. No attunement. Rare.
Gaudy and a little loose: +1 armour (the card's +1 AC), and advantage on athletic checks as a higher jump, a little more speed and a softer landing (+0.1 jump strength, +3% speed, +1 block of safe fall).
The price: every jump and every melee blow is a check, and one in twenty comes up a natural 1: the pantaloons fall down around your ankles. Until you spend an action pulling them up (use), you are slowed and weak (disadvantage on all checks).
item.nusmp.buffoons_pantaloons.desc: Gaudy baggy pantaloons: +1 armour and a spring in your step (higher jump, a little faster, softer landings). But a jump or a blow can come up a natural 1 and the pantaloons fall to your ankles: slow and weak until you spend an action pulling them up.
item.nusmp.executioners_bane.card:
Drunk and used up. Unique.
Drink it and for three hours of the day (3000 ticks) you survive being beheaded. In the game:
- A blow that would kill you leaves you on one hit point instead (with Resistance V for three seconds), once every ten seconds. A second killing blow inside those ten seconds is the head being destroyed and kills you as it would.
- The head still feels everything (Tensura's pain nullification is lent); but you are slowed and weakened, and you cannot eat or drink while it lasts.
- The head can be reattached: sleep through a night in a bed, or be cured by the Sunheart Medallion's Greater Restoration, Heal, Regenerate or Resurrection. The wound heals and the effect ends.
- If the three hours pass without that, the body gives out: you lose half your health (never the last point), and are slow, weak and hungry for a while. (The card says you die; nothing in this game kills outright.)
Tabletop rules replaced: head and body as separate targets, saving throw failures, spell and potion rules (dropped; the survival and its price are what is played).
item.nusmp.executioners_bane.desc: A black crystal vial on a gold chain. Drink it and for three hours of the day you survive being beheaded: a killing blow leaves you on one hit point (once every ten seconds). You are slow and weak and cannot eat or drink; sleep in a bed to put your head back, or the body gives out.
item.nusmp.perculiar_puking_poison.card:
Drunk and used up. Special.
Make a Constitution save (a d20 plus one for every four points of maximum health above 20, against 15; the card's DC 15). On a fail you are poisoned for one hour of the day (1000 ticks: Weakness all the while, Nausea at each puke) and about every ten minutes of it (167 ticks) you puke up something strange: six times, each a d20:
1 luminous rainbow slime (3 slimeballs, glowing); 2 a broom (a stick and wheat); 3 several large rocks (4 cobblestone); 4 acid (2 damage, corrosion or poison); 5 a live fish (a cod); 6 bubbles (water breathing, slow fall); 7 a book; 8 blood (1d4 damage, never the last point); 9 1d6 carrots; 10 a ship's anchor (2 iron ingots, 3 chains, slowness); 11 live ducklings (three baby chickens that go after two and a half minutes); 12 a well-crafted chair (oak stairs); 13 necrotic mush (rotten flesh, hunger); 14 a fist-sized ball of glass; 15 a large cactus (2); 16 a swarm of bugs (spider eyes, nausea); 17 deer antlers (bones); 18 a copy of your own head (your player head); 19 electrical plasma (4 lightning damage to every foe within 3 blocks, you slowed); 20 a full size coffin (a chest and a bone).
item.nusmp.perculiar_puking_poison.desc: A glass orb of swirling rainbow slime in a spiked claw. Drink it and make a Constitution save or be poisoned: six times, about every ten minutes of the hour, you puke up something strange (a broom, a chair, a coffin, a copy of your own head...).
item.nusmp.pocket_portal.card:
Very Rare potion (a glass orb), used up when it opens a portal.
Home Sweet Home: the orb remembers the circle it was brewed in. Sneak while you drink it to brew it where you stand (the orb you drink is swapped for a marked one; an orb never marked marks itself on first use). The portal always leads back to that spot, in the same world.
Smash the Orb (drink without sneaking): the orb breaks where you aim (up to twelve blocks, the ground in front of you if nothing is hit) and a ring of two blocks radius (the 10 ft portal) opens and stays for twelve seconds (two rounds, until the end of your next turn). Any creature that steps into the ring is carried to within a block of the circle (or the nearest free space) and cannot be carried again for three seconds. Bosses (300 health or more) are never carried. One portal per player at a time; it never changes a block. If the circle is in another world the portal will not open and the orb is kept.
Replaced: 'an action' = drinking the orb; 'permanent teleportation circle' = the spot marked by sneaking; 5 ft / 10 ft = 1 block / 2 blocks; 'end of your next turn' = 12 seconds.
item.nusmp.pocket_portal.desc: A glass orb of swirling purple. Sneak to brew it in the spot you stand; smash it elsewhere and a ring of light opens for twelve seconds that carries everyone who steps in back to that spot.
item.nusmp.potion_of_vampirism.card:
Very Rare potion. Drinking it rolls a d20 on the server, and the result is told to you.
1-12 Cursed (60%): for three Minecraft days (24000 ticks each) you gain a vampire's vulnerabilities: in sunlight (daytime, open sky, no rain) you take 1 damage a second and are weakened; in flowing water you take 1 damage a second; radiant, holy and sacred damage is doubled. These burns never take you below two hearts. Dying ends the curse.
13-18 Children of the Night (30%): for five Minecraft days, when a hostile creature wounds you, a pack answers (once in five minutes): 1d4 rounds later (6 to 24 seconds), wolves if you were under the open sky or bats (Tensura giant bats) if not arrive as your allies for five minutes. Their number is the card's 2d4 (bats) or 3d6 (wolves) halved and capped at six, the most summons a player may have. They fight what you fight and vanish if you die.
19-20 Regeneration (10%), for good: every other second you heal 3 health, but not while sunlight (daytime, open sky, no rain) or flowing water touches you, and not for a round (6 s) after you take radiant, holy or sacred damage. It is kept through death.
Replaced: 'vulnerabilities of a vampire (Monster Manual)' = sunlight, flowing water and double radiant damage; '3 days' / '5 days' = Minecraft days; 'summon 2d4 swarms / 3d6 wolves, arrive in 1d4 rounds, 1 hour' = the pack above (summon limit and five-minute cap); 'regain 20 hit points at the start of each turn' = 3 health every other second; 'radiant damage from running water, sunlight or holy water' = exposure to them or holy damage pauses it.
item.nusmp.potion_of_vampirism.desc: A skull-shaped flask with red eyes. Drink and roll a d20: most often a curse (sunlight and holy light burn you for three days), sometimes the Children of the Night (wolves and bats answer your wounds for five days), rarely Regeneration for good.
item.nusmp.romlos_potion_of_sleep.card:
Potion of unknown rarity (Special). Whoever drinks this falls asleep for five minutes unless they save.
Drink: you make the saving throw yourself. Sneak while you drink: you pour it into the mouth of the creature you face within four blocks (never a pet, a summon, or a creative or spectator player; players only where they can be harmed).
Wisdom save (DC 15): a d20 plus one per ten maximum health (at most ten) and up to three more for a full pool of magicules; a natural 20 always saves, a natural 1 never does. A creature that saves is only drowsy (Slowness) for ten seconds. One that fails sleeps for five minutes (the card's five hours at one minute an hour, since a sleeper is helpless): Tensura's Sleep effect, no movement, no fighting, no mining, no using items, and sleeping mobs pick no target. Any damage wakes it at once. A creature with 100 health or more only yawns (the potion is kept).
Replaced: 'DC 15 Wisdom saving throw' = the roll above; 'asleep for 5 hours' = 5 minutes.
item.nusmp.romlos_potion_of_sleep.desc: Bright lime liquid. Whoever drinks it must save or sleep for five minutes; sneak to pour it into the mouth of the creature in front of you. Damage wakes the sleeper.
item.nusmp.spider_brew.card:
Potion of unknown rarity (Special). Drink it and you morph into a giant spider for 1d4 'hours' (five minutes each, so 5 to 20 minutes), keeping your own mind.
Giant spider body: +6 maximum health (26 like the monster), +3 armour, +2 attack damage, a higher jump (+30%), a lower, longer body (scale 85%), night vision (darkvision).
Spider Climb: press yourself against any wall and you climb it; sneak to cling in place; no fall damage from the climb.
Poisonous bite: every melee hit you land poisons the target for six seconds, and a hit with an empty main hand (a bite) deals 3 more damage.
Tensura lends you Poison Resistance and Sticky Steel Thread (web) for the whole time, where the world has those skills. Drinking another Spider Brew while a spider only renews the time. Dying ends it.
Replaced: 'giant spider abilities' = the list above; 'keep your intelligence' = you keep your hands, items, chat and spells; 1d4 hours = 1d4 x 5 minutes; Web Walker is not reproduced (cobwebs still slow you).
item.nusmp.spider_brew.desc: A bottle of blue liquid wrapped in cobweb. Drink to become a giant spider for five to twenty minutes with your own mind: climb walls, a poisonous bite, more health and armour, night vision.
item.nusmp.hand_of_vecna.card:
Artifact (God grade), worn in the Hands slot, requires attunement. In the tabletop rules you cut off your left hand and press the Hand to the stump; here the five-second attunement ritual is the cutting, and the first second it works for you it GRAFTS: it cannot be taken off while you live (Curios refuses; an operator frees you with /vecna release <player>; your death frees it and it drops). The game has no alignment: the evil of the Hand is its Whisper.
Strength 20: +7 attack damage, +3 armor and +2 armor toughness while it is worn.
Cold blows: every melee blow adds 3 cold damage (1.5 on a player) and a few seconds of Tensura frost and slowness.
Touch of Death (3% existence points, 60 s cooldown): the creature you touch takes 20 heavy damage and Wither II; a player takes at most 45% of their health and is never left under a heart.
Rimed Grasp (5% mana, 30 s): every foe within six blocks takes 7 cold damage, frost, Slowness III and freezing.
Skeleton to Jelly (needs the Eye too; 4% existence points, 5 min): the touched creature loses 30% of its maximum health (10% on a boss; a player at most 45%, never below a heart), then Slowness III, Weakness III and Glowing.
Coercion: after any Hand act there is a 20% chance of Vecna's Whisper: 8 seconds of Hunger II and Mining Fatigue and a whisper in chat. It takes nothing from you and never forces an act.
The pair of Vecna (Hand and Eye both worn and attuned to one bearer): immune to poison and disease (poison, hunger, magicule poison and infection are cleansed every second, and Poison Resistance, Paralysis Resistance and Danger Sense are lent); cannot be surprised (the first blow from an attacker in each 20 seconds is turned aside); regeneration of one health every two seconds; safe X-ray (no hunger cost); Skeleton to Jelly and the Wish can be used.
The Wish (the pair): Choose the Wish cycles Full Restore, A Day of Resilience, Clear Skies, Summon Rain; Make the Wish grants the chosen one, once in 30 real days for each player.
item.nusmp.hand_of_vecna.desc: A withered grey hand in an ornate gold gauntlet. Attuning grafts it to your wrist for as long as you live: strength of a giant, cold in every blow, and a whisper that wants you to do evil. Worn with the Eye, it is more.
item.nusmp.eye_of_vecna.card:
Artifact (God grade), worn on the Head, requires attunement. In the tabletop rules you gouge out your eye and press the Eye into the socket; here the five-second attunement ritual is the pressing, and the first second it works for you it GRAFTS: it carries the curse of binding and cannot be taken off while you live (an operator frees you with /vecna release <player>; your death frees it and it drops).
Sight: lends Eye of Truth and Farsight, night vision, and X-ray: every second, mobs and players within 24 blocks that you cannot see glow through the walls (it costs a little hunger unless the pair is worn).
Clairvoyance (4% mana, 60 s): names the five nearest living things within 96 blocks with their coordinates, and makes them glow for ten seconds.
Crown of Madness (3% mana, 45 s): the mob you look at (not a boss) fights its own allies for ten seconds.
Disintegrate (3% existence points, 60 s): a grey beam of 26 heavy damage; it removes no block; a player takes at most 45% of their health and is never left under a heart.
Dominate Monster (6% mana, 2 min): the mob you look at (not a boss, not a player) is your ally for one minute.
Eyebite (3% mana, 30 s): a cone twelve blocks long of Tensura fear, Weakness II and Slowness II for ten seconds (four on a player).
Vecna's Hunger: each use of the Eye has a 5% chance of it: for 20 seconds you are in darkness and slowed and a spectral hand hunts you alone. Kill it. It cannot take your last heart, drops nothing, and never takes control of you or locks you out.
The pair of Vecna (Hand and Eye both worn and attuned to one bearer): immune to poison and disease (poison, hunger, magicule poison and infection are cleansed every second, and Poison Resistance, Paralysis Resistance and Danger Sense are lent); cannot be surprised (the first blow from an attacker in each 20 seconds is turned aside); regeneration of one health every two seconds; safe X-ray (no hunger cost); Skeleton to Jelly and the Wish can be used.
item.nusmp.eye_of_vecna.desc: A pink-irised eye on a red cord. Attuning presses it into your socket for as long as you live: it sees through walls and in the dark, casts five terrible spells, and sometimes, one use in twenty, hungers for you. Worn with the Hand, it is more.
item.nusmp.deck_of_many_things.card:
Artifact (God grade), a charm, no attunement. A deck of 22 cards. Draw One, Two or Three Cards: you draw exactly the number you chose, at most three a game day, and never more than the deck holds; the deck is shuffled once (the great and terrible cards tend to lie deeper) and the 22 are drawn without repeat. After the 22nd card the deck crumbles to dust. Look at the Deck shows how many are left and which have been drawn.
Nothing in the deck kills, takes a relic or a ledger item, or locks you out of the game. The cards: Balance (harmful effects cleansed, Resistance for 5 min); Comet (the next hostile monster you kill alone within a day gives 3 levels); The Donjon (3 minutes of Slowness II, Weakness and Mining Fatigue in a ring of dark glass); Euryale (30 minutes of bad luck and weakness); The Fates (misfortunes lifted, Luck II for 10 min); Flames (an Infernal Envoy, a wither skeleton, hunts you for a minute); The Fool (lose 3 levels, the deck draws again); Gem (25 emeralds); Idiot (10 minutes of Mining Fatigue and Weakness); Jester (4 levels, or two more cards, fixed by the deck); Key (a random unissued RARE relic weapon, ledger-stamped; a pair gives both halves; diamonds if none is left); Knight (an iron golem ally for 5 minutes); Moon (one to three boons for 10 minutes); Rogue (a vindicator, The Turncoat, hunts you for a minute); Ruin (up to 64 emeralds and magic stones lost, bad luck for 10 minutes); Skull (an Avatar of Death, a vex, hunts you for 90 seconds); Star (for good: +1 heart and +1 attack damage, at most three times); Sun (a random unissued UNIQUE relic and 6 levels); Talons (half a stack, at most 32, of a plain valuable or food is torn up; never a relic, a tool or enchanted gear); Throne (Hero of the Village and Absorption for a day, 16 gold, the title Lord of the Keep); Vizier (names the nearest Labyrinth Spire if you are in the Labyrinth, or the nearest Dungeon Gate in the Overworld); The Void (2 minutes of Slowness IV, blindness and Resistance V: you cannot move or see, and nothing can harm you).
The hostile summons last at most 90 seconds, fight only you, drop nothing, and can never take your last heart.
item.nusmp.deck_of_many_things.desc: Twenty-two cards in a gold-edged case. Choose how many to draw (one, two or three a day) and you draw exactly that many: wonders and ruin, nothing that kills and nothing that takes a relic. After the twenty-second the deck crumbles to dust.
item.nusmp.the_infinity_gauntlet.card:
Artifact (Genesis grade), worn in the Hands slot, requires attunement. Any Infinity Stone you carry anywhere on you (inventory or Curios) is set in the Gauntlet and answers through it; the Gauntlet must be worn. Each carried Stone makes the Stones' acts 12% stronger (range, time, damage), up to +72% with all six, and a worn Gauntlet lends the skills of the Space, Mind, Time and Soul Stones and the pool doubling of the Power Stone even if the Stones are only carried. (The card's rule that the Gauntlet's bearer cannot attune other items is replaced by the usual limit of three attuned relics; the Stones themselves need no attunement slot.)
Greater Wish (all six Stones carried, once a game day): Choose the Wish cycles Treasure (32 diamonds and 32 emeralds), Restoration (every player and pet of yours within 48 blocks healed to full and cleansed), Resistance (Resistance II, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing for 10 minutes), Immunity (cleansed now and every second for a day), Reroll (the blow you took in the last six seconds is healed back).
The Snap (all six Stones carried, once a game day, 10% existence points): every hostile mob within 48 blocks loses half of its current health (a boss a tenth of its maximum), is weakened and slowed, never to zero; no player is touched and no block is changed. The bearer pays with 30 seconds of Weakness II, Mining Fatigue II and Hunger II.
Acts: Space, Mind, Power, Time, Reality, Soul Stone (each needs its Stone carried).
item.nusmp.the_infinity_gauntlet.desc: A black gauntlet with a ribcage palm and six sockets. Every Infinity Stone you carry is set in it and answers through it, stronger for each; with all six it makes the Greater Wish and the Snap, once a day each.
item.nusmp.the_space_stone_or_the_tesser: The Space Stone, or the Tesseract

Artifact (God grade), a charm. Lends Spatial Motion while worn.
Tesseract (3% mana, 60 s): you and up to nine willing companions (players who are sneaking, pets of yours) within 12 blocks step to your marked place on the same plane (the dimension). With no mark, to your bed or the world spawn. The card's save for unwilling people is replaced by consent: only those who sneak are taken.
Mark the Place (sneak and use): marks where you stand as the destination in this dimension.
A small blue cube of folded space. Mark a place (sneak and use), then step to it with up to nine willing companions. It lends you Spatial Motion.
item.nusmp.the_mind_stone.card:
Artifact (God grade), a charm. Lends Thought Communication and Analytical Appraisal while worn.
Sense Minds (30 s): lists, with coordinates and what they are about to do, the nearest twelve thinking creatures (players, villagers, illagers, piglins, witches) within 200 blocks, and makes those within 96 glow for five seconds.
Read Mind (sneak and use, 5 s): learns what the creature you look at is, holds and wants. A player resists on a d20 + 0 against DC 20 (only a natural 20).
item.nusmp.the_mind_stone.desc: A small yellow gem that hears. Use it to sense every thinking creature within two hundred blocks; sneak and use to read the mind in front of you. It lends you Thought Communication and Analytical Appraisal.
item.nusmp.the_power_stone.card:
Artifact (God grade), a charm. Doubles your pools: maximum magicules and maximum aura +50% and magicule regeneration +100% (Tensura attributes; no new stat). The card's doubling of uses per day is replaced by this doubling of the pools.
Power Burst (2% existence points, 45 s): a shock of power: every foe within six blocks takes 14 heavy damage and is thrown back.
item.nusmp.the_power_stone.desc: A small purple gem of raw power. Your magicule and aura pools swell by half and refill twice as fast; use it for a shock of power that throws back every foe round you.
item.nusmp.the_time_stone_or_the_eye_of_: The Time Stone, or the Eye of Agamotto

Artifact (God grade), a charm. Lends Danger Sense while worn.
Foresight (a ritual: hold use for five seconds; 2 min cooldown): for 600 seconds (twelve thousand ticks) the first blow from an attacker in each 20 seconds is turned aside, Luck II is yours, and Tensura future vision shows you what is to come for two minutes. The tabletop's advantage on rolls is replaced by the luck and the guard.

A small green gem that sees what is to come. Hold use to cast Foresight as a ritual: for twelve thousand ticks you cannot be surprised, luck is with you and the future is in sight. It lends you Danger Sense.
item.nusmp.the_reality_stone.card:
Artifact (God grade), a charm.
Polymorph (3% mana, 30 s): the mob you look at (not a boss, not a player) is made small (40% size, where Tensura's size attributes exist), weak (Weakness III) and slow for thirty seconds. The card's swap into another creature, and polymorphing objects, are replaced by this reversible shrinking.
Seeming (sneak and use, 3% mana, 60 s): invisible and hard to sense for three minutes.
Mirage Arcane (3% mana, 30 s): foes within 14 blocks lose their target and stumble for ten seconds (Greater Image and Mirage Arcane in one).
item.nusmp.the_reality_stone.desc: A small red gem that rewrites. Polymorph shrinks and weakens a mob in sight; sneak and use for Seeming (unseen for three minutes); the Mirage makes nearby foes lose you.
item.nusmp.the_soul_stone.card:
Artifact (God grade), a charm. True sight at any distance: lends Eye of Truth while worn.
Anyone who dies within 64 blocks of you has their soul stored in the Stone (twelve at most; the names of players are kept). True Resurrection (automatic, once a game day, needs a stored soul): a killing blow that would end you instead leaves you on half your health with Regeneration III, Resistance II and Absorption. Count the Souls shows what the Stone holds. (The card's resurrection of another person, and keeping the dead from being raised, are replaced by this return of the bearer.)
item.nusmp.the_soul_stone.desc: A small orange gem that keeps the dead. You see truly at any distance; the souls of those who die within sixty-four blocks are stored in it, and once a day one of them brings you back from a killing blow.
item.nusmp.paradox.card:
Artifact staff (God grade), requires attunement. +3 damage and 2d4 more on every melee blow (the card's 2d10 scaled to a Minecraft blow; half of that on a player) and a critical blow (x1.5) on 19 or 20 of a d20.
Twenty charges, refilled by 2d8+4 at each dawn (a long or short rest). Acts (sneak-use picks the second): Slow (3 charges: foes within 10 blocks, Slowness III and Weakness); Phase Lock (5: the creature you look at is held, for as long as the control caps allow: 5 s on a mob, 3 s on a player, 1 s on a boss); Phase Stasis (3: the same for a person: a player, villager, illager, piglin or witch); Temporal Movement (3: Speed II and Haste II for 15 s); Time Stop (9: every foe within 16 blocks is held, you move at Speed III); Alternate Reality (3: foes within 18 blocks lose their target and stumble for 5 s); Turn the Clock (1: the damaged item in your off hand is turned back to new; not a relic); Missing Time (3: everyone within 18 blocks, you included, saves against DC 15 or is aged (slow and weak) or made young (regenerating and quick) for 20 s).
The Paradox: Time Stop and Missing Time force the staff: you save against DC 17 (d20, only a 17 or more holds); on a failure you are cast out of the timeline back to where you stood about ten seconds ago, tired (Hunger, Slowness), and the madness table rolls: 0 you are knocked flat; 1-49 short-term (nausea and slowness for 1d10 x 10 s); 50-99 long-term (5 minutes of nausea, weakness and mining fatigue); 100 indefinite (10 minutes, or until milk). The staff's sentience and its habit of vanishing into the timeline are not played.
item.nusmp.paradox.desc: The staff of the God of Time: a twisted thorn of violet crystal. Its blows carry extra weight and a critical on 19 and 20; twenty charges, refilled by 2d8+4 each dawn, buy slows, holds, haste, a stopped moment, a turned clock and missing years. Forcing it may cast you out of your own timeline.
item.nusmp.warrens_key.card:
Artifact (God grade), a charm, no attunement. It never works inside the Labyrinth or the Living Dungeon, whose doors are not to be changed.
Knock and Arcane Lock (a shared pool of five uses a game day; spent only when the spell works): Knock opens the door, gate, trapdoor or chest you point at and lifts your own arcane lock from it; Arcane Lock shuts and locks it against everyone but you (sixteen locks at most, kept with the world, until you knock them away).
Door to Door (five a game day): the door you point at and a door the Key remembers (it learns every door it touches, twelve at most; Choose the Door cycles which) become the two ends of a portal on the same plane that stays open for an hour, or until either door is shut: step into one doorway and you come out of the other (walk-through, one second apart). If the Key knows no other door on this plane, the spell fails. The tabletop's plane shift and teleport accuracy are replaced by this remembered-door rule.
item.nusmp.warrens_key.desc: A long bronze skeleton key with a labyrinth for a bit. Five a day it knocks or arcane-locks a door, gate, trapdoor or chest; five a day it joins the door in front of you to a door it remembers, as a portal that stays open an hour. It does not work inside the Dungeon.
effect.nusmp.soul_corruption.description: Lucius's Soul Touch has cut into your soul: maximum health is reduced by 10% per level (three levels, never below four hearts) for a minute. A new touch adds a level. Milk or a Totem of Undying cleanses it.
effect.nusmp.paladin.description: Purified by Lucius Zogratis's Paladin Conversion: this creature serves its caster with doubled health, 60% more attack, 8 armour, 4 toughness and 15% more speed, wears a halo and wings of light, and never harms its master.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_travel: Shadow Travel - slip into the shadow you stand in and rise from the shadow you aim at (or the nearest one ahead). Both spots must be dark (light level 3 or less). Costs more the further you go; up to two sneaking allies follow.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_equus: Unite Mode: Equus - united with Slotos, the horse devil: +10 armor, +6 toughness, 40% less physical damage, no knockback, 25% slower, for 30 s. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_felis: Unite Mode: Felis - united with Plumede, the cat devil: +30% speed, higher jumps, night sight, 20% dodge, mobs beyond 8 blocks lose you, living things within 24 blocks are outlined for you alone. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_gallus_call: Gallus: Walgner's Call - while united with Gallus: the first call stuns every enemy within 8 blocks (1.5 to 2.5 s); the second roots the enemy you look at for 4 s. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_dance: Kiato's dance, now a passive: anyone who holds Butoh Magic dances by themselves, with no need to cast it. You move in a flowing, never-repeating dance: eight moves in an order only the dance knows. While it lasts, a blow aimed at you may find nobody there (35 to 65 percent by the move you are in, at most 65 percent, 20 points less against bosses; falls, fire, poison and the void are never dodged), a dodge slips you one step aside and leaves an ink after-image, your body is 15 to 25 percent smaller (a harder target), and Butoh pages you cast hit for 15 percent more. It costs mana every second (1 percent of your maximum, half of that while you stand still) and stops when you run dry (it returns once you have 15 percent of your mana again), are stunned, asleep, frozen in time, riding, swimming or gliding, and it comes back by itself afterwards. Casting this page costs nothing: it only switches the dance between resting and dancing.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_dash_deflect: A quick dash along the way you are moving (or the way you look), 5.5 blocks, 6.5 while dancing. For 12 ticks afterwards every arrow, bolt or fireball that reaches you is turned around at its shooter, with you as its new owner, so it can hurt the one who sent it. While dancing the return is faster and tighter. A missile can be turned back twice at most. About 6 seconds to recharge.
effect.nusmp.relic_nullified.description: A spatial pulse has de-attuned every relic you carry. They stay equipped and stay yours; they simply do not answer until this ends.
effect.nusmp.severed.description: Your Djinn and your Black Clover spirits are cut off from you. Nothing is lost: they answer again when this ends.
effect.nusmp.time_decay.description: Lucius's aura stops all passive healing here: natural regeneration, the Regeneration effect and regeneration skills. Healing potions and food still work.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_reani: Raises the dead of the last minute near you as Soul Corpses (up to 2). When no one has died near you, the earth gives up new corpses of its own: undead that fit the place (husks in the desert, strays in the snow, drowned in the water, skeletons in the dark and the Nether), one to three by your mastery, each for a little mana. They fight for you, bleed away, and last about a minute. This page is open from the start.
item.nusmp.zogratis_hourglass.tip.lore: The sand falls upward for those who are ready to meet him.
item.nusmp.zogratis_hourglass.tip.use: Hold right click for 3 seconds: you and every player within 8 blocks (party first) are carried to Lucius's arena. Hold again inside to go home.
item.nusmp.zogratis_hourglass.tip.rules: Not in the Labyrinth or the dungeons. Not while hurt, nor while Lucius fights (leaving mid-fight takes 10 seconds). 60 second cooldown after coming home.
advancement.nusmp.root.title: Multiverse of Anime
advancement.nusmp.root.desc: Grimoires, relics and dungeons of many worlds. Every spell you cast and every foe you fell is written down here.
advancement.nusmp.start.first_grimoire.d: Receive your grimoire, the book that will carry your magic.

message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.here.gap: You are in the Mega-Dungeon but in no sector (a gap between two sectors). The tracker keeps floor %s for you.
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.here.hub: You are on Floor 0, the Sanctuary Hub: no road, no lock.

message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.here.noroom: Sector %s (%s road) but in no room (a door cap, or the air above the rooms). The tracker keeps floor %s for you.
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.here.outside: You are not in the Mega-Dungeon (this is %s).
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.here.tracker: The tracker has you on floor %s.
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.here.unnumber: This room has no floor number yet (the sector was never numbered): run floors assign %s.

message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.player.line: %s: %s, %s; deepest reached: Holy %s, Abyssal %s; the tracker has them on floor %s.

message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.player.op: They are an operator and pass the lock (floors.opsBypass).
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.reset.ok: %s has no road, no lock and no record of the floors any more.
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.set.locked: They are locked, so the lock now closes the other road.
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.set.unknown: '%s' is not a road. Use holy or abyssal.
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.cmd.unlock.ok: %s is free to take either road again (their road, the %s, is kept).
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.locked: Floor %s is behind you. The %s is yours now, and the other road is sealed to you. The way back to Floor 0 stays open.
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.locked.op: You are an operator, so the lock does not bind you.
message.nusmp.mega.mfl.refused: The %s will not open for you: you are bound to the %s. The way back to Floor 0 is always open.
item.nusmp.mana_core.tooltip.dormant: Dormant: it was forged for no seal.
item.nusmp.mana_core.tooltip.forged: Forged by a Guardian's fall. It never fades, burns or breaks.
message.nusmp.gatekeeper.sector_sealed: Sealed. Only the Mana Core of this sector's Guardian opens this gate.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.active: The altar is awake. Finish what you started.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.answers: The Guardian Altar answers. Something vast turns toward you.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.core_exists: A Mana Core of this sector still exists. Find it first.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.core_forged: The Guardian falls. A Mana Core of Sector %s rises from the altar.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.done: The altar is spent: its Guardian has fallen.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.idle: The altar waits. Come closer to wake what it guards.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.no_sector: The Guardian falls, but the altar belongs to no sector: nothing rises.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.reforged: The altar answers your need: a new Mana Core forms above it.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.altar.wait: The altar is still cooling. It can forge again in %s s.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.core_dormant: The core is dormant: it was forged for no seal.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.core_here: The core trembles: its seal is right here.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.core_lost: The core cannot feel its seal.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.core_not_ready: The seal is still being woven. Try again in a moment.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.core_pull: The core pulls you on: its seal lies %s blocks to the %s.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.core_silent: The core is silent here: its seal lies in the Mega-Dungeon.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.core_wrong_seal: The core hums, but this is not its seal.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.door_open: The Mana Core dissolves. The Gatekeeper's seal breaks, and the dungeon begins to grow.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.phase_two: The Guardian roars. The seal's light flares: it fights in earnest now.

message.nusmp.mega.mhb.cmd.gates.none: Where you stand (%s) no gate answers: the nearest one is more than %s blocks away.

message.nusmp.mega.mhb.cmd.plaza: The plaza was stamped again from %s (build version %s).

message.nusmp.mega.mhb.cmd.tp: Sent %s to the plaza of Floor 0.
message.nusmp.mega.mhb.gate.unknown: This gate answers to nothing here.
message.nusmp.mega.mhb.protected: This ground is protected: the square, the way home and the gates cannot be changed.
message.nusmp.mega.mhb.readonly: The Sanctuary is not open to building.
message.nusmp.mega.mhb.travel.arrive: Floor 0, the Sanctuary. Nothing here wishes you harm. The Spire to the east climbs, the Chasm to the west descends; the gate behind you leads home.
message.nusmp.mega.mhb.travel.leave: The Sanctuary lets you go. The gate stands quiet behind you.
message.nusmp.mega.mhb.travel.no_level: The Sanctuary does not answer: its dimension is not loaded.
message.nusmp.mega.mhb.travel.plaza: You are back on the Sanctuary's square.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.collapse: The ceiling groans. Watch the floor and RUN!
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.crumble: The other relics crumble to dust.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.empty_slot: There is nothing on this pedestal.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.exhausted: The pedestals stay bare: every relic of this rank already walks the world.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.flood: Magicule flood: %s s. Leave the vault!
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.flood_start: Toxic magicules pour out of the floor. Leave the vault!
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.not_offered: The relics have not appeared yet.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.offered: The vault stirs: %s relics rise from the dust. Take one and the rest are lost.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.refused: The Order's ledger refuses: that relic walks the world already. The vault falls silent.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.road: The relic chooses the road: the next ten floors are %s.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.spirit: A Cursed Spirit tears itself out of the stone!
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.swapped: Another hand had claimed that relic: a different one took its place.
message.nusmp.mega.crucible.too_late: Too late: a relic was already taken and the others are dust.
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_hub.title: Floor 0
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_hub.desc: Arrive in the Sanctuary Hub: a safe place to build, and the start of both roads.
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_holy.desc: Clear the first floor of the Holy road. From now on the Abyssal road is closed to you.
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_abyssal.d: Clear the first floor of the Abyssal road. From now on the Holy road is closed to you.
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_decennial: Reach floor +10 or floor -10 of the Mega-Dungeon.
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_system.de: Finish a quest that the System gives you inside the Mega-Dungeon.
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_shadow.de: Extract the shadow of a defeated Holy enemy with a Shadow Core.
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_gear.desc: Find a graded piece of standard gear in the Mega-Dungeon.
advancement.nusmp.dungeon.mega_gear_rare: Find a Rare-grade piece of standard gear, made to turn magic aside.
message.nusmp.arc.blank: This one has nothing to say yet.
message.nusmp.arc.egg_blank: This egg has no character in it.
message.nusmp.arc.disabled: The characters of the arcs are switched off (arc.enabled).
arc.dialogue._fallback.1: Ah, %1$s. I do not think we have met. I am %2$s.
arc.dialogue._fallback.5: The road ahead is long, %1$s. Do not rush it.
arc.dialogue._fallback.6: A door that will not open usually has another way around.
arc.dialogue._fallback.7: You have already brought one of them down. Keep your head, and keep going.
arc.dialogue._fallback.8: Every story starts with a first fight. Choose it well.
item.nusmp.genesis_core.desc1: Take it to a Soul Forge to design an Avatar. It is spent only when the Avatar is born.
item.nusmp.soul_forge.desc1: Place it, hold a Genesis Core and use it: the ritual of the Avatar begins.
item.nusmp.soul_forge.desc2: Each Avatar costs one Genesis Core. The forge itself is never used up.

message.nusmp.avatar.disabled: Avatars are disabled on this server.
message.nusmp.avatar.forge.abandoned: You leave the ritual. Nothing was taken.

message.nusmp.avatar.forge.gone: The Soul Forge is gone: the ritual breaks.
message.nusmp.avatar.forge.hungry: The Soul Forge hungers for a Genesis Core.
message.nusmp.avatar.forge.limit: You already have %s Avatar(s): the Soul Forge has nothing more for you.
message.nusmp.avatar.forge.noscreen: The Soul Forge could not open its screen.
message.nusmp.avatar.forge.strayed: You moved away from the circle: the ritual breaks. Nothing was taken.
message.nusmp.avatar.forge.timeout: The ritual has waited too long and fades. Nothing was taken.

message.nusmp.mega.gen2.stairs.lost: The stairs back are gone. Ask an admin to look at /multiverse mega status.
message.nusmp.mega.gen2.stairs.hub.sub: You leave the Labyrinth by the stairs.
