message.nusmp.mega.enc.celestial_court.c: The sentence has been passed. The executioner is on its way.
Two halves of the golden gate swing shut behind a sentinel's step.
The statues between the columns have not been there as long as you thought.
The court sits in judgement on the unlit. The condemned are called.
The host of the court has come down from the terraces.
A horn from the terrace. The host has been summoned, and you are why.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.holy_church.churc: The bell tolls once, and something in the belfry gets up.
A tomb lid slides aside in the side chapel. Armour that was knighted here stands up.
Stone grinds above you. The gargoyles on the buttresses have turned their heads.
Chanting from the apse, in a tongue the church does not use.
The procession of the crypt has begun, and you are the way it is walking.
The great bell tolls and every candle in the nave leans toward you.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.mountain_monaster: The gate guardian has heard you coming and is not going to move aside.
The great gong has been struck, and not by anyone friendly.
Something is moving inside the paper walls.
A gong, and the rogue monks form a ring. A challenge has been called.
The mountain has decided against you, and it brought company.
You hear nothing, which is how you know he is there.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sky_citadel.sky_g: A horn for the giants' table, and you are what is being served.
Something very large stirs in a chair built for it.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sky_citadel.sky_s: Every curtain on the gallery stands out sideways at once.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sky_citadel.sky_t: Thunder rolls down the gallery from the wrong direction.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sky_citadel.sky_w: The wind in the arched windows has found a voice and a direction.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.celestial_c: Marble terraces under an open sky, and a court that has been waiting for you to be tried.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.holy_church: Candles gutter in the nave, and the bell has not been rung by a living hand in a long time.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.mountain_mo: Paper lanterns, bamboo and a bell on the mountain wind: the discipline of this place went wrong in a quiet way.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.sky_citadel: Everything here was built for something ten times your size, and the floor ends where the cloud begins.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.feywild_gro: Giant flowers glow where no sun reaches, and every path you take was chosen for you by something that is laughing.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.dwarven_for: The hearths were never banked, and a hammer still rings in the great hall with nobody swinging it.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.crystal_geo: The whole room is one crystal, humming, and each of your footsteps comes back from a different wall.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.sunken_temp: A kind god's temple, flooded to the knee, where the lanterns still burn under the water and the hymn goes on.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.feywild_grove.sat: Pipes and hooves on the turf, and a laugh with an edge on it. The feast has no seat for you.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.feywild_grove.wil: Small lights drift out of the dark, and each one is pretending to be the way out.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.feywild_grove.bri: The hedge beside you rustles, and whatever is in it has too many legs.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.feywild_grove.hag: A crone hums over a pot that was not there a moment ago. She has a bargain for you, and her friends are listening.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.feywild_grove.wil: A horn, far off, then much nearer. The Wild Hunt is riding through the grove and you are on its road.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.feywild_grove.bra: The thickets close in. Every hedge around you has something in it, and all of it is moving.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.feywild_grove.mid: Midsummer: a whole revel spills out of the flowers, laughing, and the guest of honour is you.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.dwarven_forgehold: Grey beards and grey axes come down the long hall. The hold's rebels do not keep a guest room.
The vein in the wall shivers. Something has been eating the ore from the inside, and it has come out.
An anvil rings once with nobody at it. The armour on the racks stands up, and the forges answer.
Drums from the lower deeps and a great many boots on the stair. The horde has found the hold's front door.
A horn in the great hall, and the whole hold turns out in arms: the golem, the armour and the fire.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.crystal_geode.cry: A facet in the wall opens like an eye. Then another, and another.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.crystal_geode.ech: A geode carries every step a long way. Wings answer from all the galleries at once.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.crystal_geode.umb: The wall beside you hums, then splits. Something with horns has been tunnelling toward the sound of you.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.crystal_geode.liv: Two of the crystal statues were never statues. Their facets turn, slowly, toward you.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.crystal_geode.cub: The floor shivers, and slimes full of light well up between the shells with sparks riding on them.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.crystal_geode.sha: A wall sheds its crystal in a hundred pieces, and the pieces have teeth.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.crystal_geode.geo: The geode groans, a wall comes down with a roar, and what it was hiding steps through while the floor is still ringing.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sunken_temple.los: A bell under the water, and singing. The temple's dead are at their hymn, and you are quiet enough to hear it.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sunken_temple.col: The statue of the god turns its head. Water streams from its shoulders, and it begins to walk.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sunken_temple.dee: Something in the cisterns has noticed that you carry no light, and it is coming up the stairs.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sunken_temple.flo: The pool is rising, and the water has teeth. The tide has come in and it brought company.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.sunken_temple.dro: The bell sounds, the hymn begins, and the whole drowned congregation rises to sing you down.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.cursed_archive.ca: Chains rattle on the aisle ahead. The censors have come for what you are carrying.
A cough, from every shelf at once. The rule of the room is silence, and you have not kept it.
The ink on the nearest page lifts off the paper and learns to fly.
Something in the aisle says your name, and says it is overdue.
A bay of shelving tips toward you, and something steps out from behind it.
A page turns by itself, and then every page in the room.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.haunted_manor.hm_: The air in front of you is colder than the room.
Every door in the house opens at once.
Someone has come downstairs in a gown. She was not expecting company, and she is not pleased.
A music box, somewhere, playing a tune you almost know.
A chair slides across the floor, and nobody pushed it.
The armour on the wall is facing the other way than it was.
Doors slam all over the house, one after another, toward you.
A cauldron lid clatters, and a voice says dinner is nearly ready.
Strings, out of tune, and the sound of many feet on the boards.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.necropolis.nc_bon: The bones in the wall have been gathered. Something has put them together.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.necropolis.nc_bur: The ground gives, and the ones under it have been awake a long time.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.necropolis.nc_dea: Armour, and the iron sound of an oath being kept, coming up out of the tomb.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.necropolis.nc_gna: The niches in the wall are not all full any more.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.necropolis.nc_oss: Every skull in the wall turns the same way, and it is yours.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.necropolis.nc_pro: A bell, slow and far off. Then footsteps in step, coming this way.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.vampire_castle.vc: The bell rings once, and the belfry empties.
The hunt has your scent, and the whole court has heard you coming.
Lids slide across the floor, from every side.
A coffin lid slides to the floor. Then the next.
Stone grinds above you. The gargoyles on the roof have turned their heads.
A howl in the yard, and then many of them, closer.
Someone is standing in the mirror who is not standing beside you.
A gentleman in evening dress bows to you from the stair. He does not cast a shadow.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.cursed_arch: Chained books climb out of sight, and the quiet here is not peace, it is a rule that somebody enforces.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.haunted_man: Dust sheets, a music box, and a house that still keeps the hour it ended; every room is as the family left it, and not everybody left.
A city of the dead laid out in streets and squares, where every door is a tomb and the lamps were never allowed to go out.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.vampire_cas: A castle that keeps its own night: red velvet, a mirror that shows the room but not you, and a host who has expected you for some time.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.fungal_unde: Spores drift where no sun ever came, and every cap you pass is listening.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.infernal_fo: Everything here is on shift, and every bargain is already signed.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.drowned_cry: The sea took the church and kept the congregation.
message.nusmp.mega.mgd.theme.spider_warr: White silk over black stone; something very large has been waiting for guests.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.drowned_crypt.dc_: A bell rings, a long way down.
Water running off something that is walking.
The water in the hall is rising.
The lid of the tomb is on the floor.
Someone is singing, under the water.
Boots, a great many, on the stairs.
A voice in a language that is not for you.
Soft footsteps, and eight legs behind them.
Something round and unblinking is hanging in the dark.
The mushrooms shiver all at once.
Lights go out, one at a time, in a ring.
The spores go off like a drum.
Something lets go of the cap above you.
Two armies have found the same corridor.
The air shimmers; something small is laughing.
Every door in the foundry has opened.
The armour on the rack is still hot.
Somebody has rung for the crew.
Claws on iron plates, coming fast.
message.nusmp.mega.enc.spider_warrens.sw: Something has let go of the ceiling.
Someone is whistling to the spiders.
Every web in the warren is shaking.
The guard has been told you are here.
Eight legs on stone, many times over.
The threads are all pulled at once.
message.nusmp.mega.party.entry.solo: You walk the floors of your own: a party of one. Join an FTB team to share them with friends.
message.nusmp.mega.party.entry.team: Your party %s has floors of its own. %s of you are in the dungeon now.
message.nusmp.mega.party.evicted: These floors belong to another party. The dungeon sends you back to the Hub; go in again by your own gate.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.1: Charlotte Roselei, Blue Rose. Do not stare. State your business or leave.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.2: Hmph. Another delver. Keep your distance and your hands to yourself, and we will get along.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.3: You are not unbearable. That is rare. Go on, speak.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.4: You are the one clearing the guardian floors? ...Fine. I suppose that earns you a place within arm's reach.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.6: Back again? Do not make a habit of it. ...Do.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.7: Thorns exist so that nobody has to apologise for what they protect. Remember that when you build a defence.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.8: A trap you have seen is half-defused. The dungeon is full of them. Look at the floor before you step on it.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.9: Briars bind what they touch. Fire frees you, so does a sharp blade, so does patience. Panic is the only thing that does not.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.10: If you happen to meet the Black Bulls' captain, you did not hear my name from me.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.11: Take your party's weakest member seriously. A chain breaks at its smallest link, and a squad at its most careless knight.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.12: Noise and light draw things in the dark. Walk softly through halls you have not cleared.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.13: No champions beaten. Listen: start with the lesser ones, watch their habits, then strike. That is what a Blue Rose does.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun hide behind pretty speeches. Cut through them.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.15: One of the Eye's thorns is pulled. Do not celebrate; there are more.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.16: Spade Kingdom blood magic is petty and cruel. Keep your guard up and your party close.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.17: Lucius turns people into props on his stage. I would very much like to prune him.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.18: More challengers from other worlds. Good. I have been told I am unsociable; this is my chance to be rude to strangers.
arc.dialogue.charlotte_roselei.19: Mind my roses on your way out.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.1: Hi hi hi! I'm Dorothy, Coral Peacock! ...Zzz. Sorry. Mid-hello. It happens.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.2: Welcome to the Sanctuary, %1$s. Have you ever had a dream that felt more real than waking? ...Me neither. Just asking.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.3: Oh, a new face. You look like someone who would share a macaron. ...Yes? Yes.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.4: You're the one in all the dreams lately. Fighting big things. Nice, nice.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.6: You again! Hee hee. I dreamed about you.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.7: In a dream, anything is possible, but it only works if the dreamer is awake enough to hold it. Think about that.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.8: Macarons keep morale up. Strawberry ones especially. This is a fact.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.9: Rest is a weapon, %1$s. If you do not rest properly, you fight worse. I rest properly. All the time.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.10: Cute things are underrated in battle. They make people underestimate you. ...Yawn.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.11: My vice-captain does the paperwork. I do the sleeping. We are very efficient.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.12: I look after my squad, you know. Even when I am asleep. Especially when I am asleep.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.13: Do not worry too much. Worry is just a dream you have with your eyes open.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.14: No champions yet? Mmm. Start with an easy one. Or nap first. Napping first is allowed.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.15: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are so serious. Serious people have terrible dreams. I have seen.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.16: Spade Kingdom dreams are heavy. Like being pushed into a bed that is also a cliff.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.17: Lucius is in a lot of dreams lately. He does not say anything. He just waits. Do not dream about him.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.18: So many worlds in the Chronicle. I dream about them sometimes. Everyone is a little sad and a little hungry. Bring snacks.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.19: Mm. See you. Or I will dream you.
arc.dialogue.dorothy_unsworth.21: Take a nap first. Then go.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.1: I am Fuegoleon Vermillion, captain of the Crimson Lion. Be welcome in the Sanctuary, %1$s.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.2: A delver, then. The dungeon has need of those who keep their heads. Do you?
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.3: Fire is a good servant and a terrible master. I would be glad to see you learn the difference.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.4: Your deeds reached the Sanctuary before you did, %1$s. It is an honour to meet you.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.6: Good to see you on your feet.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.7: A flame with no purpose is only a fire. Decide what you protect, and let the heat follow.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.8: I was struck down once, badly. It taught me what the people behind me are worth. Fight with them, not around them.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.9: The spirit of fire does not lend its power to the careless. Earn it, and take care of it.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.10: My sister Mereoleona has more strength than patience, and my brother Leopold more heart than caution. Between them they keep me humble.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.11: Every boss shows its blow before it lands. A calm eye sees the warning; a hot head sees only the target.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.12: Hold the line together. A party that retreats together can always return.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.13: Start small, %1$s. A guardian on the early floors is still a guardian. There is no shame in bringing company.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun is patient and cruel. Do not let them choose the ground you fight on.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.15: One of the Eye's blades is broken. It is a start, not the end of it.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.16: The Spade Kingdom fights in a way we do not. Do not meet gravity with stubbornness; go around it.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.17: To face Lucius is to face a man who has already thought of your next move. Show him one he has not.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.18: I am told there are warriors in the Chronicle who answer to no kingdom at all. I would be glad to learn from them, and to stand beside them.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.19: Go with fire in your heart and a cool head.
arc.dialogue.fuegoleon_vermillion.21: The Crimson Lion stands behind you.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.1: Hahaha! Look at that, a fresh face! Jack the Ripper, Green Mantis. Don't worry, I only cut things that cut back.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.2: A delver! Good. Delvers always have something worth cutting.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.3: Commoner? Noble? Doesn't matter. Can you swing something sharp? That's all I want to know.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.4: So YOU'RE the one filling the guardians' graves! Come here, let me shake your hand. Carefully.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.5: Hey, it's you! Got anything for me to cut?
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.6: Still alive? Hahaha! I like that.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.7: Everything has a seam. Armour, magic, even the dark between two rooms. Find it and I'll teach you the cut.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.8: Barrier in your way? Cut it. Door in your way? Cut it. Rule in your way... I'll cut that too, if nobody's looking.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.9: Safe Zones are for resting, and resting is for people with somewhere to be. I'm going to sharpen.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.10: Don't mind me licking the blade. It helps me think. It also tastes of victory. Hahaha!
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.11: That lazy Black Bull captain keeps calling me a madman. Pot, kettle! Hahaha!
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.12: I was born a commoner and I cut just fine. Blood doesn't matter; the edge does. Remember that.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.13: No guardians dead yet? Then you're missing the best part. Go! Hear them crack!
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are lovely targets. Lots of tricks, lots of seams. Tell me how it goes!
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.15: Heath Grice? He never liked being cut. Don't blame him. Hahaha!
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.16: Gravity, huh? Cut the field itself if you've got the reach. Otherwise... run! Hahaha!
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.17: Lucius reads attacks before they land? Then cut fast. Four cuts inside a second, and see how he reads that!
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.18: Other worlds, other swords! I hope somebody out there cuts better than I do. Then I can stop being bored.
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.19: Hahaha! Go bring me stories with blood in them!
arc.dialogue.jack_the_ripper.20: Don't get cut! ...Unless it makes a good story.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.1: Ahaha! A new visitor to the Sanctuary! I am Julius Novachrono. Do not stand on ceremony. I certainly do not.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.2: Welcome, %1$s! You have the look of someone who has opened a great many doors and wants to open more. Excellent!
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.3: Ah, so you are the one the dungeon has been whispering about! Come, ask me anything. Time is the one thing I always seem to find.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.4: The records say your story stands at '%3$s', and I am only now learning your name! Forgive a Wizard King his manners.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.6: Back so soon? Or did I wander off in the middle of the hour again? Hee hee.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.7: Every grimoire is a small door. I have spent my life opening them. Never stop reading.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.8: I never judged anyone by rank or by blood. The dungeon does not either: it only asks what you can do.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.9: The Chronicle in the plaza keeps the list of every story told here, and the dungeon plays them back as challengers. Read it before each descent.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.10: Time Magic is mostly patience. Even so, there are moments when patience runs out and only the next breath is left.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.11: Chrono Stasis is the page every Time mage learns to trust. It holds a thing for a few seconds at most. Spend them on a friend's safety, not on greed.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.12: If you find the hours are not enough, I can spare one or two. Not many. Ahaha!
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.13: If a stranger in the plaza gives you good advice, be polite and say thank you. You never know who is wearing a disguise.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.14: Magic is not a ranking. It is a conversation. Listen to your grimoire, and it will tell you what it wants to become.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.15: A champion that falls does not vanish. It joins the Chronicle. That is how we remember them.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.16: Let me tell you how it goes. First the Eye of the Midnight Sun, then the Spade Kingdom, then a name I would rather not say aloud. The Chronicle opens each in its turn.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.17: The Eye of the Midnight Sun is older than the kingdom's quarrels. Their members hold the first guardian floors. Beat them in the order the Chronicle gives.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.18: The devil of the word souls is silenced. One more thread of that old story is cut. Ahaha, I do love a tidy ending!
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.19: The Spade Kingdom now. The Zogratis siblings fight with gravity, blood and bone, and behind them stands a devil whose weight no one bears alone. Bring friends.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.20: The last of them is Lucius Zogratis. He can only be called to his own arena, with the Hourglass of the Final Hour.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.21: Craft the hourglass from gold, a nether star, amethyst, a clock, diamonds and an ender pearl. An odd recipe, but time is odd.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.22: Hold the hourglass, and those within eight paces of you come with you. Choose them well, and do not step in alone.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.23: In that fight a part of me is bound to him. At four moments my will rises, and for a few breaths he is not himself. Strike then, all of you, with everything you have.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.24: He reads the next blow before it falls, unless two of you strike together, or one of you strikes very quickly, or you carry anti-magic. Remember that.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.25: The Chronicle has begun to open pages from other worlds. Seven knights who carry sins, a labyrinth beneath a city called Orario... Stranger and stranger. I am delighted.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.26: If you meet someone from another world, treat them as you would a Magic Knight from another kingdom. Curiosity first. Swords second.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.27: You stood before Lucius and walked away. I... thank you. More than I can say in a single hour.
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.28: Go well, %1$s. And come back with stories!
arc.dialogue.julius_novachrono.29: May your hours be long and your grimoire heavy.
arc.dialogue.kahono.1: Oh! Hello! I'm Kahono, from the Seabed Temple! Well, I used to be. Now I'm from... the sky? The sky is so big!
arc.dialogue.kahono.2: Welcome, %1$s! Songs can close wounds, you know. Mine do. Mostly. I'll sing for you sometime!
arc.dialogue.kahono.3: My brother says I talk too much. Do you think that's true? Don't answer that!
arc.dialogue.kahono.4: You're the one bringing down the champions! Everyone's talking about you! I'm going to write a song about it!
arc.dialogue.kahono.5: %1$s! You came back! I wrote a new verse!
arc.dialogue.kahono.7: If you ever learn Song magic, you can sing it with your own voice! Speak into your microphone, or hold the Sing key if you don't have one.
arc.dialogue.kahono.8: Healing Hymn is for friends, Lullaby for anyone who needs to stop, Barrier Chorus to push foes away, and Requiem for when there is no other way.
arc.dialogue.kahono.9: My Crescendo answers only to my own grimoire. But every other song is yours to learn!
arc.dialogue.kahono.10: I want to be an idol, you know. The first idol of the surface! I think I'd be good at it.
arc.dialogue.kahono.11: My brother Kiato is serious about everything. I'm serious about only a few things. Mostly singing.
arc.dialogue.kahono.12: I've never seen so many stars! Do you have this many where you come from?
arc.dialogue.kahono.13: A song in your head helps in a fight. Hum something! Anything!
arc.dialogue.kahono.14: No champions yet? Then everything is still ahead of you! That's the best kind of song.
arc.dialogue.kahono.15: The Eye of the Midnight Sun frightens me. But we'll face things like that together, right?
arc.dialogue.kahono.16: Vetto is gone? Then Kiato and I can finally breathe. Thank you, thank you!
arc.dialogue.kahono.17: Everyone in the Spade Kingdom looks so sad in the stories. I hope songs can reach them too.
arc.dialogue.kahono.18: Lucius frightens even the captains. So I'll sing the loudest for whoever goes to face him!
arc.dialogue.kahono.19: So many strangers from other worlds in the Chronicle! Imagine the songs they must know!
arc.dialogue.kahono.20: Come back and tell me everything! I'll sing about it!
arc.dialogue.kiato.1: I am Kiato, of the Seabed Temple. The dance is my prayer and my blade. You may call me by name.
arc.dialogue.kiato.2: You walk with purpose. Good. The dance begins with the first step, and so does every journey.
arc.dialogue.kiato.3: Forgive my sister if she talks your ear off. She means well. ...Usually.
arc.dialogue.kiato.4: Your deeds are known even to the Sea God's servants. I am honoured to meet you, %1$s.
arc.dialogue.kiato.7: The dance teaches one thing: be where the blow is not. It sounds simple. It takes a lifetime.
arc.dialogue.kiato.8: A body that moves without fear is harder to strike. Fear tightens; the dance releases.
arc.dialogue.kiato.9: When a missile comes, turn it. When a blow comes, step out. When both come, dance.
arc.dialogue.kiato.10: If you carry the Butoh book, the dance wakes by itself: the body learns to slip out of a blow. Mine is only more practised.
arc.dialogue.kiato.11: My grandfather is the High Priest of the Temple. He taught me that tradition is a river, not a wall.
arc.dialogue.kiato.12: The surface is brighter than I imagined. Kahono sings to the sky every evening. I pretend not to listen.
arc.dialogue.kiato.13: Do not fight the rhythm of a boss. Learn it, and step between its beats.
arc.dialogue.kiato.14: No champions defeated. Begin with patience. Watch the first guardian dance before you join it.
arc.dialogue.kiato.15: The Eye of the Midnight Sun came to our temple once. I will say no more. Defeat them, and the sea grows calmer.
arc.dialogue.kiato.16: Vetto is gone. My sister and I owe you a debt we cannot repay in words.
arc.dialogue.kiato.17: The Spade Kingdom's gravity is a heavy dance. Learn its rhythm, then move where it is not.
arc.dialogue.kiato.18: Lucius reads a fight like a score. Change the tempo.
arc.dialogue.kiato.19: Other worlds have other dances. I would like to learn from their warriors, if they will teach.
arc.dialogue.kiato.21: May the sea carry your steps.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.1: Klaus Lunettes, Golden Dawn. I assume you know what that means. If you do not, you will learn.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.2: State your purpose in the Sanctuary. ...The dungeon, of course. Then listen carefully, because I will say this only once.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.3: A new delver. Tell me, %1$s: do you have a plan, or only courage? Courage is not a plan.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.4: Hm. A delver of record already. Then I will skip the lecture. Mostly.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.5: %1$s. What have you learned since last time?
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.6: Still alive? Good. Dead delvers make poor strategists.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.7: Every dangerous attack shows its warning first: a mark on the floor, a glow, a held breath. Learn the warnings and half the fight is won.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.8: Steel is patient. A wall, a lance, an ally standing behind both. Build a position before you advance.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.9: Do not fight in the open when a corridor will do. Narrow ground favours the prepared.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.10: I was raised to believe nobility is a privilege. I have since learned it is a debt. I intend to repay mine.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.11: Noble or commoner, I judge a mage by how long they stay on their feet. The dungeon keeps the same ledger.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.12: Noise and light draw attention in the dark. Move quietly through halls you have not cleared, and scout before you commit.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.13: No champion defeated, yet you are asking for advice. That alone puts you ahead of most. Study the first guardian's pattern before you commit.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun fights as a unit. When you meet one of them, assume a second plan is hidden behind the first.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.15: You defeated Vetto. A beast with no obvious weakness. I would like your notes, if you kept any.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.16: Gravity, blood, bone. Three siblings, three problems. Solve them one at a time, in the order the Chronicle gives.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.17: Lucius reads a single attacker's rhythm. So break your rhythm, or strike in pairs, or strike so fast he has no time to read.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.18: I cannot evaluate enemies from worlds I have never studied. I will study them anyway. A strategist is paid to be uncomfortable.
arc.dialogue.klaus_lunettes.20: Do nothing unwise. Or, at the least, document it.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.1: Hey! You! I'm Leopold Vermillion, and one day I'll be the strongest of the Vermillions!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.2: Are you a delver? Great! Then we're rivals! Don't argue, it's decided.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.3: Welcome to the Sanctuary! Don't worry, I'll show you around. By which I mean I'll show you how strong I am.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.4: You've beaten champions already?! No way! Then I'll train twice as hard!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.5: Rival! You're back! I've been waiting to show you something!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.6: Oh! It's you! Let's spar sometime!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.7: Fire gets stronger when you shout! ...That might not be true. But it feels true.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.8: My brother is a captain, my sister is a monster, and I'm just getting started. Watch me.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.9: Rest when you're tired and fight when you're not. Even I figured that one out.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.10: Don't just copy someone's spells. Make them yours! That's what my brother says, anyway.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.11: Warm up before the big fights! A stiff arm is a missed block!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.12: No champion yet? Perfect, we start from the same spot, rival! First to beat a guardian wins! ...You're already ahead. I haven't gone yet.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.13: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are tough, but we're tougher! Don't let their tricks scare you, rival!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.14: Heath Grice is beaten? Ha! I would have done it too, just... later!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.15: Spade Kingdom! Gravity! If it pushes you down, push back harder! Or just jump!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.16: Lucius is the last big one? I can't wait! Okay, I can wait a little. I'm a bit scared.
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.17: Rival, there are fighters in the Chronicle from other worlds! Think how strong they must be! I want to fight them all!
arc.dialogue.leopold_vermillion.19: Don't lose to anything without me!
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.1: Marx Francois, aide to the Wizard King. I keep the records of this Sanctuary. You are %1$s, I assume.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.2: I was expecting you, %1$s. The Wizard King announces newcomers before they arrive. Please do not ask how.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.3: Welcome to the Sanctuary. Rule one: nothing in the dungeon is safe. Rule two: everything here is. Do not confuse them.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.4: Your record is already extensive, %1$s. I will need to update several ledgers.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.6: Back again. Good. I dislike unfinished records.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.7: A party is the Magic Knights' oldest tool. Your team shares one chain of floors, and a team's progress belongs to the team.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.8: The System tracks your floor quests and rewards inside the dungeon. Its bonuses sleep outside and wake when you return. Nothing is lost.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.9: Every tenth floor has a Guardian, a Gatekeeper door and a vault. The way on lies behind them. There is no way around.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.10: Safe Zones and Landings are the only places where you recover properly. I record this because people keep dying beside them anyway.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.11: A Charter Grimoire may fall to the first one to defeat a champion, once per world, by chance. Hold it and it lends its skills; put it away and they return.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.12: Champions follow a chain. One opens only when the ones before it have fallen. The Chronicle lists which are open and which are not.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.13: Each floor is a level of its own: you arrive at the foot of a stair and must find the way on. If the stairs say they are still forming, wait. Do not run back.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.14: Wandering champions patrol the halls between the guardian floors. A quiet hall is not an empty one.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.15: Some pages answer only to the grimoire of one particular person. That is by design. Please file it under: not a bug.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.16: I have asked the Wizard King several times to keep a schedule. He says time is not a schedule. I note it for the records.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.17: The records currently place you in: %3$s.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.18: No champions on file. Per protocol, I recommend the lower floors of either road, and a party.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.19: Your current concern is the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Their chain is long. Do not skip links.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.20: Zagred: file closed, pending a review of the aftermath. Please do not reopen it.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.21: The Spade Kingdom files are now open to you. Warning: the Zogratis family uses curses that persist. Do not descend further while marked.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.22: The file on Lucius Zogratis opens only in his arena. Standing order: nobody enters alone. Anyone within reach of the Hourglass bearer travels with them, seven companions at most.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.23: Once the fight has begun, the arena is closed to latecomers, and leaving takes ten seconds. Gather everyone first. I will not be filing a rescue report.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.24: New files keep arriving from worlds I have not catalogued. I have stopped asking where they come from.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.25: Warning on file: fighters from other worlds do not follow Clover Kingdom protocol. Plan accordingly.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.26: Return alive. The paperwork is shorter.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.27: Report back when you have results.
arc.dialogue.marx_francois.28: Good luck. Strictly speaking, I am not permitted to say that.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.1: Hah! Fresh blood! I'm Mereoleona Vermillion. Don't bow, it makes my neck hurt.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.2: You look like you can take a punch. Good. I've been bored.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.3: Are you strong? No, don't answer. I'll find out.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.4: THAT'S you? The one clearing the guardians? Come here, let me see your arms!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.5: Oh, it's you again. Have you been training?
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.6: Ha! Still in one piece. Excellent!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.7: Mana Zone! Learn it! If you can't feel the magic around you, you're fighting blind, and I will laugh at you.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.8: Mana Strike is raw power with no tricks. I like it. It works on anything, and nobody can call it cheating.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.9: Talking won't make you stronger. Training will. Go hit something big!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.10: Retreat? Never. Fall back to a Safe Zone and come back angrier. That's different.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.11: Fuegoleon thinks too much and Leopold shouts too much. The Crimson Lion is balanced by me, naturally.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.12: Pain is only information. Read it, and move on.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.13: No champions beaten? Hah! Then go beat one. Why are you still talking to me?
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are the first of many. Break them quickly, and keep your anger. It keeps you warm.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.15: You beat Vetto? That monster hit like a mountain. Come here, I'll buy you meat.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.16: A Spade Kingdom brat with gravity? Don't stand where he wants you standing. Move!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.17: Lucius! I'd love to fight someone who reads my moves... and then break his nose with the one he didn't read.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.18: Strangers from other worlds in the Chronicle? Even better! Go, and bring me the strongest one's name.
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.19: Go! Don't come back until you've broken something!
arc.dialogue.mereoleona_vermillion.20: Bring me a good story, or a good bruise.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.1: Oh! Hello, I'm Mimosa Vermillion. Please don't be nervous, I'm only a Golden Dawn knight. ...Only.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.2: Welcome to the Sanctuary, %1$s! I hope you're not hurt. Healing is the one thing I'm good at, so please take care of yourself.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.3: Hello! Please take care of yourself down there. I'll worry otherwise.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.4: You've already beaten champions... you must be so tired. Please, rest and take care of yourself.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.5: %1$s! You came back safe. I'm so glad.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.6: Oh, hello again! You look tired. Please rest first.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.7: Rest in a Safe Zone or at a Landing whenever you can. Your body won't mend by itself down there, however brave you feel.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.8: Plants remember where the light was. If a room feels wrong, look at what grows in it.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.9: Flowers can't fight, but they can hold a wall. I think healing and protecting are the same thing.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.10: Eat before you go, and bring something for your friends. Nobody fights well on an empty stomach.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.11: Fuegoleon and Mereoleona are my brother and sister. I joined the Golden Dawn on my own, so nobody could say it was because of my name.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.12: I used to think only people with strong magic mattered. I was wrong, and it took my friends to show me.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.13: You haven't fought a champion yet, have you? Please take a friend with you for the first one.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun frightens me. But I saw my friends stand up to them, and I want to stand up too.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.15: I heard Heath Grice is gone. I'm glad it's over, but I wish nobody had to be hurt like that.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.16: The Zogratis curses don't fade on their own. If you're marked, please don't hide it from your party. Tell them.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.17: Lucius... please, whoever you go with, hold each other's hands before you start. Even if it sounds silly.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.18: There are so many people from other worlds fighting down there. I hope they'll let us help them someday.
arc.dialogue.mimosa_vermillion.20: I'll leave a flower here for you. Bring it back with a story!
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.1: Nozel Silva, captain of the Silver Eagle. State your business, or do not. I have little interest either way.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.2: A new delver. Do not expect special treatment because you stand on royal ground. Do expect honesty.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.3: Hmph. At least you do not shout. That puts you ahead of most.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.4: I have heard of you, %1$s. Do not let it go to your head.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.7: Mercury flows into every gap. A defence with no gap is worth more than ten attacks. Remember that.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.8: Do not mistake courage for competence. The dungeon punishes the first and rewards the second.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.9: Pride is not strength. But strength that does not know its worth is wasted. I speak from experience.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.10: Family is a matter of effort, not blood. ...Forget that I said that.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.11: A telegraphed blow is a gift. Anyone who dies to one has only himself to blame.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.12: Armour, barrier, mercury: choose what suits you, then trust it. Doubt kills faster than any blade.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.13: No champions defeated. Then you have much to prove. Begin by surviving the first one.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun means to rewrite this kingdom. I do not intend to let them. Neither should you.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.15: The Eye has lost another piece. Continue.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.16: Spade Kingdom gravity can pin even armour. Do not lean on silver or steel to bear a weight meant for resolve.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.17: If you intend to face Lucius, do it as a unit. A single blade will not matter.
arc.dialogue.nozel_silva.18: The Chronicle holds strangers now. Fine. I will judge them as I judge everyone: by what they do under pressure.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.1: Solid Silva, Silver Eagle. Yes, those Silvas. Try not to look too impressed.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.2: Another delver? How tedious. ...Well, at least you are not shouting.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.3: You look like you need advice. Lucky for you I give it free. Do not expect it to be nice.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.4: So you are the delver who keeps turning up in the reports. I suppose I should say well done. ...There. I said it.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.7: Water takes the shape of whatever holds it. A mage who cannot adapt is just a puddle with pride.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.8: My family has a talent for looking down on people. I am working on it. Slowly.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.9: Do not waste mana on showy spells. Anyone can make a big splash. The trick is being the one still standing afterwards.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.10: My little sister turned out to be stronger than the rest of us. I will not say that out loud again.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.11: The tide goes out, the tide comes in. If you are losing a fight, remember the tide: pull back, then return stronger.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.12: No champions beaten? Fine. We all start somewhere. Some of us started with servants. Never mind.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.13: The Eye of the Midnight Sun are fanatics. Fanatics make mistakes when you wreck their plans. So wreck them.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.14: You beat Vetto? ...Tch. Fine. Good work. Do not make me say it twice.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.15: Spade Kingdom. Dark nonsense. Wash off the curses after every fight there.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.16: Lucius? Let somebody else go first. ...I am joking. Mostly.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.17: People from beyond our world in the Chronicle? Splendid. More people to out-perform.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.18: Do not die. It would be embarrassing for the Sanctuary.
arc.dialogue.solid_silva.19: Go on. I have things to look down on.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.1: I am William Vangeance, captain of the Golden Dawn. You are welcome here, %1$s, as everyone is.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.2: The Sanctuary is a good place to set a burden down for an afternoon. I know something of burdens.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.3: You have the look of someone choosing a road. I will only say: choose it with open eyes.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.4: You have walked far already, %1$s. I will not waste your time with pleasantries.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.7: The World Tree has roots beneath every floor of this dungeon, if you know how to look. Wherever something grows, it is trying to tell you something.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.8: A captain is judged by those who stand behind him. I have not always been worthy of mine.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.9: Trust is easy to give and hard to win back. If someone offers you a second chance, take it, and spend your life deserving it.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.10: Be kind to people who wear masks. They usually have their reasons.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.11: Healing and growing are the same craft. A wound closes the way a seedling opens: slowly, and toward the light.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.12: Do not carry your doubts into a fight. Leave them here with me; I have room.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.13: You have not faced a champion yet. Good. Go slowly: your first impression of the dungeon will last.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.14: The Eye of the Midnight Sun's grief is older than their quarrel with us. I do not forgive them, but I understand it. That makes the fight harder, not easier.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.15: Zagred's words reached further than anyone knew. Some of them reached me. I am glad that voice is silenced.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.16: The Spade Kingdom's strength is taken from other people. Remember that when it merely looks powerful.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.17: When you face Lucius, remember that Julius is not gone. He fights beside you in that battle. I would stake what is left of my name on it.
arc.dialogue.william_vangeance.18: A tree grows toward whatever light there is, even another world's sun. I would like to learn from these newcomers.
arc.dialogue.yuno.1: %1$s. I have not seen you here before. I am Yuno, of the Golden Dawn.
arc.dialogue.yuno.2: A new delver. If you are going into the dungeon, go in with a plan. Ask me what you want to know.
arc.dialogue.yuno.3: Hm. You look like you have not decided whether to be brave or careful. Be both.
arc.dialogue.yuno.4: So you are the one the guardians keep losing to. I wanted to meet you, %1$s.
arc.dialogue.yuno.6: Still in one piece. That is a good start.
arc.dialogue.yuno.7: My rival would charge in first and think afterwards. I prefer the other order. Both work, if you survive.
arc.dialogue.yuno.8: Wind never pushes for the sake of pushing. It goes where the resistance is least. Fight the same way.
arc.dialogue.yuno.9: A spirit lends its strength only to someone it trusts. Treat the one that chose you as a partner, not a tool.
arc.dialogue.yuno.10: Spirit Dive asks a great deal of you both. Do not stay in it longer than the strain allows.
arc.dialogue.yuno.11: Mana runs lower down there than it feels. If your magic starts to stutter, step back and breathe before you cast again.
arc.dialogue.yuno.12: I mean to become Wizard King. So does Asta. Neither of us can afford to lose to anything in this dungeon.
arc.dialogue.yuno.13: You have not beaten a single champion yet. Start with the Eye of the Midnight Sun on the early floors. They are strong, but they are the first step, not the last.
arc.dialogue.yuno.14: Read the Chronicle in the plaza before you go down. It shows which fights are open to you and which are not.
arc.dialogue.yuno.15: You are making progress against the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Do not grow comfortable: the ones who lead them are far beyond the first.
arc.dialogue.yuno.16: Heath Grice is down? Then you know the Eye's soldiers can be beaten. Remember how you did it.
arc.dialogue.yuno.17: You brought Vetto down: all brawn and no mercy, and you still found a way. I am impressed.
arc.dialogue.yuno.18: The Spade Kingdom. The Zogratis name carries a weight the Eye never had: gravity, blood and bone. Prepare for each of them separately.
arc.dialogue.yuno.19: Lucius Zogratis. Even the Wizard King could not end him alone. Do not enter his arena unless you can fight as a team.
arc.dialogue.yuno.20: There are fighters in the Chronicle I have never heard of, from worlds I have never seen. I intend to measure myself against every one.
arc.dialogue.yuno.22: May the wind be at your back.
arc.dialogue.yuno.23: I will be here when you return. Try to make that certain.
message.nusmp.arc.early.revchi.bound: Chained for %s s: strike him to tear the links, or use anti-magic.
message.nusmp.arc.early.revchi.free: The chain breaks: you are free.
message.nusmp.arc.early.heath.shielded: The ice shield swallows it: close in, or use anti-magic.
message.nusmp.arc.early.lotus.fall: The smoke has you: you stumble.
message.nusmp.arc.early.mars.guarded: The crystal turns the blow: strike from the side, or use anti-magic.
message.nusmp.arc.early.vetto.shielded: A wall stands between you and the Mana Release.
